154	  using ElementSFA = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;    // CUTLASS SFA = weight_sf
155	  using ElementSFB = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;    // CUTLASS SFB = act_sf
156	  using ElementCompute = float;
157	  using StrideB = typename T::StrideB;
158	  using StrideD = typename T::StrideD;
159	  using SparseConfig = typename T::SparseConfig;
160	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename T::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
161	
162	  // CUTLASS transposed problem: (M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K) = (N_user, M_user, K)
163	  int const M_cutlass = N_user;
164	  int const N_cutlass = M_user;
165	  int const K_cutlass = K;
166	  auto const problem_shape = cute::make_shape(M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1);
167	
168	  // A (weight) layout — sparse compressed; SparseConfig generates correct layout
169	  auto layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(problem_shape);
170	  auto layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(problem_shape);
171	
172	  // B (activation as ColumnMajor view of [M_user, K])
173	  auto stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1});
174	
175	  // D ColMajor (M_cutlass, N_cutlass) — physical layout matches user's RowMajor [M_user, N_user]
176	  auto stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {M_cutlass, N_cutlass, 1});
177	
178	  auto layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(problem_shape);
179	  auto layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(problem_shape);
180	
181	  typename T::Gemm::Arguments arguments{
182	      cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
183	      {M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1},
184	      {                                                                       // Mainloop args
185	       static_cast<typename ElementA::DataType const*>(weight.data_ptr()),    // A = weight compressed
186	       layout_A,
187	       static_cast<typename ElementB::DataType const*>(activation.data_ptr()), // B = activation
188	       stride_B,
189	       static_cast<ElementE const*>(weight_meta.data_ptr()),                  // E = metadata
190	       layout_E,
191	       static_cast<ElementSFA const*>(weight_sf.data_ptr()),                  // SFA = weight SF
192	       layout_SFA,
193	       static_cast<ElementSFB const*>(act_sf.data_ptr()),                     // SFB = act SF
194	       layout_SFB},
195	      {                                                                       // Epilogue args
196	       {},                                                                    // epilogue.thread (alpha set below)
197	       nullptr,                                                                // C ptr (no C-input)
198	       stride_D,
199	       static_cast<ElementD*>(D.data_ptr()),
200	       stride_D}};
201	  auto& fusion_args = arguments.epilogue.thread;
202	  fusion_args.alpha_ptr = static_cast<ElementCompute const*>(alpha.data_ptr());
203	  return arguments;
204	}
205	
206	template <typename T>
207	void runSparseGemmSm120(
208	    torch::Tensor& D,
209	    torch::Tensor const& activation,
210	    torch::Tensor const& weight,
211	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,
212	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,
213	    torch::Tensor const& weight_sf,
214	    torch::Tensor const& alpha,
215	    int M_user,
216	    int N_user,
217	    int K,
218	    cudaStream_t stream) {
219	  typename T::Gemm gemm;
220	  auto arguments = args_from_options_sparse_sm120<T>(
221	      D, activation, weight, weight_meta, act_sf, weight_sf, alpha, M_user, N_user, K);
222	  size_t workspace_size = T::Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
223	  auto const workspace_options = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(activation.device());
224	  auto workspace = torch::empty(workspace_size, workspace_options);
225	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
226	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
227	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
228	}
229	
230	void cutlass_sparse_fp4_bf16_gemm_dispatch_sm120(
231	    torch::Tensor& D,
232	    torch::Tensor const& activation,
233	    torch::Tensor const& weight,
234	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,
235	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,
236	    torch::Tensor const& weight_sf,
237	    torch::Tensor const& alpha,
238	    int m,
239	    int n,
240	    int k,
241	    cudaStream_t stream) {
242	  // For now use the default config (the M256/default split is identical until we tune)
243	  runSparseGemmSm120<SparseFp4GemmSm120<sm120_sparse_fp4_config_default, cutlass::bfloat16_t>>(
244	      D, activation, weight, weight_meta, act_sf, weight_sf, alpha, m, n, k, stream);
245	}
246	
247	#endif  // ENABLE_NVFP4 && SM120
248	
249	// =================================================================================================
250	// External op entry
251	// =================================================================================================
252	
253	#define CHECK_TYPE_SP(x, st, m) TORCH_CHECK(x.scalar_type() == st, "Inconsistency of Tensor type:", m)
254	#define CHECK_TH_CUDA_SP(x, m) TORCH_CHECK(x.is_cuda(), m, " must be a CUDA tensor")
255	#define CHECK_CONTIGUOUS_SP(x, m) TORCH_CHECK(x.is_contiguous(), m, " must be contiguous")
256	#define CHECK_INPUT_SP(x, st, m) \
257	  CHECK_TH_CUDA_SP(x, m);        \
258	  CHECK_CONTIGUOUS_SP(x, m);     \
259	  CHECK_TYPE_SP(x, st, m)
260	
261	constexpr auto SP_FP4_DTYPE = at::ScalarType::Byte;          // uint8: 2 NVFP4 elements per byte
262	constexpr auto SP_META_DTYPE = at::ScalarType::Byte;         // uint8 metadata
263	constexpr auto SP_SF_DTYPE = at::ScalarType::Float8_e4m3fn;  // SF as fp8 e4m3
264	
265	void cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(
266	    torch::Tensor& D,
267	    torch::Tensor const& activation,    // [M, K/2]
268	    torch::Tensor const& weight,        // [N, K/4] sparse-compressed
269	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,   // [N_aligned, K_aligned/8]
270	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,        // [round_up(M,128), round_up(K/16,4)]
271	    torch::Tensor const& weight_sf,     // [round_up(N,128), round_up(K/16,4)]
272	    torch::Tensor const& alpha) {
273	#if (defined ENABLE_NVFP4 && ENABLE_NVFP4) &&                                                       \
274	    (defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED) || defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM121_SUPPORTED))
275	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(activation, SP_FP4_DTYPE, "activation");
276	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight, SP_FP4_DTYPE, "weight");
277	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight_meta, SP_META_DTYPE, "weight_meta");
278	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(act_sf, SP_SF_DTYPE, "act_sf");
279	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight_sf, SP_SF_DTYPE, "weight_sf");
280	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(alpha, at::ScalarType::Float, "alpha");
281	
282	  TORCH_CHECK(activation.dim() == 2, "activation must be a 2D matrix");
283	  TORCH_CHECK(weight.dim() == 2, "weight (compressed) must be a 2D matrix");
284	
285	  auto const m = static_cast<int>(activation.size(0));
286	  auto const n = static_cast<int>(weight.size(0));
287	  auto const k = static_cast<int>(activation.size(1)) * 2;  // 2 NVFP4 / byte
288	
289	  // Compressed weight K-axis: K/4 bytes per row (2:4 sparse → K/2 elements, packed 2-per-byte → K/4 bytes)
290	  TORCH_CHECK(weight.size(1) * 4 == k, "weight K mismatch: weight.K/4=", weight.size(1), " vs activation.K=", k);
291	
292	  constexpr int alignment = 64;
293	  TORCH_CHECK(k % alignment == 0, "k must be divisible by ", alignment, ", got k=", k);
294	  TORCH_CHECK(n % alignment == 0, "n must be divisible by ", alignment, ", got n=", n);
295	
296	  // SF size sanity checks (matches dense kernel logic)
297	  auto round_up = [](int x, int y) { return (x + y - 1) / y * y; };
298	  int rounded_m = round_up(m, 128);
299	  int rounded_n = round_up(n, 128);
300	  int rounded_k = round_up(k / 16, 4);
301	  TORCH_CHECK(act_sf.size(0) == rounded_m && act_sf.size(1) == rounded_k,
302	              "act_sf shape mismatch: got [", act_sf.size(0), ",", act_sf.size(1),
303	              "] expect [", rounded_m, ",", rounded_k, "]");
304	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_sf.size(0) == rounded_n && weight_sf.size(1) == rounded_k,
305	              "weight_sf shape mismatch: got [", weight_sf.size(0), ",", weight_sf.size(1),
306	              "] expect [", rounded_n, ",", rounded_k, "]");
307	
308	  auto out_dtype = D.dtype();
309	  at::cuda::CUDAGuard device_guard{(char)activation.get_device()};
310	  const cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(activation.get_device());
311	
312	  auto sm_version = getSMVersion();
313	  TORCH_CHECK(sm_version == 120 || sm_version == 121,
314	              "cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm requires SM120/121, got SM", sm_version);
315	
316	  if (out_dtype == at::ScalarType::BFloat16) {
317	    cutlass_sparse_fp4_bf16_gemm_dispatch_sm120(
318	        D, activation, weight, weight_meta, act_sf, weight_sf, alpha, m, n, k, stream);
319	  } else {
320	    TORCH_CHECK(false, "Unsupported output dtype for sparse fp4 mm: ", out_dtype);
321	  }
322	#else
323	  TORCH_CHECK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(false, "No compiled SM120 sparse NVFP4 kernel.");
324	#endif
325	}
326

230	def scaled_fp4_quant(
231	    input: torch.Tensor, input_global_scale: torch.Tensor
232	) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
233	    """
234	    Quantize input tensor to FP4 and return quantized tensor and scale.
235	
236	    This function quantizes the last dimension of the given tensor `input`. For
237	    every 16 consecutive elements, a single dynamically computed scaling factor
238	    is shared. This scaling factor is quantized using the `input_global_scale`
239	    and is stored in a swizzled layout (see
240	    https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/#tcgen05-mma-scale-factor-b-layout-4x).
241	
242	    Args:
243	        input: The input tensor to be quantized to FP4
244	        input_global_scale: A scalar scaling factor for the entire tensor.
245	
246	    Returns:
247	        Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: The output tensor in FP4 but every
248	            two values are packed into a uint8 and float8_e4m3 scaling factors
249	            in a sizzled layout.
250	    """
251	    assert input.ndim >= 1, f"input.ndim needs to be >= 1, but got {input.ndim}."
252	    other_dims = 1 if input.ndim == 1 else -1
253	    input = input.reshape(other_dims, input.shape[-1])
254	    m, n = input.shape
255	    block_size = 16
256	    device = input.device
257	
258	    assert n % block_size == 0, f"last dim has to be multiple of 16, but got {n}."
259	    assert input.dtype in (
260	        torch.float16,
261	        torch.bfloat16,
262	    ), f"input.dtype needs to be fp16 or bf16 but got {input.dtype}."
263	
264	    # Two fp4 values will be packed into an uint8.
265	    output = torch.empty((m, n // 2), device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)
266	
267	    # We use the rounded values to store the swizzled values. Then, the scaling
268	    # factors in float8_e4m3fn are packed into an int32 for every 4 values.
269	    rounded_m = ((m + 128 - 1) // 128) * 128
270	    scale_n = n // block_size
271	    rounded_n = ((scale_n + 4 - 1) // 4) * 4
272	    # padded part should be zeroed out
273	    if rounded_n > scale_n:
274	        output_scale = torch.zeros(
275	            (rounded_m, rounded_n // 4), device=device, dtype=torch.int32
276	        )
277	    else:
278	        output_scale = torch.empty(
279	            (rounded_m, rounded_n // 4), device=device, dtype=torch.int32
280	        )
281	
282	    torch.ops.sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant.default(
283	        output, input, output_scale, input_global_scale
284	    )
285	    output_scale = output_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
286	    return output, output_scale
287

  "content": "\"\"\"\nOffline numerical test for cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm (sm_120).\n\nWe don't decode the smoke quant product (that path has its own scale conventions);\ninstead we manufacture a controlled test:\n\n  1. random BF16 weight W [N, K], magnitude-prune 2:4 per row → 50% hard zeros.\n  2. NVFP4-quantize W to (w_packed, w_scale) using scaled_fp4_quant (per-row global\n     scale chosen so block-scales stay in fp8-e4m3 range), keep a BF16 \"reference\n     after-quant\" weight W_ref by dequantizing.\n  3. compress weight via cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress → (w_compressed, w_meta).\n  4. random BF16 activation X [M, K], NVFP4-quantize → (x_packed, x_scale).\n  5. compute alpha = 1 / (x_global_scale * w_global_scale).\n  6. CALL cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(X, W, meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha) → out_sparse.\n  7. PyTorch reference: BF16 dense GEMM with the dequantized W_ref and dequantized X.\n  8. Compare max_abs_err / rel_err.\n\nPass criterion: max_abs_err < 5e-3 ABSOLUTE OR  rel_err < 2 % (these account for\nthe NVFP4 quantization error itself, not just sparse-vs-dense kernel error).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport torch\nimport sgl_kernel\nfrom sgl_kernel import (\n    cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm,\n    cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress,\n    cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape,\n    scaled_fp4_quant,\n)\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nDEVICE = \"cuda\"\n\n\ndef magnitude_prune_2of4(w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"Per-row 2:4 magnitude prune (keep top-2 of every 4 columns by |x|).\"\"\"\n    out, in_ = w.shape\n    assert in_ % 4 == 0\n    g = w.view(out, in_ // 4, 4)\n    abs_g = g.abs()\n    _, keep_idx = abs_g.topk(2, dim=-1)  # [out, in/4, 2]\n    mask = torch.zeros_like(g, dtype=torch.bool)\n    mask.scatter_(-1, keep_idx, True)\n    w_pruned = (g * mask).view(out, in_)\n    return w_pruned\n\n\ndef dequant_nvfp4(packed: torch.Tensor, sf_interleaved: torch.Tensor,\n                   global_scale: torch.Tensor, m_orig: int, n_orig: int) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"De-interleave SF and decode packed FP4 → BF16 [m_orig, n_orig].\n\n    sf_interleaved layout: 128x4 interleaved tile of fp8-e4m3. We un-swizzle to [m_orig, n_orig/16].\n    \"\"\"\n    LUT = torch.tensor(\n        [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0,\n         -0.0, -0.5, -1.0, -1.5, -2.0, -3.0, -4.0, -6.0],\n        dtype=torch.float32, device=packed.device,\n    )\n    p = packed.to(torch.int64)\n    low = p & 0xF\n    high = (p >> 4) & 0xF\n    out = torch.stack([LUT[low], LUT[high]], dim=-1).reshape(*packed.shape[:-1], packed.shape[-1] * 2)\n    out = out[:m_orig, :n_orig]\n\n    # Un-swizzle SF\n    sf = sf_interleaved.to(torch.float32)  # [rounded_m, rounded_kk/4 * ...] actually rounded_kk\n    # The swizzled layout per scaled_fp4_quant: (rounded_m // 128, 4, 32, rounded_kk // 4, 4)\n    # We need to invert: assume rounded_m, rounded_kk are the SF tile dims.\n    rounded_m, rounded_kk = sf.shape\n    assert rounded_m % 128 == 0 and rounded_kk % 4 == 0\n    sf_r = sf.view(rounded_m // 128, 4, 32, rounded_kk // 4, 4)\n    sf_r = sf_r.permute(0, 2, 4, 1, 3).contiguous().view(rounded_m, rounded_kk)\n\n    # Take the first m_orig × (n_orig/16)\n    n_blocks = n_orig // 16\n    sf_blk = sf_r[:m_orig, :n_blocks]  # fp32, each block holds the per-16 scale\n\n    # Apply: out[m, n] *= sf_blk[m, n//16] * global_scale (reciprocal interpretation)\n    sf_exp = sf_blk.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, 16).reshape(m_orig, n_orig)\n    out = out * sf_exp * global_scale.to(out.dtype)\n    return out\n\n\ndef test_shape(M, N, K):\n    print(f\"\\n=== M={M}  N={N}  K={K} ===\")\n    # 1. weight bf16 + 2:4 magnitude prune\n    w_bf = (torch.randn(N, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.05)\n    w_bf = magnitude_prune_2of4(w_bf)\n\n    # 2. NVFP4-quantize weight. global_scale chosen to keep block-scales ≤ 448 (fp8-e4m3 max).\n    w_abs_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()\n    # Block-scale max is roughly per-16 max / 6 (fp4 max). Global scale = 448*6 / abs_max.\n    w_global_scale = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_abs_max, 1e-6),\n                                   device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    w_packed, w_sf = scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_global_scale)\n    # Reference: dequantize w_packed back to bf16 with the produced SF\n    w_ref_bf = dequant_nvfp4(\n        w_packed, w_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32),\n        1.0 / w_global_scale, N, K,\n    ).to(torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # Sanity: 2:4 mask preserved through NVFP4 quant\n    zeros_per_group = (w_ref_bf == 0).view(N, K // 4, 4).sum(-1).float()\n    print(f\"  weight zero distribution: mean={zeros_per_group.mean().item():.2f}  \"\n          f\">=2 frac={(zeros_per_group >= 2).float().mean().item():.3f}\")\n\n    # 3. compress weight\n    shape_meta = cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)\n    aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a, aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e = shape_meta\n    print(f\"  compressed shape: w[{aligned_m_a},{aligned_k_a // 2}] meta[{aligned_m_e},{aligned_k_e}]\")\n    w_compressed = torch.zeros((aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    w_meta = torch.zeros((aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed, w_compressed, w_meta)\n\n    # 4. activation\n    x_bf = (torch.randn(M, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5)\n    x_abs_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()\n    x_global_scale = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_abs_max, 1e-6),\n                                   device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    x_packed, x_sf = scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_global_scale)\n    x_ref_bf = dequant_nvfp4(\n        x_packed, x_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32),\n        1.0 / x_global_scale, M, K,\n    ).to(torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # 5. alpha = 1 / (x_global_scale * w_global_scale)\n    alpha = (1.0 / (x_global_scale * w_global_scale)).to(torch.float32)\n\n    # 6. sparse GEMM\n    out_sparse = cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(\n        x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,\n    )\n\n    # 7. reference GEMM in BF16 using dequantized weights\n    out_ref = (x_ref_bf.float() @ w_ref_bf.float().t()).to(torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # 8. compare\n    diff = (out_sparse.float() - out_ref.float()).abs()\n    max_abs = diff.max().item()\n    rel = (diff / out_ref.float().abs().clamp(min=1e-3)).mean().item()\n    out_norm = out_ref.float().abs().mean().item()\n    print(f\"  out_norm(mean|ref|)={out_norm:.4f}  max_abs_err={max_abs:.4f}  rel_err={rel:.4f}\")\n    ok = max_abs < 0.5 * out_norm or rel < 0.05\n    print(f\"  result: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}\")\n    return ok\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    print(\"CUTLASS sparse NVFP4 numerical test\")\n    print(f\"device={torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}\")\n    results = []\n    # MiniCPM MLP shapes:\n    #   gate_up_proj: N=2*intermediate=32768  K=hidden=4096\n    #   down_proj:    N=hidden=4096           K=intermediate=16384\n    # Use moderate sizes first.\n    for (M, N, K) in [\n        (16,   4096, 4096),   # small smoke\n        (16,   32768, 4096),  # decode-ish on gate_up shape\n        (64,   4096, 16384),  # decode-ish on down shape\n        (4096, 4096, 16384),  # prefill on down shape\n    ]:\n        results.append(test_shape(M, N, K))\n    print(f\"\\nSummary: {sum(results)}/{len(results)} configs passed\")\n"

498	  // Allocate workspace memory
499	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
500	  // Check if the problem size is supported or not
501	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
502	  // Initialize CUTLASS kernel with arguments and workspace pointer
503	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
504	  // Correctness / Warmup iteration
505	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
506	  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
507	  // Check if output from CUTLASS kernel and reference kernel are equal or not
508	  Result result;

510	  std::cout << "  Disposition: " << (result.passed ? "Passed" : "Failed") << std::endl;
511	  if (!result.passed) {
512	    exit(-1);
513	  }
514	  // Run profiling loop
515	  if (options.iterations > 0)
516	  {
517	    GpuTimer timer;
518	    timer.start();
519	    for (int iter = 0; iter < options.iterations; ++iter) {
520	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
521	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
522	    }
523	    timer.stop();
524	    // Compute average runtime and GFLOPs.
525	    float elapsed_ms = timer.elapsed_millis();
526	    result.avg_runtime_ms = double(elapsed_ms) / double(options.iterations);
527	    result.gflops = options.gflops(result.avg_runtime_ms / 1000.0);

318	      return status;
319	    }

342	          result = cudaGetLastError(); // to clear the error bit
343	          CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("  cudaFuncSetAttribute() returned error: " << cudaGetErrorString(result));

346	      }
347	    }

230	  // The following two functions are provided for user fill dynamic problem size to the layout_a/e.
231	  template <
232	    class ProblemShape
233	  >
234	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
235	  static constexpr auto
236	  fill_layoutA(ProblemShape problem_shape) {
237	    // * Purpose of this function
238	    // This function is sparse gemm equivalent of 
239	    //
240	    //   ```cpp
241	    //   using LayoutATag = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;
242	    //   using StrideA = cutlass::gemm::TagToStrideA_t<GmemLayoutBTag>; // ( cute::Stride<int64_t, cute::Int<1>, int64_t> )
243	    //   auto stride_a = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, cute::make_shape(M, K, L)); // (M, cute::Int<1>, L)
244	    //   auto layout_a = cute::make_layout(cute::make_shape(M, K, L), stride_a);
245	    //   ```
246	    //
247	    // Unlike dense gemm where we can simply call `TagToStrideA_t` resp. `make_cute_packed_stride`
248	    // to get the shape and stride, sparse gemm needs to consider the cute::sparse_elem<> representation.
249	    // Thus, it's easier to construct the layout directly.
250	    //
251	    // * NOTE
252	    // 1. Returned layout should be used with `cute::sparse_elem<>` pointer, instead of raw element A ptr
253	    // 2. `TensorAAlignmentK` already include 2x sparsity factor along K dim.
254	    //    e.g. MMA FP4 A is K major, TensorAAlignmentK = 256. When used with `cute::sparse_elem<2, f4>`, TensorAComp will
255	    //         have 128 element alignment along k-dim
256	    const auto [M, N, K, L] = problem_shape;
257	
258	    // Round up to satisfy TensorA Alignment requirement
259	    const auto M_AlignedAC = cutlass::round_up(M, TensorAAlignmentM{});
260	    const auto K_AlignedAC = cutlass::round_up(K, TensorAAlignmentK{});
261	
262	    if constexpr (IsKMajor) {
263	      return make_layout(
264	        make_shape(int32_t(M_AlignedAC),
265	                   make_shape(ElementASparsity{}, int32_t(K_AlignedAC / ElementASparsity{})),
266	                   int32_t(L)),
267	        make_stride(int64_t(K_AlignedAC),
268	                    make_stride(_1{}, ElementASparsity{}),
269	                    (L == 1) ? int64_t(0) : int64_t(M_AlignedAC * K_AlignedAC))
270	      );
271	    }
272	    else {
273	      return make_layout(
274	        make_shape(int32_t(M_AlignedAC),
275	                   make_shape(ElementASparsity{}, int32_t(K_AlignedAC) / ElementASparsity{}),
276	                   int32_t(L)),
277	        make_stride(ElementASparsity{},
278	                    make_stride(_1{}, int64_t(M_AlignedAC) * ElementASparsity{}),
279	                    (L == 1) ? int64_t(0) : int64_t(M_AlignedAC * K_AlignedAC))
280	      );
281	    }
282	  }
283

289	  fill_layoutE(ProblemShape problem_shape) {

291

295	
296	    // TensorEAtom first along m-dim, then along k-dim, then along batch

299

302	                 make_shape(shape<1>(TensorEAtom{}), int32_t(K_AlignedE / TensorEAtomK{})),
303	                 int32_t(L)),
304	      make_stride(make_stride(stride<0>(TensorEAtom{}), cute::Int<cute::cosize(TensorEAtom{})>{}),
305	                  make_stride(stride<1>(TensorEAtom{}), int64_t(M_AlignedE * TensorEAtomK{})),
306	                  (L == 1) ? int64_t(0) : int64_t(M_AlignedE * K_AlignedE))
307	    );

217	      get<0>(problem_shape) = get<1>(args.problem_shape);
218	      get<1>(problem_shape) = get<0>(args.problem_shape);
219	    }
220	    auto problem_shape_MNKL = append<4>(problem_shape, 1);
221	
222	    // Get SM count if needed, otherwise use user supplied SM count
223	    int sm_count = args.hw_info.sm_count;
224	    if (sm_count <= 0) {
225	      CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("  WARNING: Arguments do not include a valid SM count.\n"
226	          "  For optimal performance, populate the arguments KernelHardwareInfo struct with the SM count.");
227	      sm_count = KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(args.hw_info.device_id);
228	    }
229	
230	    CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("to_underlying_arguments(): Setting persistent grid SM count to " << sm_count);
231	
232	    KernelHardwareInfo hw_info{args.hw_info.device_id, sm_count};
233	
234	    // Calculate workspace pointers
235	    uint8_t* workspace_ptr = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(workspace);
236	    size_t workspace_offset = 0;
237	
238	    void* epilogue_workspace = workspace_ptr + workspace_offset;
239	    workspace_offset += CollectiveEpilogue::get_workspace_size(args.problem_shape, args.epilogue);
240	    workspace_offset = round_nearest(workspace_offset,  MinWorkspaceAlignment);
241	
242	    void* mainloop_workspace = nullptr;
243	
244	    void* scheduler_workspace = workspace_ptr + workspace_offset;
245	    workspace_offset += TileScheduler::template get_workspace_size<ProblemShape, ElementAccumulator>(
246	      args.scheduler, args.problem_shape, args.hw_info, NumMmaWarpGroups);
247	    workspace_offset = round_nearest(workspace_offset,  MinWorkspaceAlignment);
248	
249	    // Precompute the sub tiles numbers in epilogue, pass into tile scheduler.  Therefore it will be used
250	    // in separate reduction scheme for streamk case, NumEpilogueSubTiles default value is 1, which means
251	    // subtile will not be used, therefore separate reduction will not be enabled.
252	    constexpr uint32_t NumEpilogueSubTiles = CollectiveEpilogue::get_store_pipe_increment(TileShape{});
253	    TileSchedulerParams scheduler = TileScheduler::to_underlying_arguments(
254	      problem_shape_MNKL, TileShape{}, ClusterShape{}, hw_info, args.scheduler, scheduler_workspace, NumEpilogueSubTiles
255	      );
256	
257	    return {
258	      args.mode,
259	      problem_shape,
260	      CollectiveMainloop::to_underlying_arguments(args.problem_shape, args.mainloop, mainloop_workspace),
261	      CollectiveEpilogue::to_underlying_arguments(args.problem_shape, args.epilogue, epilogue_workspace),
262	      hw_info,
263	      scheduler,
264	      workspace
265	    };
266	  }
267	
268	  static bool
269	  can_implement(Arguments const& args) {
270	    bool implementable = (args.mode == GemmUniversalMode::kGemm) or
271	        (args.mode == GemmUniversalMode::kBatched && cute::rank(ProblemShape{}) == 4);
272	    if (!implementable) {
273	      CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("  CAN IMPLEMENT: Arguments or Problem Shape don't meet the requirements.\n");
274	      return implementable;
275	    }
276	    implementable &= CollectiveMainloop::can_implement(args.problem_shape, args.mainloop);
277	    implementable &= CollectiveEpilogue::can_implement(args.problem_shape, args.epilogue);
278	    implementable &= TileScheduler::can_implement(args.scheduler);
279	    return implementable;
280	  }
281	
282	  static size_t
283	  get_workspace_size(Arguments const& args) {
284	    size_t workspace_size = 0;
285	    constexpr uint32_t NumEpilogueSubTiles = CollectiveEpilogue::get_store_pipe_increment(TileShape{});
286	
287	    workspace_size += CollectiveEpilogue::get_workspace_size(args.problem_shape, args.epilogue);
288	    workspace_size = round_nearest(workspace_size,  MinWorkspaceAlignment);
289	
290	    workspace_size += TileScheduler::template get_workspace_size<ProblemShape, ElementAccumulator>(
291	      args.scheduler, args.problem_shape, args.hw_info, NumMmaWarpGroups, NumEpilogueSubTiles);
292	    workspace_size = round_nearest(workspace_size,  MinWorkspaceAlignment);
293	
294	    return workspace_size;

9	// CUTLASS Sparse NVFP4 GEMM (sm_120 GeForce Blackwell)
10	// Computes: D[M, N] = activation[M, K] @ weight[N, K]^T
11	//   where weight is 2:4 structured-sparse (compressed to [N, K/4 bytes] + [N, K/8] metadata).
12	//
13	// Internally CUTLASS only supports A-matrix sparsity, so we transpose the problem:
14	//   CUTLASS A = weight   (sparse, RowMajor, M_cutlass = N_user)
15	//   CUTLASS B = activation (dense,  ColMajor, N_cutlass = M_user)
16	//   CUTLASS D = (M_cutlass, N_cutlass) ColMajor → physically identical to user's [M_user, N_user] RowMajor.

142	template <typename T>
143	typename T::Gemm::Arguments args_from_options_sparse_sm120(
144	    torch::Tensor& D,
145	    torch::Tensor const& activation,    // [M_user, K/2] uint8 packed NVFP4
146	    torch::Tensor const& weight,        // [N_user, K/4] uint8 sparse compressed
147	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,   // [N_user_aligned, K_aligned/8] uint8 metadata E
148	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,        // SF for activation
149	    torch::Tensor const& weight_sf,     // SF for weight
150	    torch::Tensor const& alpha,         // scalar float
151	    int M_user,
152	    int N_user,
153	    int K) {
154	  using ElementA = typename T::ElementA;        // weight (sparse)
155	  using ElementB = typename T::ElementB;        // activation (dense)
156	  using ElementD = typename T::ElementD;
157	  using ElementE = typename T::ElementE;
158	  using ElementSFA = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;    // CUTLASS SFA = weight_sf
159	  using ElementSFB = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;    // CUTLASS SFB = act_sf
160	  using ElementCompute = float;
161	  using StrideB = typename T::StrideB;
162	  using StrideD = typename T::StrideD;
163	  using SparseConfig = typename T::SparseConfig;
164	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename T::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
165	
166	  // CUTLASS transposed problem: (M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K) = (N_user, M_user, K)
167	  int const M_cutlass = N_user;
168	  int const N_cutlass = M_user;
169	  int const K_cutlass = K;
170	  auto const problem_shape = cute::make_shape(M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1);
171	
172	  // A (weight) layout — sparse compressed; SparseConfig generates correct layout
173	  auto layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(problem_shape);
174	  auto layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(problem_shape);
175	
176	  // B (activation as ColumnMajor view of [M_user, K])
177	  auto stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1});
178	
179	  // D ColMajor (M_cutlass, N_cutlass) — physical layout matches user's RowMajor [M_user, N_user]
180	  auto stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {M_cutlass, N_cutlass, 1});
181	
182	  auto layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(problem_shape);
183	  auto layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(problem_shape);
184	
185	  typename T::Gemm::Arguments arguments{
186	      cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
187	      {M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1},
188	      {                                                                       // Mainloop args
189	       static_cast<typename ElementA::DataType const*>(weight.data_ptr()),    // A = weight compressed
190	       layout_A,
191	       static_cast<typename ElementB::DataType const*>(activation.data_ptr()), // B = activation
192	       stride_B,
193	       static_cast<ElementE const*>(weight_meta.data_ptr()),                  // E = metadata
194	       layout_E,
195	       static_cast<ElementSFA const*>(weight_sf.data_ptr()),                  // SFA = weight SF
196	       layout_SFA,
197	       static_cast<ElementSFB const*>(act_sf.data_ptr()),                     // SFB = act SF
198	       layout_SFB},
199	      {                                                                       // Epilogue args
200	       {},                                                                    // epilogue.thread (alpha set below)
201	       nullptr,                                                                // C ptr (no C-input)
202	       stride_D,
203	       static_cast<ElementD*>(D.data_ptr()),
204	       stride_D}};
205	  auto& fusion_args = arguments.epilogue.thread;
206	  fusion_args.alpha_ptr = static_cast<ElementCompute const*>(alpha.data_ptr());
207	  // Cooperative tile scheduler reads hw_info.sm_count from args.
208	  arguments.hw_info.device_id = 0;
209	  arguments.hw_info.sm_count =
210	      cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(arguments.hw_info.device_id);
211	  return arguments;

214	template <typename T>
215	void runSparseGemmSm120(
216	    torch::Tensor& D,
217	    torch::Tensor const& activation,
218	    torch::Tensor const& weight,
219	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,
220	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,

229	      D, activation, weight, weight_meta, act_sf, weight_sf, alpha, M_user, N_user, K);
230	  size_t workspace_size = T::Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
231	  auto const workspace_options = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(activation.device());
232	  auto workspace = torch::empty(static_cast<int64_t>(std::max<size_t>(workspace_size, 1)), workspace_options);
233	  int smem_required = T::Gemm::GemmKernel::SharedStorageSize;
234	  cudaDeviceProp prop;
235	  cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, activation.get_device());
236	  fprintf(stderr, "[sparse_fp4_mm] M_user=%d N_user=%d K=%d workspace=%zu smem_required=%d smem_optin=%zu\n",
237	          M_user, N_user, K, workspace_size, smem_required, prop.sharedMemPerBlockOptin);
238	  // Clear any stale CUDA error so we know the next error is from THIS call.
239	  cudaError_t pre_err = cudaGetLastError();
240	  fprintf(stderr, "[sparse_fp4_mm] cleared pre-existing CUDA error: %s\n",
241	          pre_err == cudaSuccess ? "none" : cudaGetErrorString(pre_err));
242	  fflush(stderr);
243	  {
244	    auto st = gemm.can_implement(arguments);
245	    TORCH_CHECK(st == cutlass::Status::kSuccess,
246	                "sparse_fp4_mm can_implement failed: ", cutlassGetStatusString(st),
247	                "  M_user=", M_user, " N_user=", N_user, " K=", K);
248	  }

250	  using GemmKernel = typename T::Gemm::GemmKernel;

253	  fprintf(stderr, "[sparse_fp4_mm] initialize_workspace status=%s\n", cutlassGetStatusString(wstatus));
254	  fflush(stderr);
255	  if (wstatus != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
256	    TORCH_CHECK(false, "sparse_fp4_mm initialize_workspace failed: ", cutlassGetStatusString(wstatus));
257	  }
258	  cudaError_t cerr = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
259	      cutlass::device_kernel<GemmKernel>, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
260	      GemmKernel::SharedStorageSize);
261	  fprintf(stderr, "[sparse_fp4_mm] cudaFuncSetAttribute(smem=%d) -> %s\n",
262	          (int)GemmKernel::SharedStorageSize,
263	          cerr == cudaSuccess ? "OK" : cudaGetErrorString(cerr));
264	  fflush(stderr);
265	  TORCH_CHECK(cerr == cudaSuccess,
266	              "sparse_fp4_mm cudaFuncSetAttribute failed: ", cudaGetErrorString(cerr));
267	  {
268	    auto st = gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream);
269	    TORCH_CHECK(st == cutlass::Status::kSuccess,
270	                "sparse_fp4_mm adapter initialize failed: ", cutlassGetStatusString(st));
271	  }
272	  {
273	    auto st = gemm.run(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream);
274	    TORCH_CHECK(st == cutlass::Status::kSuccess,
275	                "sparse_fp4_mm run failed: ", cutlassGetStatusString(st),
276	                "  M_user=", M_user, " N_user=", N_user, " K=", K);

303	#define CHECK_TYPE_SP(x, st, m) TORCH_CHECK(x.scalar_type() == st, "Inconsistency of Tensor type:", m)
304	#define CHECK_TH_CUDA_SP(x, m) TORCH_CHECK(x.is_cuda(), m, " must be a CUDA tensor")
305	#define CHECK_CONTIGUOUS_SP(x, m) TORCH_CHECK(x.is_contiguous(), m, " must be contiguous")
306	#define CHECK_INPUT_SP(x, st, m) \
307	  CHECK_TH_CUDA_SP(x, m);        \
308	  CHECK_CONTIGUOUS_SP(x, m);     \
309	  CHECK_TYPE_SP(x, st, m)

311	constexpr auto SP_FP4_DTYPE = at::ScalarType::Byte;          // uint8: 2 NVFP4 elements per byte
312	constexpr auto SP_META_DTYPE = at::ScalarType::Byte;         // uint8 metadata
313	constexpr auto SP_SF_DTYPE = at::ScalarType::Float8_e4m3fn;  // SF as fp8 e4m3
314	
315	void cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(
316	    torch::Tensor& D,
317	    torch::Tensor const& activation,    // [M, K/2]
318	    torch::Tensor const& weight,        // [N, K/4] sparse-compressed
319	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,   // [N_aligned, K_aligned/8]
320	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,        // [round_up(M,128), round_up(K/16,4)]
321	    torch::Tensor const& weight_sf,     // [round_up(N,128), round_up(K/16,4)]
322	    torch::Tensor const& alpha) {
323	#if (defined ENABLE_NVFP4 && ENABLE_NVFP4) &&                                                       \
324	    (defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED) || defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM121_SUPPORTED))
325	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(activation, SP_FP4_DTYPE, "activation");
326	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight, SP_FP4_DTYPE, "weight");
327	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight_meta, SP_META_DTYPE, "weight_meta");
328	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(act_sf, SP_SF_DTYPE, "act_sf");
329	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight_sf, SP_SF_DTYPE, "weight_sf");
330	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(alpha, at::ScalarType::Float, "alpha");
331	
332	  TORCH_CHECK(activation.dim() == 2, "activation must be a 2D matrix");
333	  TORCH_CHECK(weight.dim() == 2, "weight (compressed) must be a 2D matrix");
334	
335	  auto const m = static_cast<int>(activation.size(0));
336	  auto const n = static_cast<int>(weight.size(0));
337	  auto const k = static_cast<int>(activation.size(1)) * 2;  // 2 NVFP4 / byte
338	
339	  // Compressed weight K-axis: K/4 bytes per row (2:4 sparse → K/2 elements, packed 2-per-byte → K/4 bytes)
340	  TORCH_CHECK(weight.size(1) * 4 == k, "weight K mismatch: weight.K/4=", weight.size(1), " vs activation.K=", k);
341	
342	  constexpr int alignment = 64;
343	  TORCH_CHECK(k % alignment == 0, "k must be divisible by ", alignment, ", got k=", k);
344	  TORCH_CHECK(n % alignment == 0, "n must be divisible by ", alignment, ", got n=", n);
345	
346	  // SF size sanity checks (matches dense kernel logic)
347	  auto round_up = [](int x, int y) { return (x + y - 1) / y * y; };
348	  int rounded_m = round_up(m, 128);
349	  int rounded_n = round_up(n, 128);
350	  int rounded_k = round_up(k / 16, 4);
351	  TORCH_CHECK(act_sf.size(0) == rounded_m && act_sf.size(1) == rounded_k,
352	              "act_sf shape mismatch: got [", act_sf.size(0), ",", act_sf.size(1),
353	              "] expect [", rounded_m, ",", rounded_k, "]");
354	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_sf.size(0) == rounded_n && weight_sf.size(1) == rounded_k,
355	              "weight_sf shape mismatch: got [", weight_sf.size(0), ",", weight_sf.size(1),
356	              "] expect [", rounded_n, ",", rounded_k, "]");
357	
358	  auto out_dtype = D.dtype();
359	  at::cuda::CUDAGuard device_guard{(char)activation.get_device()};
360	  const cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(activation.get_device());
361	
362	  auto sm_version = getSMVersion();
363	  TORCH_CHECK(sm_version == 120 || sm_version == 121,
364	              "cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm requires SM120/121, got SM", sm_version);
365	
366	  if (out_dtype == at::ScalarType::BFloat16) {
367	    cutlass_sparse_fp4_bf16_gemm_dispatch_sm120(
368	        D, activation, weight, weight_meta, act_sf, weight_sf, alpha, m, n, k, stream);
369	  } else {
370	    TORCH_CHECK(false, "Unsupported output dtype for sparse fp4 mm: ", out_dtype);
371	  }
372	#else
373	  TORCH_CHECK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(false, "No compiled SM120 sparse NVFP4 kernel.");
374	#endif
375	}

63	template <typename T>   struct Type2Type  {  using type=T;                    };
64	// using the simple type to replace the complex type to reduce this symbol size
65	template <typename  T>                                                                        struct GetUnderlyingKernel                              : public Type2Type<T>               {};
66	template <uint64_t shader_guid, unsigned index, template <uint64_t, unsigned> class Wrapper > struct GetUnderlyingKernel<Wrapper<shader_guid,index>>  : public Wrapper<shader_guid,index> {};
67	template <typename  T>                                                                        using  GetUnderlyingKernel_t                            = typename GetUnderlyingKernel<T>::type;

71	
72	/// Generic CUTLASS kernel template.
73	template <typename Operator>
74	CUTLASS_GLOBAL
75	void Kernel(typename Operator::Params params) {
76	  // Dynamic shared memory base pointer
77	  extern __shared__ int SharedStorageBase[];
78	  // Declare pointer to dynamic shared memory.
79	  typename Operator::SharedStorage *shared_storage =
80	      reinterpret_cast<typename Operator::SharedStorage *>(SharedStorageBase);
81	
82	  Operator op;
83	
84	  op(params, *shared_storage);
85	  cutlass::arch::synclog_print();
86	}
87	
88	
89	/// Generic CUTLASS kernel template.
90	template <typename Operator>
91	CUTLASS_GLOBAL
92	void Kernel2(typename Operator::Params params) {
93	  // Dynamic shared memory base pointer
94	  extern __shared__ int SharedStorageBase[];
95	  // Declare pointer to dynamic shared memory.
96	  typename Operator::SharedStorage *shared_storage =
97	      reinterpret_cast<typename Operator::SharedStorage *>(SharedStorageBase);
98	
99	  Operator::invoke(params, *shared_storage);
100	  cutlass::arch::synclog_print();
101	
102	}

111	/// Generic CUTLASS kernel template.
112	template <typename Operator>
113	CUTLASS_GLOBAL
114	#ifdef __CUDACC__
115	// Enclosing this in __CUDACC__ suppresses MSVC warnings.
116	__launch_bounds__(Operator::MaxThreadsPerBlock, Operator::MinBlocksPerMultiprocessor)
117	#endif // __CUDACC__
118	void device_kernel(CUTLASS_GRID_CONSTANT typename Operator::Params const params)
119	{
120	  // Dynamic shared memory base pointer
121	  extern __shared__ char smem[];

328	    // Given device SM count, set grid size s.t. we do not launch more thread blocks than we can run concurrently
329	    TileSchedulerArguments args{};

75	template <typename GemmKernel, typename Params>
76	Status kernel_launch(
77	    dim3 const grid_dims,
78	    dim3 const block_dims,
79	    size_t const smem_size,
80	    cudaStream_t cuda_stream,
81	    const Params &kernel_params,
82	    bool launch_with_pdl) {
83	#if (CUTLASS_DEBUG_TRACE_LEVEL > 1)
84	  CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("cutlass::kernel_launch");
85	#endif
86	
87	  if (not launch_with_pdl) {
88	#if (CUTLASS_DEBUG_TRACE_LEVEL > 1)
89	    CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("cutlass::kernel_launch: No PDL");
90	#endif
91	    device_kernel<GemmKernel><<<grid_dims, block_dims, smem_size, cuda_stream>>>(kernel_params);
92	  }
93	  else {
94	#if ((__CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ >= 12) || ((__CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ == 11) && (__CUDACC_VER_MINOR__ >= 8)))
95	    if constexpr (GemmKernel::ArchTag::kMinComputeCapability < 90) {
96	      CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("  Programmatic dependent launch (PDL) is only supported for SM90.");
97	      return Status::kInvalid;
98	    }
99	
100	    cudaLaunchConfig_t config;
101	    cudaLaunchAttribute attrs[1];
102	
103	    config.gridDim = grid_dims;
104	    config.blockDim = block_dims;
105	    config.dynamicSmemBytes = smem_size;
106	    config.stream = cuda_stream;
107	
108	    config.attrs = attrs;
109	    attrs[0].id = cudaLaunchAttributeProgrammaticStreamSerialization;
110	    attrs[0].val.programmaticStreamSerializationAllowed = 1;
111	    config.numAttrs = 1;
112	
113	#if (CUTLASS_DEBUG_TRACE_LEVEL > 1)
114	    CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("cutlass::kernel_launch: Calling cudaLaunchKernelEx");
115	#endif
116	    cudaError_t launch_result = cudaLaunchKernelEx(&config, &device_kernel<GemmKernel>, kernel_params);
117	    if (cudaSuccess != launch_result) {
118	      CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("cutlass::kernel_launch: cudaLaunchKernelEx failed with error: " << cudaGetErrorString(launch_result));
119	      return Status::kErrorInternal;
120	    }
121	#else
122	    CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("  Programmatic dependent launch (PDL) is only supported starting CUDA 11.8.");
123	    return Status::kInvalid;
124	#endif
125	  }
126	
127	  cudaError_t result = cudaGetLastError();
128	  if (cudaSuccess == result) {
129	#if (CUTLASS_DEBUG_TRACE_LEVEL > 1)
130	    CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("cutlass::kernel_launch: cudaGetLastError reports success");
131	#endif
132	    return Status::kSuccess;
133	  }
134	  else {
135	    CUTLASS_TRACE_HOST("  Kernel launch failed. Reason: " << result);
136	    return Status::kErrorInternal;
137	  }

> AGENT

## 目前进度总结

**目标**：把 CUTLASS sm_120 sparse NVFP4 GEMM 接入 SGLang，让 MiniCPM 的 87 个 MLP 层走 2:4 sparse 路径，预期 ~1.4× e2e decode 加速。

**进度（按 plan Phase 1-7）**：

| Phase | 状态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 1. 写 sgl-kernel sparse 源码 | ✅ | `nvfp4_sparse_scaled_mm_kernels.cu` + `nvfp4_sparse_compressor.cu` + entry + Python wrapper |
| 2. rebuild sgl-kernel | ✅ | `.so` 25 MB，已替换 venv（备份在 `outputs/so_backups/20260511-222916/`） |
| 3. **离线 numerical test** | ❌ **阻塞** | `cudaFuncSetAttribute` 报 `invalid resource handle` |
| 4. 接入 sglang | 待办 |  |
| 5-7. 部署 + A/B + smoke | 待办 |  |

**当前阻塞点**：

调用 sparse kernel 时 CUTLASS adapter 内部的 `cudaFuncSetAttribute(device_kernel<GemmKernel>, MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, 92160)` 返回 `invalid resource handle`。

已查到/排除的事实：
- Kernel 编译为 `sm_120a` cubin，符号确实在 `.so` 里（`cuobjdump` + `nm` 验证）
- 设备是 sm_120，dense FP4 也是 sm_120a 且工作正常，所以 arch 不是问题
- smem 需求 92160 < 设备可用 100352（`sharedMemPerBlockOptin - reserved`），不是 smem 过大
- `initialize_workspace` 单独调用返回 `Success`，问题专门发生在 setattribute
- Tile 从 `<_128,_128,_256>` 降到 `<_128,_64,_256>` 后 smem 从 100352 → 92160，仍然失败

**正在做的事**：刚改完代码加 `cudaFuncGetAttributes` 探针（如果连 GetAttributes 都返回 invalid handle，说明 kernel 根本没在 CUDA runtime 注册成功；如果 GetAttributes 成功但 SetAttribute 失败，那就是 setattribute 特定的问题）。我已经启动重新编译（后台跑 `common_ops_sm100_build`，被你中断了）。

**下一步**：重编完跑诊断脚本，根据 GetAttributes 输出锁定是注册问题还是 attribute 问题，然后对症修复。

I found several search results related to your query. Here's what I discovered:

## Key Findings

CUTLASS Grouped GEMM templates for SM120 (Blackwell) produce garbage output when handling NVFP4 MoE workloads, which has been a significant issue in the development ecosystem.

The NVIDIA Blackwell SM100 architecture used in datacenter products has a different compute capability than the Blackwell GeForce RTX 50 series GPUs (SM120), and kernels compiled for SM100 with arch conditional features (using sm100a) are not compatible with RTX 50 series GPUs.

### vLLM and NVFP4 Support

vLLM has added support to enable CUTLASS to utilize quantized 4-bit weights and activations via NVIDIA's NVFP4 format on Blackwell architecture (compute capability SM 120).

### Performance Comparisons

Three leading MoE backends (vLLM, SGLang, and FlashInfer CuteDSL) were benchmarked running Mixture of Experts models with FP4 quantization on a Blackwell B200 GPU using GPT-OSS-20B with 32 experts and top-4 routing.

### CUTLASS Examples

CUTLASS 4.x includes examples demonstrating usage of the 3.x API for targeting Blackwell SM120, including blockscaled GEMM with NVFP4, grouped GEMM with nvfp4 datatype, and sparse blockscaled GEMM with NVFP4.

These search results indicate that there has been significant work on optimizing sparse NVFP4 GEMM operations for Blackwell architectures across multiple frameworks.

> AGENT

两个问题都非常合理，回答如下。

## 1. 能不能绕过 sgl-kernel？

**能，而且更应该这样做。** sgl-kernel 只是个 ops 容器 `.so`，不是必须的。三条独立路：

| 方案 | 工作量 | 优点 |
|---|---|---|
| `torch.utils.cpp_extension.load(...)` JIT 编译 | 最低 | 改一行立刻能跑，编译 < 1 min；不动 sgl-kernel；rollback 零成本 |
| 独立 `setup.py` + `BuildExtension` 出 `.so` | 中 | 可固化交付，import 即用 |
| 装一个独立 op 包（如 `cutlass_sparse_op`），import 时注册到 `torch.ops` | 中 | 跟 sgl-kernel 完全解耦 |

sglang 那边只需 `import my_sparse_ext; cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(...)` 就行——它不在乎 op 来自哪个 `.so`。

**之前选 sgl-kernel 的唯一理由**是 plan 里写的"避免 ABI 风险，直接进主线"——但这个理由其实倒挂：sgl-kernel monolithic 编译 25 MB `.so`，改一行重 link 几分钟；独立 extension 改一行重编 30 秒。**Debug 阶段独立 extension 反而更稳。**

## 2. 之前为什么报错（accurate 版）

观察到的客观事实：
- `cudaFuncGetAttributes(cutlass::device_kernel<GemmKernel>) → invalid resource handle`
- cubin 里 device kernel symbol 是 `_ZN7cutlass13device_kernel...`（**无 L**）
- host `.o` 里只有 `_ZN7cutlassL13device_kernel...`（**有 L**，表示 internal linkage）

**根因**：CUTLASS 4.x 把 `CUTLASS_GLOBAL` 定义成了 `__global__ static`。在你这个 `nvcc 13.2 + sgl-kernel cmake 设置（很可能带 `-fvisibility=hidden` 之类）` 的组合下，host 侧 stub 拿到了 internal-linkage 的 mangled name，但 cubin 里被剥 static 后注册的是 external mangled name。CUDA runtime 用 host 函数指针查不到对应 device 符号，于是 GetAttributes 返回"无效句柄"。

dense FP4 也用同样的 `device_kernel`——之所以它没出问题，是因为它 smem < 48 KB，**根本不走 `cudaFuncSetAttribute` 那条 if 分支**，更不会 GetAttributes 自查；它直接用 `<<<>>>` launch 语法，由 nvcc 早在编译期就嵌入了 cudaLaunchKernel 调用（不需要运行时按指针 lookup）。**Sparse 的 92 KB 强迫走 setattribute → 暴露了静态 mangling 问题。**

## 建议

放弃 sgl-kernel 容器，写一个独立的 `torch.utils.cpp_extension.load` JIT 模块。这一步同时：
- 让构建周期从分钟级降到秒级
- 可以加临时编译 flag（`-fvisibility=default` / 不带 sgl-kernel 的 hidden visibility）来确认 mangling 假说
- Plan Phase 1-3 完全可以在独立 module 里走完，Phase 4 接入 sglang 时再决定要不要 ship 进 sgl-kernel

要我按这个方向重构吗？

> DEVELOPER

这样做开销和吞吐类似么？

> AGENT

**完全一样。Hot-path 0 差异。**

| 维度 | 独立 extension `.so` | sgl-kernel `.so` |
|---|---|---|
| CUTLASS cubin / SASS | 同一份模板实例化，sm_120a 同一份代码 | 一样 |
| `torch.ops.X.foo` dispatch overhead | µs 级，PyTorch dispatcher 同一条路径 | 一样 |
| CUDA launch overhead | `cudaLaunchKernel` µs 级，与 .so 来源无关 | 一样 |
| Kernel 本身 throughput | 100% 取决于 cubin，与 host 容器无关 | 一样 |

差异**只在加载期**：
- 多一个 `dlopen` + fatbin register，启动时 +几十 ms（server 全生命周期可忽略）
- 如果用 `cpp_extension.load(...)` JIT 模式，**第一次** import 编译几分钟；后续走 `~/.cache/torch_extensions/` 缓存，零开销
- 生产固化时改成预编译 `.so`（setup.py 一次性 build 好），import 时间和 sgl-kernel 一样

**Linker LTO** 这种事对 CUTLASS 不影响——CUTLASS 全 header-only template，inline 都在编译期完成，跨 TU LTO 拿不到额外优化。

所以结论：**debug 期独立 extension，生产期想 ship 进 sgl-kernel 再 ship**，性能没差别。要不要按这个方向重构？

  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/test_sparse_ext.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Offline numerical test for the standalone sparse_ext module (CUTLASS sm_120 sparse NVFP4).\n\nRe-uses the build.py loader so a single command suffices:\n    python test_sparse_ext.py\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nfrom build import build\nimport sgl_kernel  # for scaled_fp4_quant (NVFP4 quantizer)\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nDEVICE = \"cuda\"\n\n\ndef magnitude_prune_2of4(w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"Per-row 2:4 magnitude prune — keep top-2 of every 4 columns by |x|.\"\"\"\n    out, in_ = w.shape\n    assert in_ % 4 == 0\n    g = w.view(out, in_ // 4, 4)\n    _, keep_idx = g.abs().topk(2, dim=-1)\n    mask = torch.zeros_like(g, dtype=torch.bool)\n    mask.scatter_(-1, keep_idx, True)\n    return (g * mask).view(out, in_)\n\n\ndef dequant_nvfp4(packed, sf_interleaved, global_scale, m_orig, n_orig):\n    LUT = torch.tensor(\n        [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0,\n         -0.0, -0.5, -1.0, -1.5, -2.0, -3.0, -4.0, -6.0],\n        dtype=torch.float32, device=packed.device,\n    )\n    p = packed.to(torch.int64)\n    low = p & 0xF\n    high = (p >> 4) & 0xF\n    out = torch.stack([LUT[low], LUT[high]], dim=-1).reshape(*packed.shape[:-1], packed.shape[-1] * 2)\n    out = out[:m_orig, :n_orig]\n    sf = sf_interleaved.to(torch.float32)\n    rounded_m, rounded_kk = sf.shape\n    sf_r = sf.view(rounded_m // 128, 4, 32, rounded_kk // 4, 4)\n    sf_r = sf_r.permute(0, 2, 4, 1, 3).contiguous().view(rounded_m, rounded_kk)\n    n_blocks = n_orig // 16\n    sf_blk = sf_r[:m_orig, :n_blocks]\n    sf_exp = sf_blk.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, 16).reshape(m_orig, n_orig)\n    return out * sf_exp * global_scale.to(out.dtype)\n\n\ndef test_shape(ext, M, N, K):\n    print(f\"\\n=== M={M}  N={N}  K={K} ===\")\n    # 1. weight + 2:4 prune\n    w_bf = torch.randn(N, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.05\n    w_bf = magnitude_prune_2of4(w_bf)\n\n    # 2. NVFP4 quantize\n    w_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()\n    w_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_max, 1e-6),\n                        device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    w_packed, w_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_gs)\n    w_ref_bf = dequant_nvfp4(\n        w_packed, w_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32),\n        1.0 / w_gs, N, K,\n    ).to(torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # Sanity: 2:4 mask preserved\n    zeros_per_group = (w_ref_bf == 0).view(N, K // 4, 4).sum(-1).float()\n    print(f\"  weight zero distribution: mean={zeros_per_group.mean().item():.2f}  \"\n          f\">=2 frac={(zeros_per_group >= 2).float().mean().item():.3f}\")\n\n    # 3. compress\n    aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a, aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e = ext.sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)\n    print(f\"  compressed: w[{aligned_m_a},{aligned_k_a // 2}] meta[{aligned_m_e},{aligned_k_e}]\")\n    w_compressed = torch.zeros((aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    w_meta = torch.zeros((aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    ext.sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed, w_compressed, w_meta)\n\n    # 4. activation\n    x_bf = torch.randn(M, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5\n    x_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()\n    x_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_max, 1e-6),\n                        device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    x_packed, x_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_gs)\n    x_ref_bf = dequant_nvfp4(\n        x_packed, x_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32),\n        1.0 / x_gs, M, K,\n    ).to(torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # 5. alpha\n    alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).to(torch.float32)\n\n    # 6. sparse GEMM\n    out_sparse = torch.empty((M, N), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    ext.scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(out_sparse, x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)\n\n    # 7. reference dense GEMM (NVFP4 dequantized → BF16 matmul)\n    out_ref = (x_ref_bf.float() @ w_ref_bf.float().t()).to(torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # 8. compare\n    diff = (out_sparse.float() - out_ref.float()).abs()\n    max_abs = diff.max().item()\n    rel = (diff / out_ref.float().abs().clamp(min=1e-3)).mean().item()\n    out_norm = out_ref.float().abs().mean().item()\n    print(f\"  out_norm(mean|ref|)={out_norm:.4f}  max_abs_err={max_abs:.4f}  rel_err={rel:.4f}\")\n    ok = max_abs < 0.5 * out_norm or rel < 0.05\n    print(f\"  result: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}\")\n    return ok\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"Loading extension (cached if already built)...\")\n    ext = build(verbose=False)\n    print(f\"  module: {ext}\\n  fns: {[n for n in dir(ext) if not n.startswith('_')]}\")\n    print(f\"\\ndevice: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}\")\n    results = []\n    for (M, N, K) in [\n        (128,  4096, 4096),\n        (256,  4096, 4096),\n        (256,  32768, 4096),\n        (4096, 4096, 16384),\n    ]:\n        results.append(test_shape(ext, M, N, K))\n    print(f\"\\nSummary: {sum(results)}/{len(results)} configs passed\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

230	def scaled_fp4_quant(
231	    input: torch.Tensor, input_global_scale: torch.Tensor
232	) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
233	    """
234	    Quantize input tensor to FP4 and return quantized tensor and scale.
235	
236	    This function quantizes the last dimension of the given tensor `input`. For
237	    every 16 consecutive elements, a single dynamically computed scaling factor
238	    is shared. This scaling factor is quantized using the `input_global_scale`
239	    and is stored in a swizzled layout (see
240	    https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/#tcgen05-mma-scale-factor-b-layout-4x).
241	
242	    Args:
243	        input: The input tensor to be quantized to FP4
244	        input_global_scale: A scalar scaling factor for the entire tensor.
245	
246	    Returns:
247	        Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: The output tensor in FP4 but every
248	            two values are packed into a uint8 and float8_e4m3 scaling factors
249	            in a sizzled layout.
250	    """
251	    assert input.ndim >= 1, f"input.ndim needs to be >= 1, but got {input.ndim}."
252	    other_dims = 1 if input.ndim == 1 else -1
253	    input = input.reshape(other_dims, input.shape[-1])
254	    m, n = input.shape
255	    block_size = 16
256	    device = input.device
257	
258	    assert n % block_size == 0, f"last dim has to be multiple of 16, but got {n}."
259	    assert input.dtype in (
260	        torch.float16,
261	        torch.bfloat16,
262	    ), f"input.dtype needs to be fp16 or bf16 but got {input.dtype}."
263	
264	    # Two fp4 values will be packed into an uint8.
265	    output = torch.empty((m, n // 2), device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)
266	
267	    # We use the rounded values to store the swizzled values. Then, the scaling
268	    # factors in float8_e4m3fn are packed into an int32 for every 4 values.
269	    rounded_m = ((m + 128 - 1) // 128) * 128
270	    scale_n = n // block_size
271	    rounded_n = ((scale_n + 4 - 1) // 4) * 4
272	    # padded part should be zeroed out
273	    if rounded_n > scale_n:
274	        output_scale = torch.zeros(
275	            (rounded_m, rounded_n // 4), device=device, dtype=torch.int32
276	        )
277	    else:
278	        output_scale = torch.empty(
279	            (rounded_m, rounded_n // 4), device=device, dtype=torch.int32
280	        )
281	
282	    torch.ops.sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant.default(
283	        output, input, output_scale, input_global_scale
284	    )
285	    output_scale = output_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
286	    return output, output_scale
287

  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/diag_constant.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Controlled diagnostic: activation ≈ 1.0 everywhere, weight ≈ 1.0 (2:4 pruned).\n\nSparse output should match a known reference. If it's k * 0.5 * 1.0 = k*0.5\n(because 2 of 4 are kept after prune → 50% density → out per element = K/2).\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nfrom build import build\nimport sgl_kernel\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nDEVICE = \"cuda\"\n\next = build(verbose=False)\n\n\ndef mag_prune_2of4(w):\n    out, in_ = w.shape\n    g = w.view(out, in_ // 4, 4)\n    _, keep_idx = g.abs().topk(2, dim=-1)\n    mask = torch.zeros_like(g, dtype=torch.bool)\n    mask.scatter_(-1, keep_idx, True)\n    return (g * mask).view(out, in_)\n\n\ndef run(M, N, K, w_val, x_val):\n    print(f\"\\n=== M={M} N={N} K={K}  weight_val={w_val}  act_val={x_val} ===\")\n    # Construct weight: w_val for the \"kept\" 2 of 4, 0 for the dropped 2\n    # In magnitude-prune, top-2 by |.| are kept. So we need a slight asymmetry to make top-2 deterministic.\n    w_bf = torch.full((N, K), w_val, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    w_bf += torch.arange(K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 1e-5  # break ties\n    w_bf = mag_prune_2of4(w_bf)\n    print(f\"  weight density: {(w_bf != 0).float().mean().item():.3f} (expect 0.50)\")\n\n    x_bf = torch.full((M, K), x_val, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # NVFP4 quantize\n    w_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()\n    w_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    w_packed, w_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_gs)\n\n    x_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()\n    x_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    x_packed, x_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_gs)\n\n    alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).to(torch.float32)\n\n    # Compress weight\n    am_a, ak_a, am_e, ak_e = ext.sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)\n    w_compressed = torch.zeros((am_a, ak_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    w_meta = torch.zeros((am_e, ak_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    ext.sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed, w_compressed, w_meta)\n\n    # Sparse GEMM\n    out_sparse = torch.empty((M, N), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    ext.scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(out_sparse, x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)\n\n    # Expected: each output element = sum over K of (kept_w * x_val) ≈ (K/2) * w_val * x_val\n    expected_per_elem = (K / 2) * w_val * x_val\n    actual_mean = out_sparse.float().abs().mean().item()\n    print(f\"  expected (K/2 * w_val * x_val) = {expected_per_elem:.3f}\")\n    print(f\"  actual sparse mean(|out|)      = {actual_mean:.3f}\")\n    print(f\"  ratio actual / expected         = {actual_mean / expected_per_elem:.3f}\")\n\n    # Also call dense FP4 for comparison (use same weight reordered: dense weight, no sparsity)\n    # Pad/dense reference using full weight\n    out_dense_ref = (x_bf.float() @ w_bf.float().t()).to(torch.bfloat16)\n    dense_mean = out_dense_ref.float().abs().mean().item()\n    print(f\"  dense BF16 ref mean(|out|)     = {dense_mean:.3f}\")\n    print(f\"  ratio sparse / dense_ref        = {actual_mean / dense_mean:.3f}\")\n\n\n# Try several configs\nrun(128, 4096, 4096, 1.0, 1.0)\nrun(128, 4096, 4096, 0.5, 1.0)\nrun(128, 4096, 4096, 2.0, 1.0)\n"
}

> AGENT

🎯 **找到了！constant 测试 PASS（ratio = 1.00），说明 kernel 数值正确**。

那 random 测试 5× 误差是因为我的 `dequant_nvfp4` reference 有 un-swizzle bug —— constant 输入下 SF 都相同所以 permute 不影响结果，random 下不同 block 的 SF 不同，un-swizzle 错就给出错误的 reference。

  "content": "\"\"\"Compare sparse kernel output vs dense kernel output on the same NVFP4 data.\n\nStrategy:\n  1. quantize w (with 2:4 zeros) → (w_packed, w_sf), one shape.\n  2. activation x → (x_packed, x_sf).\n  3. dense_out = cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(x_packed, w_packed, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)\n                — well-tested, treats weight as dense (the 0 elements are physically 0 NVFP4 codes)\n  4. compress w_packed → (w_compressed, w_meta).\n  5. sparse_out = scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)\n  6. dense_out and sparse_out should match (same math, different storage of zeros).\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nfrom build import build\nimport sgl_kernel\n\ntorch.manual_seed(42)\nDEVICE = \"cuda\"\next = build(verbose=False)\n\n\ndef mag_prune_2of4(w):\n    out, in_ = w.shape\n    g = w.view(out, in_ // 4, 4)\n    _, keep_idx = g.abs().topk(2, dim=-1)\n    mask = torch.zeros_like(g, dtype=torch.bool)\n    mask.scatter_(-1, keep_idx, True)\n    return (g * mask).view(out, in_)\n\n\ndef run(M, N, K):\n    print(f\"\\n=== M={M} N={N} K={K} ===\")\n    w_bf = (torch.randn(N, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.05)\n    w_bf = mag_prune_2of4(w_bf)\n    x_bf = (torch.randn(M, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5)\n\n    w_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()\n    w_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    w_packed, w_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_gs)\n    x_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()\n    x_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    x_packed, x_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_gs)\n    alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).to(torch.float32)\n\n    # Dense GEMM on the same NVFP4 data (ground truth — the kernel is well-tested)\n    out_dense = sgl_kernel.cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(\n        x_packed, w_packed, x_sf, w_sf, alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,\n    )\n\n    # Sparse GEMM on the same data\n    am_a, ak_a, am_e, ak_e = ext.sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)\n    w_compressed = torch.zeros((am_a, ak_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    w_meta = torch.zeros((am_e, ak_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    ext.sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed, w_compressed, w_meta)\n\n    out_sparse = torch.empty((M, N), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    ext.scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(out_sparse, x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)\n\n    diff = (out_sparse.float() - out_dense.float()).abs()\n    max_abs = diff.max().item()\n    rel = (diff / out_dense.float().abs().clamp(min=1e-3)).mean().item()\n    print(f\"  out_dense  : mean(|x|)={out_dense.float().abs().mean().item():.4f}, \"\n          f\"max(|x|)={out_dense.float().abs().max().item():.4f}\")\n    print(f\"  out_sparse : mean(|x|)={out_sparse.float().abs().mean().item():.4f}, \"\n          f\"max(|x|)={out_sparse.float().abs().max().item():.4f}\")\n    print(f\"  max_abs_err={max_abs:.5f}  rel_err={rel:.5f}\")\n    # Sample a few values\n    print(f\"  out_dense[0,:4]  = {out_dense[0,:4].tolist()}\")\n    print(f\"  out_sparse[0,:4] = {out_sparse[0,:4].tolist()}\")\n    print(f\"  ratio sparse/dense [0,:4] = {(out_sparse[0,:4].float() / out_dense[0,:4].float().clamp(min=1e-4)).tolist()}\")\n\n\nfor shape in [(128, 4096, 4096), (256, 4096, 4096), (4096, 4096, 16384)]:\n    run(*shape)\n"
}

cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>>
make_cute_packed_stride(cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>> s, cute::Shape<int,int,int> shape_MKL) {
  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<IntT>,
    "Stride must have an integral type so it can be set dynamically. Static strides not supported.");
  auto s_copy = s;
  cute::get<0>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<1>(shape_MKL));
  return s_copy;
}

template <class IntT>
CUTLASS_HOST_DEVICE
cute::Stride<cute::Int<1>, IntT>
make_cute_packed_stride(cute::Stride<cute::Int<1>, IntT> s, cute::Shape<int,int,int> shape_MKL) {
  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<IntT>,
    "Stride must have an integral type so it can be set dynamically. Static strides not supported.");
  auto s_copy = s;
  cute::get<1>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<0>(shape_MKL));
  return s_copy;
}

/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

// Strides with batch mode

template <class IntT>
--
cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>, int64_t>
make_cute_packed_stride(cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>, int64_t> s, cute::Shape<int,int,int> shape_MKL) {
  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<IntT>,
    "Stride must have an integral type so it can be set dynamically. Static strides not supported.");
  auto s_copy = s;
  cute::get<0>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<1>(shape_MKL));
  int batch_count =  cute::get<2>(shape_MKL);
  if (batch_count > 1) {
    cute::get<2>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<0>(shape_MKL) * cute::get<1>(shape_MKL));
  }
  else {
    cute::get<2>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(0);
  }
  return s_copy;
--
cute::Stride<cute::Int<1>, IntT, int64_t>
make_cute_packed_stride(cute::Stride<cute::Int<1>, IntT, int64_t> s, cute::Shape<int,int,int> shape_MKL) {
  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<IntT>,
    "Stride must have an integral type so it can be set dynamically. Static strides not supported.");
  auto s_copy = s;
  cute::get<1>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<0>(shape_MKL));
  int batch_count =  cute::get<2>(shape_MKL);
  if (batch_count > 1) {
    cute::get<2>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<0>(shape_MKL) * cute::get<1>(shape_MKL));
  }
  else {
    cute::get<2>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(0);
  }
  return s_copy;
--
cute::Stride<StrideIntT, cute::Int<1>, cute::Int<0>>
make_cute_packed_stride(cute::Stride<StrideIntT, cute::Int<1>, cute::Int<0>> s, cute::Shape<int,int,int> shape_MKL) {
  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<StrideIntT>,
    "Stride must have an integral type so it can be set dynamically. Static strides not supported.");
  auto s_copy = s;
  cute::get<0>(s_copy) = static_cast<StrideIntT>(cute::get<1>(shape_MKL));
  return s_copy;
}

template <class StrideIntT>
CUTLASS_HOST_DEVICE
cute::Stride<cute::Int<1>, StrideIntT, cute::Int<0>>
make_cute_packed_stride(cute::Stride<cute::Int<1>, StrideIntT, cute::Int<0>> s, cute::Shape<int,int,int> shape_MKL) {
  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<StrideIntT>,

  auto s_copy = s;
  cute::get<1>(s_copy) = static_cast<StrideIntT>(cute::get<0>(shape_MKL));

Stride<Stride<_16,_4>, Stride<           _0, _1>>>;
  using SfMNMajorAtom = Layout< Shape< Shape<Int<SFVecSize>, _4>,  Shape<_32,_4>>, 
                               Stride<Stride<            _0, _1>, Stride<_16,_4>>>;
  using SfAtom    = cute::conditional_t<major == UMMA::Major::K, SfKMajorAtom, SfMNMajorAtom>;
};

template<int SFVecSize_>
struct Sm1xxBlockScaledConfig {
  // We are creating the SFA and SFB tensors' layouts in the collective since they always have the same layout.
  // k-major order
  static constexpr int SFVecSize = SFVecSize_;
  using Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk = Sm1xxBlockScaledBasicChunk<SFVecSize>;
  using Blk_MN = typename Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk::Blk_MN;
  using Blk_SF = typename Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk::Blk_SF; 
  using SfAtom = typename Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk::SfAtom;

  using LayoutSF = decltype(blocked_product(SfAtom{}, make_layout( make_shape(int32_t(0), int32_t(0), int32_t(0)),
                                                                  make_stride(int32_t(0),       _1{}, int32_t(0)))));

  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
  static constexpr auto
  deduce_layoutSFA() {
    return LayoutSF{};
  }

--
  using Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk = cutlass::detail::Sm1xxBlockScaledBasicChunk<SFVecSize, major>;
  using Blk_MN = typename Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk::Blk_MN;
  using Blk_SF = typename Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk::Blk_SF; 
  using SfAtom = typename Sm1xxBlkScaledChunk::SfAtom;

  using LayoutKMajorSF  = decltype(blocked_product(SfAtom{}, make_layout(make_shape (int32_t(0), int32_t(0), int32_t(0)),
                                                                         make_stride(int32_t(0),       _1{}, int32_t(0)))));

  using LayoutMNMajorSF = decltype(blocked_product(SfAtom{}, make_layout(make_shape (int32_t(0), int32_t(0), int32_t(0)),
                                                                         make_stride(      _1{}, int32_t(0), int32_t(0)))));

  using LayoutSF = cute::conditional_t<major == UMMA::Major::K, LayoutKMajorSF, LayoutMNMajorSF>;

  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
--
  // The blockscaled tensor does not need to know vectorsize
  using Blk_M = _128;
  using Blk_N =   _4; 
  using SfAtom = Layout< Shape< Shape<_32,_4>,  Shape<_4>>, 
                        Stride<Stride<_16,_4>, Stride<_1>>>;

  template <class ProblemShape>
  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
  static constexpr auto
  tile_atom_to_shape(ProblemShape problem_shape) {
    auto problem_shape_MNL = append<3>(problem_shape, 1);
    auto [M, N, L] = problem_shape_MNL;
    return tile_to_shape(SfAtom{}, make_shape(M,N,L), Step<_2,_1,_3>{});
  }
