73	    MmaTileShape,
74	    ClusterShape,
75	    cutlass::epilogue::collective::EpilogueTileAuto,
76	    ElementAccumulator,
77	    ElementCompute,
78	    ElementC, LayoutCTag, AlignmentC,
79	    ElementD, LayoutDTag, AlignmentD,
80	    EpilogueScheduleType>::CollectiveOp;
81	
82	using CollectiveMainloop = typename cutlass::gemm::collective::CollectiveBuilder<
83	    ArchTag,
84	    OperatorClassMainloop,
85	    ElementA, LayoutATag, AlignmentA,
86	    ElementB, LayoutBTag, AlignmentB,
87	    ElementAccumulator,
88	    MmaTileShape,
89	    ClusterShape,
90	    cutlass::gemm::collective::StageCountAutoCarveout<
91	        static_cast<int>(sizeof(typename CollectiveEpilogue::SharedStorage))>,
92	    KernelScheduleType>::CollectiveOp;
93	
94	using GemmKernel = cutlass::gemm::kernel::GemmUniversal<
95	    Shape<int, int, int, int>,
96	    CollectiveMainloop,
97	    CollectiveEpilogue,
98	    void>;
99	
100	using Gemm = cutlass::gemm::device::GemmUniversalAdapter<GemmKernel>;
101	
102	using StrideA = typename GemmKernel::StrideA;
103	using StrideB = typename GemmKernel::StrideB;
104	using StrideC = typename GemmKernel::StrideC;
105	using StrideD = typename GemmKernel::StrideD;
106	using SparseConfig = typename CollectiveMainloop::SparseConfig;
107	using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename CollectiveMainloop::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
108	
109	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
110	// Compressor types (re-use SparseConfig from the GEMM above — single source of truth).
111	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
112	
113	using CompressorUtility = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressorUtility<
114	    Shape<int, int, int, int>,
115	    typename ElementA::DataType,
116	    LayoutATag,
117	    SparseConfig>;
118	
119	using CompressorKernel = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressor<
120	    Shape<int, int, int, int>,
121	    typename ElementA::DataType,
122	    LayoutATag,
123	    SparseConfig,
124	    ArchTag>;
125	
126	using Compressor = cutlass::transform::device::TransformUniversalAdapter<CompressorKernel>;
127	
128	}  // anonymous namespace
129	
130	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
131	// Public op 1: cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K) -> [aM_a, aK_a, aM_e, aK_e]
132	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
133	std::vector<int64_t> cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(int64_t N, int64_t K) {
134	  auto workload = cute::make_shape(static_cast<int>(N), 1, static_cast<int>(K), 1);
135	  auto stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(
136	      StrideA{}, {static_cast<int>(N), static_cast<int>(K), 1});
137	  CompressorUtility util(workload, stride_A);
138	  int aligned_m_a = util.get_tensorA_m_physical();
139	  int aligned_k_a = util.get_tensorA_k_physical();  // NVFP4 element count
140	  int aligned_m_e = util.get_metadata_m_physical();
141	  int aligned_k_e = util.get_metadata_k_physical();  // bytes
142	  return {aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a, aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e};
143	}
144	
145	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
146	// Public op 2: cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress(weight_dense, weight_compressed, weight_meta)
147	//   weight_dense       [N, K/2]  uint8 packed NVFP4 with hard 2:4 zeros
148	//   weight_compressed  [aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a/2] uint8
149	//   weight_meta        [aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e]   uint8
150	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
151	void cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress(
152	    torch::Tensor const& weight_dense,
153	    torch::Tensor& weight_compressed,
154	    torch::Tensor& weight_meta) {
155	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_dense.is_cuda(), "weight_dense must be CUDA");
156	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_dense.is_contiguous(), "weight_dense must be contiguous");
157	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_dense.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Byte, "weight_dense must be uint8");
158	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_dense.dim() == 2, "weight_dense must be 2D");
159	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_compressed.is_cuda() && weight_meta.is_cuda(), "outputs must be CUDA");
160	
161	  int const N = static_cast<int>(weight_dense.size(0));
162	  int const K = static_cast<int>(weight_dense.size(1)) * 2;
163	
164	  auto workload = cute::make_shape(N, 1, K, 1);
165	  auto stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, {N, K, 1});
166	
167	  cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo hw_info;
168	  hw_info.device_id = weight_dense.get_device();
169	  hw_info.sm_count = cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(hw_info.device_id);
170	
171	  typename Compressor::Arguments args{
172	      {N, 1, K, 1},
173	      {reinterpret_cast<typename ElementA::DataType const*>(weight_dense.data_ptr()),
174	       stride_A,
175	       reinterpret_cast<typename ElementA::DataType*>(weight_compressed.data_ptr()),
176	       reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(weight_meta.data_ptr())},
177	      {hw_info}};
178	
179	  Compressor compressor_op;
180	  size_t ws_size = Compressor::get_workspace_size(args);
181	  auto ws_opts = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(weight_dense.device());
182	  auto workspace = torch::empty(static_cast<int64_t>(std::max<size_t>(ws_size, 1)), ws_opts);
183	
184	  at::cuda::CUDAGuard device_guard{(char)weight_dense.get_device()};
185	  cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(weight_dense.get_device());
186	
187	  CUTLASS_CHECK(compressor_op.can_implement(args));
188	  CUTLASS_CHECK(compressor_op.initialize(args, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
189	  CUTLASS_CHECK(compressor_op.run(stream));
190	}
191	
192	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
193	// Public op 3: cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm
194	//   D[M_user, N_user] BF16 = activation[M_user, K] @ weight[N_user, K]^T
195	//
196	// CUTLASS sees a transposed problem:
197	//   A_cutlass = weight (sparse, RowMajor, M_cutlass=N_user)
198	//   B_cutlass = activation (ColMajor view, N_cutlass=M_user)
199	//   D_cutlass = ColMajor (M_cutlass, N_cutlass) — physically same as user's RowMajor [M_user, N_user]
200	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
201	void cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(
202	    torch::Tensor& D,                  // [M_user, N_user] BF16
203	    torch::Tensor const& activation,   // [M_user, K/2] uint8 packed NVFP4
204	    torch::Tensor const& weight,       // [N_user_aligned, K_aligned/4] uint8 sparse-compressed (=aligned_k_a/2 bytes)
205	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,  // [N_user_aligned, K_aligned/8] uint8 metadata
206	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,       // FP8 e4m3, interleaved
207	    torch::Tensor const& weight_sf,    // FP8 e4m3, interleaved
208	    torch::Tensor const& alpha) {      // [1] float32
209	
210	  TORCH_CHECK(activation.is_cuda() && weight.is_cuda(), "tensors must be CUDA");
211	  TORCH_CHECK(activation.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Byte, "activation must be uint8");
212	  TORCH_CHECK(weight.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Byte, "weight must be uint8");
213	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_meta.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Byte, "weight_meta must be uint8");
214	  TORCH_CHECK(act_sf.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Float8_e4m3fn, "act_sf must be fp8 e4m3");
215	  TORCH_CHECK(weight_sf.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Float8_e4m3fn, "weight_sf must be fp8 e4m3");
216	  TORCH_CHECK(alpha.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Float, "alpha must be float32");
217	  TORCH_CHECK(D.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::BFloat16, "D must be bfloat16");
218	
219	  int const M_user = static_cast<int>(activation.size(0));
220	  int const N_user = static_cast<int>(weight.size(0));
221	  int const K = static_cast<int>(activation.size(1)) * 2;
222	  TORCH_CHECK(K % 64 == 0, "K must be divisible by 64");
223	  TORCH_CHECK(N_user % 64 == 0, "N must be divisible by 64");
224	
225	  // CUTLASS transposed (M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K) = (N_user, M_user, K)
226	  int const M_cutlass = N_user;
227	  int const N_cutlass = M_user;
228	  auto problem_shape = cute::make_shape(M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K, 1);
229	
230	  auto layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(problem_shape);
231	  auto layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(problem_shape);
232	  auto stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {N_cutlass, K, 1});
233	  auto stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {M_cutlass, N_cutlass, 1});
234	  auto layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(problem_shape);
235	  auto layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(problem_shape);
236	
237	  using ElementSFA = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;
238	  using ElementSFB = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;
239	
240	  typename Gemm::Arguments args{
241	      cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
242	      {M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K, 1},
243	      {
244	          reinterpret_cast<typename ElementA::DataType const*>(weight.data_ptr()),
245	          layout_A,
246	          reinterpret_cast<typename ElementB::DataType const*>(activation.data_ptr()),
247	          stride_B,
248	          reinterpret_cast<ElementE const*>(weight_meta.data_ptr()),
249	          layout_E,
250	          reinterpret_cast<ElementSFA const*>(weight_sf.data_ptr()),
251	          layout_SFA,
252	          reinterpret_cast<ElementSFB const*>(act_sf.data_ptr()),
253	          layout_SFB,
254	      },
255	      {
256	          {},        // epilogue.thread (alpha set below)
257	          nullptr,   // C ptr (no C source)
258	          stride_D,
259	          reinterpret_cast<ElementD*>(D.data_ptr()),
260	          stride_D,
261	      }};
262	  auto& fusion = args.epilogue.thread;
263	  fusion.alpha_ptr = reinterpret_cast<ElementCompute const*>(alpha.data_ptr());
264	
265	  args.hw_info.device_id = activation.get_device();
266	  args.hw_info.sm_count = cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(
267	      args.hw_info.device_id);
268	
269	  Gemm gemm;
270	  size_t ws_size = Gemm::get_workspace_size(args);
271	  auto ws_opts = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(activation.device());
272	  auto workspace = torch::empty(static_cast<int64_t>(std::max<size_t>(ws_size, 1)), ws_opts);
273	
274	  at::cuda::CUDAGuard device_guard{(char)activation.get_device()};
275	  cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(activation.get_device());
276	
277	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(args));
278	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(args, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
279	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run(args, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
280	}
281	
282	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
283	// pybind11 module
284	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
285	PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME, m) {
286	  m.def("sparse_fp4_compressed_shape", &cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape,
287	        "Return [aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a (elements), aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e (bytes)]");
288	  m.def("sparse_fp4_compress", &cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress,
289	        "Compress a 2:4-sparse NVFP4 weight in-place into (weight_compressed, weight_meta)");
290	  m.def("scaled_sparse_fp4_mm", &cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm,
291	        "Compute D = activation @ weight^T with weight=2:4-sparse NVFP4 (CUTLASS sm_120)");
292	}

279	typename T::Gemm::Arguments args_from_options(
280	    at::Tensor& D,
281	    at::Tensor const& A,
282	    at::Tensor const& B,
283	    at::Tensor const& A_sf,
284	    at::Tensor const& B_sf,

296	  using StrideB = typename T::StrideB;
297	  using StrideD = typename T::StrideD;
298	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename T::Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
299	
300	  int m = static_cast<int>(M);
301	  int n = static_cast<int>(N);
302	  int k = static_cast<int>(K);
303	  auto stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, {m, k, 1});
304	  auto stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {n, k, 1});
305	  auto stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {m, n, 1});
306	
307	  auto layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(cute::make_shape(m, n, k, 1));
308	  auto layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(cute::make_shape(m, n, k, 1));
309	
310	  typename T::Gemm::Arguments arguments{
311	      cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
312	      {m, n, k, 1},
313	      {// Mainloop arguments
314	       static_cast<ElementA const*>(A.data_ptr()),
315	       stride_A,
316	       static_cast<ElementB const*>(B.data_ptr()),
317	       stride_B,
318	       static_cast<ElementSFA const*>(A_sf.data_ptr()),
319	       layout_SFA,
320	       static_cast<ElementSFB const*>(B_sf.data_ptr()),
321	       layout_SFB},
322	      {     // Epilogue arguments
323	       {},  // epilogue.thread
324	       nullptr,
325	       stride_D,
326	       static_cast<ElementD*>(D.data_ptr()),
327	       stride_D}};
328	  auto& fusion_args = arguments.epilogue.thread;
329	  fusion_args.alpha_ptr = static_cast<ElementCompute const*>(alpha.data_ptr());
330	  using KernelConfig = typename T::Config;
331	  arguments.hw_info.cluster_shape = KernelConfig::preferred_cluster;
332	  arguments.hw_info.cluster_shape_fallback = KernelConfig::fallback_cluster;
333	  return arguments;
334	}

336	template <typename T>
337	void runGemm(
338	    at::Tensor& D,
339	    at::Tensor const& A,
340	    at::Tensor const& B,
341	    at::Tensor const& A_sf,
342	    at::Tensor const& B_sf,
343	    at::Tensor const& alpha,
344	    int64_t m,
345	    int64_t n,
346	    int64_t k,
347	    cudaStream_t stream) {
348	  typename T::Gemm gemm;
349	  auto arguments = args_from_options<T>(D, A, B, A_sf, B_sf, alpha, m, n, k);
350	
351	  size_t workspace_size = T::Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
352	  auto const workspace_options = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(A.device());
353	  auto workspace = torch::empty(workspace_size, workspace_options);
354	
355	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
356	
357	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
358	
359	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
360	}

25	// Quantizes the provided PackedVec into the uint32_t output
26	template <class Type, bool UE8M0_SF = false>
27	__device__ uint32_t cvt_warp_fp16_to_fp4(PackedVec<Type>& vec, float SFScaleVal, uint8_t* SFout) {
28	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 1000)
29	  // Get absolute maximum values among the local 8 values.
30	  auto localMax = __habs2(vec.elts[0]);
31	
32	// Local maximum value.
33	#pragma unroll
34	  for (int i = 1; i < CVT_FP4_ELTS_PER_THREAD / 2; i++) {
35	    localMax = __hmax2(localMax, __habs2(vec.elts[i]));
36	  }
37	
38	  // Get the absolute maximum among all 16 values (two threads).
39	  localMax = __hmax2(__shfl_xor_sync(uint32_t(-1), localMax, 1), localMax);
40	  // Get the final absolute maximum values.
41	  float vecMax = float(__hmax(localMax.x, localMax.y));
42	
43	  // Get the SF (max value of the vector / max value of e2m1).
44	  // maximum value of e2m1 = 6.0.
45	  // TODO: use half as compute data type.
46	  float SFValue = SFScaleVal * (vecMax * reciprocal_approximate_ftz(6.0f));
47	  // 8 bits representation of the SF.
48	  uint8_t fp8SFVal;
49	  // Write the SF to global memory (STG.8).
50	  if constexpr (UE8M0_SF) {
51	    __nv_fp8_e8m0 tmp;
52	    tmp.__x = __nv_cvt_float_to_e8m0(SFValue, __NV_SATFINITE, cudaRoundPosInf);
53	    SFValue = static_cast<float>(tmp);
54	    fp8SFVal = tmp.__x;
55	  } else {
56	    // Here SFValue is always positive, so E4M3 is the same as UE4M3.
57	    __nv_fp8_e4m3 tmp = __nv_fp8_e4m3(SFValue);
58	    fp8SFVal = tmp.__x;
59	    SFValue = static_cast<float>(tmp);
60	  }
61	  // Get the output scale.
62	  // Recipe: final_scale = reciprocal(fp32(fp8(SFValue * SFScaleVal))) *
63	  //                       reciprocal(SFScaleVal))
64	  float outputScale =
65	      SFValue != 0 ? reciprocal_approximate_ftz(SFValue * reciprocal_approximate_ftz(SFScaleVal)) : 0.0f;
66	
67	  if (SFout) {
68	    // Write the SF to global memory (STG.8).
69	    *SFout = fp8SFVal;
70	  }
71	
72	  // Convert the input to float.
73	  float2 fp2Vals[CVT_FP4_ELTS_PER_THREAD / 2];
74	
75	#pragma unroll
76	  for (int i = 0; i < CVT_FP4_ELTS_PER_THREAD / 2; i++) {
77	    if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Type, half>) {
78	      fp2Vals[i] = __half22float2(vec.elts[i]);
79	    } else {
80	      fp2Vals[i] = __bfloat1622float2(vec.elts[i]);
81	    }
82	    fp2Vals[i].x *= outputScale;
83	    fp2Vals[i].y *= outputScale;
84	  }
85	
86	  // Convert to e2m1 values.
87	  uint32_t e2m1Vec = fp32_vec_to_e2m1(fp2Vals);
88	
89	  // Write the e2m1 values to global memory.
90	  return e2m1Vec;
91	#else
92	  return 0;
93	#endif
94	}
95

98	__global__ void
99	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 1000)
100	__launch_bounds__(512, 4) cvt_fp16_to_fp4(

104	    int32_t numRows, int32_t numCols, Type const* in, float const* SFScale, uint32_t* out, uint32_t* SFout) {
105	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 1000)
106	  using PackedVec = PackedVec<Type>;
107	  static constexpr int CVT_FP4_NUM_THREADS_PER_SF = (CVT_FP4_SF_VEC_SIZE / CVT_FP4_ELTS_PER_THREAD);
108	  static_assert(sizeof(PackedVec) == sizeof(Type) * CVT_FP4_ELTS_PER_THREAD, "Vec size is not matched.");
109	
110	  // Get the global scaling factor, which will be applied to the SF.
111	  // Note SFScale is the same as next GEMM's alpha, which is
112	  // (448.f / (Alpha_A / 6.f)).
113	  float const SFScaleVal = SFScale == nullptr ? 1.0f : SFScale[0];
114	
115	  // Input tensor row/col loops.
116	  for (int rowIdx = blockIdx.x; rowIdx < numRows; rowIdx += gridDim.x) {
117	    for (int colIdx = threadIdx.x; colIdx < numCols / CVT_FP4_ELTS_PER_THREAD; colIdx += blockDim.x) {
118	      int64_t inOffset = rowIdx * (numCols / CVT_FP4_ELTS_PER_THREAD) + colIdx;
119	      PackedVec in_vec = reinterpret_cast<PackedVec const*>(in)[inOffset];
120	      // Get the output tensor offset.
121	      // Same as inOffset because 8 elements are packed into one uint32_t.
122	      int64_t outOffset = inOffset;
123	      auto& out_pos = out[outOffset];
124	
125	      auto sf_out =
126	          cvt_quant_to_fp4_get_sf_out_offset<uint32_t, CVT_FP4_NUM_THREADS_PER_SF>(rowIdx, colIdx, numCols, SFout);
127	
128	      out_pos = cvt_warp_fp16_to_fp4<Type, UE8M0_SF>(in_vec, SFScaleVal, sf_out);
129	    }
130	  }
131	#endif

134	template <typename T>
135	void invokeFP4Quantization(
136	    int m,
137	    int n,
138	    T const* input,
139	    float const* SFScale,
140	    int64_t* output,
141	    int32_t* SFOuput,
142	    bool useUE8M0,
143	    int multiProcessorCount,
144	    cudaStream_t stream) {
145	  // Grid, Block size.
146	  // Each thread converts 8 values.
147	  dim3 block(std::min(int(n / ELTS_PER_THREAD), 512));
148	  // Get number of blocks per SM (assume we can fully utilize the SM).
149	  int const numBlocksPerSM = 2048 / block.x;
150	  dim3 grid(std::min(int(m), multiProcessorCount * numBlocksPerSM));
151	
152	  // Launch the cvt kernel.
153	  if (useUE8M0) {
154	    cvt_fp16_to_fp4<T, true><<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
155	        m, n, input, SFScale, reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(output), reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(SFOuput));
156	  } else {
157	    cvt_fp16_to_fp4<T, false><<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
158	        m, n, input, SFScale, reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(output), reinterpret_cast<uint32_t*>(SFOuput));
159	  }
160	}

185	inline int getMultiProcessorCount() {
186	  static int multi_processor_count = []() {
187	    int device_id = 0;
188	    int count = 0;
189	
190	    // Get the current CUDA device ID
191	    CHECK_CUDA_SUCCESS(cudaGetDevice(&device_id));
192	
193	    // Get the number of multiprocessors for the current device
194	    CHECK_CUDA_SUCCESS(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&count, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, device_id));
195	
196	    return count;  // Initialize the static variable
197	  }();
198	
199	  return multi_processor_count;  // Return the cached value on subsequent calls
200	}
201	
202	void scaled_fp4_quant_sm100a_sm120a(
203	    torch::Tensor const& output,
204	    torch::Tensor const& input,
205	    torch::Tensor const& output_sf,
206	    torch::Tensor const& input_sf) {
207	  auto sm_version = getSMVersion();
208	  TORCH_CHECK(sm_version >= 100, "fp4_quant is only supported on sm100+");
209	
210	  int32_t m = input.size(0);
211	  int32_t n = input.size(1);
212	
213	  TORCH_CHECK(n % 16 == 0, "The N dimension must be multiple of 16.");
214	
215	  int multiProcessorCount = getMultiProcessorCount();
216	
217	  auto input_sf_ptr = static_cast<float const*>(input_sf.data_ptr());
218	  auto sf_out = static_cast<int32_t*>(output_sf.data_ptr());
219	  auto output_ptr = static_cast<int64_t*>(output.data_ptr());
220	  at::cuda::CUDAGuard device_guard{(char)input.get_device()};
221	  const cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(input.get_device());
222	
223	  // We don't support e8m0 scales at this moment.
224	  bool useUE8M0 = false;
225	
226	  switch (input.scalar_type()) {
227	    case torch::kHalf: {
228	      auto input_ptr = reinterpret_cast<half const*>(input.data_ptr());
229	      invokeFP4Quantization(m, n, input_ptr, input_sf_ptr, output_ptr, sf_out, useUE8M0, multiProcessorCount, stream);
230	      break;
231	    }
232	    case torch::kBFloat16: {
233	      auto input_ptr = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16 const*>(input.data_ptr());
234	      invokeFP4Quantization(m, n, input_ptr, input_sf_ptr, output_ptr, sf_out, useUE8M0, multiProcessorCount, stream);
235	      break;
236	    }
237	    default: {
238	      std::cerr << "Observing: " << input.scalar_type() << " for the input datatype which is invalid";
239	      throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported input data type for quantize_to_fp4.");
240	    }
241	  }

128	template <class SFType, int CVT_FP4_NUM_THREADS_PER_SF>
129	__device__ uint8_t* cvt_quant_to_fp4_get_sf_out_offset(int rowIdx, int colIdx, int numCols, SFType* SFout) {
130	#if defined(__CUDA_ARCH__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 1000)
131	  static_assert(CVT_FP4_NUM_THREADS_PER_SF == 1 || CVT_FP4_NUM_THREADS_PER_SF == 2);
132	
133	  // One pair of threads write one SF to global memory.
134	  // TODO: stage through smem for packed STG.32
135	  // is it better than STG.8 from 4 threads ?
136	  if (threadIdx.x % CVT_FP4_NUM_THREADS_PER_SF == 0) {
137	    // SF vector index (16 elements share one SF in the K dimension).
138	    int32_t kIdx = colIdx / CVT_FP4_NUM_THREADS_PER_SF;
139	    int32_t mIdx = rowIdx;
140	
141	    // SF layout [numMTiles, numKTiles, 32 (mTile), 4 (mTile), 4(kTile)]
142	    // --> index [mTileIdx, kTileIdx, outerMIdx, innerMIdx, innerKIdx]
143	
144	    int32_t mTileIdx = mIdx / (32 * 4);
145	    // SF vector size 16.
146	    int factor = CVT_FP4_SF_VEC_SIZE * 4;
147	    int32_t numKTiles = (numCols + factor - 1) / factor;
148	    int64_t mTileStride = numKTiles * 32 * 4 * 4;
149	
150	    int32_t kTileIdx = (kIdx / 4);
151	    int64_t kTileStride = 32 * 4 * 4;
152	
153	    // M tile layout [32, 4] is column-major.
154	    int32_t outerMIdx = (mIdx % 32);
155	    int64_t outerMStride = 4 * 4;
156	
157	    int32_t innerMIdx = (mIdx % (32 * 4)) / 32;
158	    int64_t innerMStride = 4;
159	
160	    int32_t innerKIdx = (kIdx % 4);
161	    int64_t innerKStride = 1;
162	
163	    // Compute the global offset.
164	    int64_t SFOffset = mTileIdx * mTileStride + kTileIdx * kTileStride + outerMIdx * outerMStride +
165	                       innerMIdx * innerMStride + innerKIdx * innerKStride;
166	
167	    return reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(SFout) + SFOffset;
168	  }
169	#endif
170	  return nullptr;
171	}

> AGENT

## 问题诊断

**现象**：
- SF 每 block 值相同的 case（diag_tiny / diag_constant）→ 通过
- SF 每 block 值变化的 case → 失败，magnitude 接近但位置错乱（mean 1.19 vs 0.95，max_abs 12，rel_err ~3-5）

dense FP4 kernel 用**同一份** sgl_kernel quant 出的 SF + 同一份 CUTLASS `Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig` layout，结果是对的。说明 sgl_kernel quant 的 SF layout 跟 dense CUTLASS 期望 bit-identical。

**那 sparse 错在哪？** 我目前最大的怀疑是：**sparse 的 SFA layout 期望 K 是 `K_logical`，但实际 CUTLASS 内部按 `K_compressed = K/2` 索引**（或反过来），跟 dense 不同。SF 全局 constant 时不显现，每 block 变化时立刻暴露错位。

## Example 为什么"对"

80b example 的 reference 是 `cutlass::reference::host::Gemm3x(mainloop_params, epilogue_params)`，**和 kernel 共用同一份 SF tensor + 同一份 layout**：

```cpp
Tensor tensor_SFA = make_tensor(block_SFA.host_data(), layout_SFA);  // 同一个 layout
// ...
cutlass::reference::host::Gemm3x<...>(mainloop_params, epilogue_params);
```

block_SFA 是 `initialize_block(...)` 随机 uint8 直接填的，**不经过任何外部 quantizer**。两边自洽 → "对"。

这只能证明 **kernel 的数学是对的**（在自洽 SF 输入下），**不能证明它跟外部 quantizer 产物兼容**。我的 constant/tiny 测试也是 kernel 自洽的产物。

## 不能"直接用 example"，但能用它当对照

1. example 是 standalone CMake binary，不是 PyTorch op，没法接进推理路径
2. example 内嵌 SF 生成，绕过了"外部 quantizer ↔ CUTLASS layout 兼容"这个关键问题，正是我现在被卡住的地方
3. 但 example 可以当 **golden reference**：在 example 里把 SF/A 替换成"sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant 产出的真实 tensor"，看 example 还对不对——如果 example 也变错，则 sparse SFA layout 和 dense 不同的假说成立；如果 example 还对，则我的 .cu 里有 transpose 或别处写错。

下一步我打算先查 CUTLASS sparse NVFP4 的 SFA layout 是 logical K 还是 compressed K（最简单地：在 example 里塞 sgl quant 的 SF 看是否炸）。要不要先继续？

194	                 int32_t(0)),

201	  // This function is used to revert a CuTe layout to a Cutlass layout tag (RowMajor/ColumnMajor)
202	  template <
203	    typename ShapeA,
204	    typename StrideA
205	  >
206	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
207	  static constexpr auto
208	  deduce_layoutA_tag(Layout<ShapeA, StrideA> layout_a) {
209	    /*
210	      (m, (2, k/2), l) : (2, (1, m*2), m*k) M-major
211	      (m, (2, k/2), l) : (k, (1, 2), m*k) K-major
212	    */
213	    // Check if the given layout_a is possibly a sparse tensorA layout.
214	    static_assert(rank_v<ShapeA> == 3 && depth_v<ShapeA> == 2, "Rank and depth mismatch with the sparse tensorA's layout.");
215	    static_assert(rank(get<1>(ShapeA{})) == 2 && rank(flatten(ShapeA{})) == 4,
216	                  "Not likely to be a sparse tensorA's layout.");
217	    static_assert(get<1,0>(StrideA{}) == 1 && get<1,0>(ShapeA{}) == ElementASparsity{},
218	                  "Not likely to be a sparse tensorA's layout.");
219	    static_assert(get<0>(StrideA{}) == ElementASparsity{} || get<1,1>(StrideA{}) == ElementASparsity{},
220	                  "Not likely to be a sparse tensorA's layout.");
221	
222	    if constexpr (get<0>(StrideA{}) == ElementASparsity{}) {
223	      return cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor{};
224	    }
225	    else {
226	      return  cutlass::layout::RowMajor{};
227	    }
228	  }
229	
230	  // The following two functions are provided for user fill dynamic problem size to the layout_a/e.
231	  template <
232	    class ProblemShape
233	  >
234	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
235	  static constexpr auto
236	  fill_layoutA(ProblemShape problem_shape) {
237	    // * Purpose of this function
238	    // This function is sparse gemm equivalent of 
239	    //
240	    //   ```cpp
241	    //   using LayoutATag = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;
242	    //   using StrideA = cutlass::gemm::TagToStrideA_t<GmemLayoutBTag>; // ( cute::Stride<int64_t, cute::Int<1>, int64_t> )
243	    //   auto stride_a = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, cute::make_shape(M, K, L)); // (M, cute::Int<1>, L)
244	    //   auto layout_a = cute::make_layout(cute::make_shape(M, K, L), stride_a);
245	    //   ```
246	    //
247	    // Unlike dense gemm where we can simply call `TagToStrideA_t` resp. `make_cute_packed_stride`
248	    // to get the shape and stride, sparse gemm needs to consider the cute::sparse_elem<> representation.
249	    // Thus, it's easier to construct the layout directly.
250	    //
251	    // * NOTE
252	    // 1. Returned layout should be used with `cute::sparse_elem<>` pointer, instead of raw element A ptr
253	    // 2. `TensorAAlignmentK` already include 2x sparsity factor along K dim.
254	    //    e.g. MMA FP4 A is K major, TensorAAlignmentK = 256. When used with `cute::sparse_elem<2, f4>`, TensorAComp will
255	    //         have 128 element alignment along k-dim
256	    const auto [M, N, K, L] = problem_shape;
257	
258	    // Round up to satisfy TensorA Alignment requirement
259	    const auto M_AlignedAC = cutlass::round_up(M, TensorAAlignmentM{});
260	    const auto K_AlignedAC = cutlass::round_up(K, TensorAAlignmentK{});
261	
262	    if constexpr (IsKMajor) {
263	      return make_layout(
264	        make_shape(int32_t(M_AlignedAC),
265	                   make_shape(ElementASparsity{}, int32_t(K_AlignedAC / ElementASparsity{})),
266	                   int32_t(L)),
267	        make_stride(int64_t(K_AlignedAC),
268	                    make_stride(_1{}, ElementASparsity{}),
269	                    (L == 1) ? int64_t(0) : int64_t(M_AlignedAC * K_AlignedAC))
270	      );
271	    }
272	    else {
273	      return make_layout(
274	        make_shape(int32_t(M_AlignedAC),
275	                   make_shape(ElementASparsity{}, int32_t(K_AlignedAC) / ElementASparsity{}),
276	                   int32_t(L)),
277	        make_stride(ElementASparsity{},
278	                    make_stride(_1{}, int64_t(M_AlignedAC) * ElementASparsity{}),
279	                    (L == 1) ? int64_t(0) : int64_t(M_AlignedAC * K_AlignedAC))

75	template <class IntT>
76	CUTLASS_HOST_DEVICE
77	cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>, int64_t>
78	make_cute_packed_stride(cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>, int64_t> s, cute::Shape<int,int,int> shape_MKL) {
79	  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<IntT>,
80	    "Stride must have an integral type so it can be set dynamically. Static strides not supported.");
81	  auto s_copy = s;
82	  cute::get<0>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<1>(shape_MKL));
83	  int batch_count =  cute::get<2>(shape_MKL);
84	  if (batch_count > 1) {
85	    cute::get<2>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(cute::get<0>(shape_MKL) * cute::get<1>(shape_MKL));
86	  }
87	  else {
88	    cute::get<2>(s_copy) = static_cast<IntT>(0);
89	  }
90	  return s_copy;
91	}

141	// Output cutlass::layout::TensorNDHWC -> rank-3 stride (InT,_1,_0)
142	// Note: For fprop/dgrad kernel, strides are assumed to be layout right in NZPQK/NDHWC order
143	// and therefore can be coalesced to just q/w. For wgrad kernel, strides are assumed to be layout
144	// right in KTRSC order and can be coalesced to just k.
145	// We enforce this condition here with asserts.
146	template <class IntT, size_t RankT_>
147	CUTLASS_HOST_DEVICE
148	cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>, cute::Int<0>>
149	make_cute_packed_stride(
150	    cute::Stride<IntT, cute::Int<1>, cute::Int<0>> s,
151	    cute::array<int32_t, RankT_> shape_output,
152	    cute::array<IntT, RankT_> stride_output,
153	    cutlass::conv::Operator conv_op) {
154	  static_assert(std::is_integral_v<IntT>,
155	    "Stride must have an integral type so it can be set dynamically. Static strides not supported.");
156	  static_assert(RankT_ >= 3u);
157	  constexpr static int RankT = static_cast<int>(RankT_);
158	
159	  assert(stride_output[RankT-1] == 1);
160	  cute::for_each(cute::make_seq<RankT-2>{}, [&](auto i) {
161	    assert(stride_output[i] == shape_output[i+1] * stride_output[i+1]);
162	  });
163	
164	  auto s_copy = s;
165	  cute::get<0>(s_copy) = (conv_op == cutlass::conv::Operator::kWgrad) ?
166	      stride_output[0] :
167	      stride_output[RankT-2];
168	  return s_copy;
169	}

229	    void set_metadata_bits(int elt_log_idx, int elt_phy_idx) {
230	      auto metadata_bits = [&]() -> uint8_t {
231	        CUTLASS_ASSERT(elt_log_idx >= 0 && elt_log_idx < 2);
232	        switch (elt_log_idx) {
233	          case 0:
234	            return 0b0100;
235	          case 1:
236	            return 0b1110;
237	          default:
238	            CUTE_GCC_UNREACHABLE;
239	        }
240	      };
241	
242	      storage_ |= (metadata_bits() << (4 * elt_phy_idx));
243	    }
244	
245	
246	    CUTE_DEVICE
247	    ElementEChunk storage() const {
248	      return ElementEChunk{storage_};
249	    }

253	  };

261	        switch (elt_log_idx) {
262	          case 0:
263	            return 0b00;
264	          case 1:
265	            return 0b01;
266	          case 2:

268	          case 3:

270	          default:

272	            CUTE_GCC_UNREACHABLE;

275	      };
276

295	  CUTE_DEVICE
296	  static void
297	  structure_sparse_compress(Params params, void* smem_buf) {
298	    // * Input Params
299	    auto [GemmM, GemmN, GemmK, GemmL] = params.problem_shape;
300	    auto [ptr_A, dA, ptr_ACompress, ptr_E] = params.transform;
301	    SharedStorage& shared_storage = *reinterpret_cast<SharedStorage*>(smem_buf);
302	
303	    [[maybe_unused]] const int gridDim_X = gridDim.x;
304	    [[maybe_unused]] const int gridDim_Y = gridDim.y;
305	    [[maybe_unused]] const int gridDim_Z = gridDim.z;
306	    [[maybe_unused]] const int blockDim_X = blockDim.x;
307	
308	    // * Global Tensor Layout
309	    const cute::Layout layout_gA = make_layout(make_shape(GemmM, GemmK, GemmL), dA);
310	    const cute::Layout layout_gAC = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(params.problem_shape);
311	    const cute::Layout layout_gE = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(params.problem_shape);
312	
313	    // * Construct Global Tensor
314	    const cute::Tensor gA   = make_tensor(make_gmem_ptr(cute::recast_ptr<ElementAUint>(ptr_A)), layout_gA);
315	    cute::Tensor gAC_sparse = make_tensor(make_gmem_ptr(cute::recast_ptr<ElementAUintCompressed>(ptr_ACompress)), layout_gAC );
316	    cute::Tensor gAC        = cute::recast<ElementAUint>(gAC_sparse);
317	    cute::Tensor gE_sparse  = make_tensor(make_gmem_ptr(cute::recast_ptr<ElementEMma>(ptr_E)), layout_gE);
318	    cute::Tensor gE         = cute::recast<ElementEMmaRaw>(gE_sparse);
319	
320	    // * CTA Tensor Layout
321	    using cAsA_layout_row = decltype(make_layout(make_shape(TensorEAtomM{}, TensorEAtomK{}), LayoutRight{}));
322	    using cAsA_layout_col = decltype(make_layout(make_shape(TensorEAtomM{}, TensorEAtomK{}), LayoutLeft{}));
323	    using cAsA_layout     = cute::conditional_t<cute::is_same_v<LayoutATag, layout::RowMajor>, cAsA_layout_row, cAsA_layout_col>;
324	    using cACsAC_layout   = decltype(make_layout(make_shape(TensorEAtomM{}, TensorEAtomK{} / ElementASparsity{}), LayoutRight{}));
325	    using cEsE_layout     = decltype(make_layout(make_shape(TensorEAtomM{}, TensorEAtomK{} / ElementEMmaSparsity{}), LayoutRight{}));
326	
327	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT(cute::is_static_v<TensorEAtom>, "TensorEAtom needs to be static");
328	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT(cute::is_static_v<cAsA_layout>, "cAsA_layout needs to be static");
329	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT(cute::is_static_v<cACsAC_layout>, "cACsAC_layout needs to be static");
330	    CUTE_STATIC_ASSERT(cute::is_static_v<cEsE_layout>, "cEsE_layout needs to be static");
331	
332	    const int blockIdx_X = blockIdx.x;
333	    const int blockIdx_Y = blockIdx.y;
334	    const int blockIdx_Z = blockIdx.z;
335	    const int threadIdx_X = threadIdx.x;
336	
337	    // * Construct CTA Tensor
338	    const auto cta_coord = make_coord(blockIdx_X, blockIdx_Y, blockIdx_Z);
339	    cute::Tensor cAgA   = cute::recast<ElementAMmaRawUnit>(local_tile(gA, shape(cAsA_layout{}), cta_coord));
340	    cute::Tensor cACgAC = cute::recast<ElementAMmaRawUnit>(local_tile(gAC, shape(cACsAC_layout{}), cta_coord));
341	    cute::Tensor cEgE   = local_tile(gE, shape(cEsE_layout{}), cta_coord);
342	
343	    cute::Tensor cAsA   = cute::recast<ElementAMmaRawUnit>(make_tensor(make_smem_ptr(cute::recast_ptr<ElementAUint>(shared_storage.cAsA)), cAsA_layout{}));
344	    cute::Tensor cACsAC = cute::recast<ElementAMmaRawUnit>(make_tensor(make_smem_ptr(cute::recast_ptr<ElementAUint>(shared_storage.cACsAC)), cACsAC_layout{}));
345	    cute::Tensor cEsE   = make_tensor(make_smem_ptr(cute::recast_ptr<ElementEMmaRaw>(shared_storage.cEsE)), cEsE_layout{});
346	    cute::Tensor cEsE_chunk = cute::recast<ElementEChunk>(cEsE);
347	
348	    // * Handle in unit of Chunk when compress
349	    using OneChunkSizeA  = Int<LogicalElemsAMmaRawPerChunk>;
350	    using OneChunkSizeAC = Int<PhysicalElemsAMmaRawPerChunk>;
351	    using OneChunkSizeE  = Int<LogicalElemsAPerChunk / ElementESparsityPerChunk{}>;
352	    using NumOneChunkK   = Int<cutlass::ceil_div(TensorEAtomK{}, LogicalElemsAPerChunk)>;
353	
354	    cute::Tensor cAsA_log_chunk   = logical_divide(cAsA, make_shape(_, OneChunkSizeA{}));

## 看完了 PR #8708：不能直接复用

**这个 PR 做的事情**（只改了 14 行）：
- `compressed_tensors.py`：让 sglang 调 **vLLM 的 `CompressedTensors24` scheme**
- 真正的 sparse GEMM **在 vLLM 仓库里**（`torch.ops._C.cutlass_scaled_sparse_mm`），不在 sglang / sgl-kernel 里
- 作者自己说：「The vllm sparse mm for bf16 inputs is poorly implemented in cutlass, optimization will be our next work」

**为什么不能直接复用**

1. **量化格式不同**：vLLM `CompressedTensors24` 走的是 **W8A8 INT8 / FP8 + BF16 act** 的稀疏路径（vLLM compressed_tensors_24 scheme 没有 NVFP4 weight + NVFP4 act + 16-elem block-scale + global-scale）。我们的目标是 NVFP4，是另一条数据通路。
2. **kernel 不共享**：sgl-kernel 编自己的 `common_ops.abi3.so`，不调用 vLLM 的 `_C`。要复用就得装 vLLM 当依赖，引入新 ABI 风险。
3. **sm_120 不确定支持**：vLLM cutlass sparse 主要针对 sm_80/sm_90，sm_120 Blackwell GeForce 没看到明确路径。
4. **性能不好**：作者自己承认 bf16 cutlass 路径「poorly implemented」，要 next work 才优化。

**但**有借鉴价值的两条线：

- **Python 侧接入逻辑**：vLLM 的 `CompressedTensors24` 怎么 hook `process_weights_after_loading` 调 compress、怎么标记 sparse layer、怎么 dispatch apply()，是现成的范本。我们 phase 4（改 modelopt_quant.py）那一步可以直接抄它的接入模式。
- **SF/transpose 写法**：vLLM `cutlass_scaled_sparse_mm` 的 entry.cu 里有现成的 「user 视角 → CUTLASS 视角」 transpose + SF 传递代码，**正好可以用来 debug 我们现在 SF 错位的问题**。如果 vLLM 的 NVFP4 sparse 路径不存在（很可能），那它的 BF16 sparse 实现至少能让我对比 transpose/SF 的 layout 处理细节。

要不要我去翻一下 vLLM 那个 entry.cu，重点看 transpose 后 SFA/SFB 是怎么对齐的？这可能直接解我们当前的 bug。

#include <cudaTypedefs.h>

#include <c10/cuda/CUDAGuard.h>
#include <torch/all.h>

#include "cutlass_extensions/common.hpp"

bool cutlass_sparse_scaled_mm_supported(int64_t cuda_device_capability) {
  // sparse CUTLASS kernels need exactly hopper and are not forward compatible
  //   CUDA 12.2 and SM90 (Hopper)

#if defined CUDA_VERSION
  return CUDA_VERSION >= 12020 && cuda_device_capability == 90;
#endif

  return false;
}

#if defined ENABLE_SPARSE_SCALED_MM_C3X && ENABLE_SPARSE_SCALED_MM_C3X
void cutlass_scaled_sparse_mm_sm90(torch::Tensor& c, torch::Tensor const& a,
                                   torch::Tensor const& b,
                                   torch::Tensor const& e,
                                   torch::Tensor const& a_scales,
                                   torch::Tensor const& b_scales,
                                   std::optional<torch::Tensor> const& bias);

using CompressorResult = std::tuple<torch::Tensor, torch::Tensor>;
CompressorResult cutlass_sparse_compress_sm90(torch::Tensor const& a);
#endif

void cutlass_scaled_sparse_mm(torch::Tensor& c, torch::Tensor const& a,
                              torch::Tensor const& bt_nzs,
                              torch::Tensor const& bt_meta,
                              torch::Tensor const& a_scales,
                              torch::Tensor const& b_scales,
                              std::optional<torch::Tensor> const& bias) {
  // Checks for conformality
  TORCH_CHECK(a.dim() == 2 && bt_nzs.dim() == 2 && c.dim() == 2);
  TORCH_CHECK(c.size(1) == bt_nzs.size(0) && bt_nzs.size(1) * 2 == a.size(1) &&
              a.size(0) == c.size(0));
  TORCH_CHECK(a_scales.numel() == 1 || a_scales.numel() == a.size(0));
  TORCH_CHECK(b_scales.numel() == 1 || b_scales.numel() == bt_nzs.size(0));

  // Check for strides and alignment
  TORCH_CHECK(a.stride(1) == 1 && bt_nzs.stride(1) == 1 &&
              c.stride(1) == 1);            // Row-major
  TORCH_CHECK(c.stride(0) % 16 == 0);       // 16 Byte Alignment
  TORCH_CHECK(bt_nzs.stride(0) % 16 == 0);  // 16 Byte Alignment
  TORCH_CHECK(a_scales.is_contiguous() && b_scales.is_contiguous());

  if (bias) {
    TORCH_CHECK(bias->numel() == bt_nzs.size(0) && bias->is_contiguous() &&
                bias->dim() == 1);
  }

  at::cuda::OptionalCUDAGuard const device_guard(device_of(a));
  int32_t version_num = get_sm_version_num();

  // Guard against compilation issues for sm90 kernels
#if defined ENABLE_SPARSE_SCALED_MM_C3X && ENABLE_SPARSE_SCALED_MM_C3X
  // We build for 9.0a which is not forward compatible, so restrict this to
  // Hopper only
  if (version_num == 90) {
    cutlass_scaled_sparse_mm_sm90(c, a, bt_nzs, bt_meta, a_scales, b_scales,
                                  bias);
    return;
  }
#endif

  TORCH_CHECK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(
      false,
      "No compiled cutlass_scaled_sparse_mm for a compute capability less than "
      "CUDA device capability: ",
      version_num);
}

std::vector<torch::Tensor> cutlass_sparse_compress(torch::Tensor const& a) {
  // Check for strides and alignment
  TORCH_CHECK(a.stride(1) == 1);      // Row-major
  TORCH_CHECK(a.stride(0) % 8 == 0);  // 8 Byte Alignment for Compression

  at::cuda::OptionalCUDAGuard const device_guard(device_of(a));
  int32_t version_num = get_sm_version_num();

  // Guard against compilation issues for sm90 kernels
#if defined ENABLE_SPARSE_SCALED_MM_C3X && ENABLE_SPARSE_SCALED_MM_C3X
  // We build for 9.0a which is not forward compatible, so restrict this to
  // Hopper only
  if (version_num == 90) {
    std::vector<torch::Tensor> result_tensors;

    auto [a_meta, a_nzs] = cutlass_sparse_compress_sm90(a);
    result_tensors.push_back(std::move(a_nzs));
    result_tensors.push_back(std::move(a_meta));
    return result_tensors;
  }
#endif

  TORCH_CHECK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED(
      false,
      "No compiled cutlass_sparse_compress for a compute capability equal to "
      "CUDA device capability: ",
      version_num);
}

using namespace cute;

/*
   This file defines 2:4 sparse GEMM operations using the CUTLASS 3.x API,
   for NVIDIA GPUs with sm90a (Hopper) or later.
*/

namespace {

// A wrapper for the GEMM kernel that is used to guard against compilation on
// architectures that will never use the kernel. The purpose of this is to
// reduce the size of the compiled binary.
// __CUDA_ARCH__ is not defined in host code, so this lets us smuggle the ifdef
// into code that will be executed on the device where it is defined.
template <typename Kernel>
struct enable_sm90_or_later : Kernel {
  template <typename... Args>
  CUTLASS_DEVICE void operator()(Args&&... args) {
#if defined __CUDA_ARCH__ && __CUDA_ARCH__ >= 900
    Kernel::operator()(std::forward<Args>(args)...);
#endif
  }
};

using GemmUniversalMode = cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode;

/*
 * cutlass_sparse_3x_gemm defines a 2:4 sparse GEMM kernel via CUTLASS
 * for SM90 Hopper systems.
 */
template <typename ElementAB_, typename ElementD_,
          template <typename, typename, typename> typename Epilogue_,
          typename TileShape, typename ClusterShape, typename KernelSchedule,
          typename EpilogueSchedule>
struct cutlass_sparse_3x_gemm {
  using ElementAB = ElementAB_;
  using ElementD = ElementD_;
  using ElementAcc =
      typename std::conditional<std::is_same_v<ElementAB, int8_t>, int32_t,
                                float>::type;

  using Epilogue = Epilogue_<ElementAcc, ElementD, TileShape>;

  using ElementC = void;
  using LayoutC = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;
  using LayoutC_Transpose =
      typename cutlass::layout::LayoutTranspose<LayoutC>::type;

  using EVTCompute = typename Epilogue::EVTCompute;

  // These are the minimum alignments needed for the kernels to compile
  static constexpr int AlignmentAB =
      128 / cutlass::sizeof_bits<ElementAB>::value;
  static constexpr int AlignmentCD =
      128 / cutlass::sizeof_bits<ElementD>::value;

  using CollectiveEpilogue =
      typename cutlass::epilogue::collective::CollectiveBuilder<
          cutlass::arch::Sm90, cutlass::arch::OpClassTensorOp, TileShape,
          ClusterShape, cutlass::epilogue::collective::EpilogueTileAuto,
          ElementAcc, float, ElementC, LayoutC_Transpose, AlignmentCD, ElementD,
          LayoutC_Transpose, AlignmentCD, EpilogueSchedule,
          EVTCompute>::CollectiveOp;

  static constexpr size_t CEStorageSize =
      sizeof(typename CollectiveEpilogue::SharedStorage);
  using Stages = typename cutlass::gemm::collective::StageCountAutoCarveout<
      static_cast<int>(CEStorageSize)>;

  // clang-format off
  using CollectiveMainloop =
      typename cutlass::gemm::collective::CollectiveBuilder<
          cutlass::arch::Sm90, cutlass::arch::OpClassSparseTensorOp,
          ElementAB, cutlass::layout::RowMajor, AlignmentAB,
          ElementAB, cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor, AlignmentAB,
          ElementAcc, TileShape, ClusterShape,
          Stages,
          KernelSchedule>::CollectiveOp;
  // clang-format on

  using KernelType = enable_sm90_or_later<cutlass::gemm::kernel::GemmUniversal<
      cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>, CollectiveMainloop, CollectiveEpilogue,
      cutlass::gemm::PersistentScheduler>>;

  struct GemmKernel : public KernelType {};

  // Sparse compressor definitions
  using SparseConfig = typename GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::SparseConfig;
  using LayoutTagA = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;
  using CompressorUtility =
      cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressorUtility<
          typename GemmKernel::ProblemShape, ElementAB, LayoutTagA,
          SparseConfig>;
  using CompressorKernel =
      cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressor<
          typename GemmKernel::ProblemShape, ElementAB, LayoutTagA,
          SparseConfig, cutlass::arch::Sm90>;
  using Compressor =
      cutlass::transform::device::TransformUniversalAdapter<CompressorKernel>;
};

/*
 * This class defines kernel to compress a 2:4 sparse matrix.
 * The particular format is defined by the Gemm template parameter,
 * which is a cutlass_sparse_3x_gemm.
 */
using CompressorResult = std::tuple<torch::Tensor, torch::Tensor>;
/// Make A structured sparse by replacing elements with 0 and compress it
template <typename Gemm>
CompressorResult cutlass_sparse_compress(torch::Tensor const& a) {
  // Checks for conformality
  TORCH_CHECK(a.dtype() == torch::kInt8 || a.dtype() == torch::kFloat8_e4m3fn ||
              a.dtype() == torch::kFloat16 || a.dtype() == torch::kBFloat16);
  TORCH_CHECK(a.dim() == 2)
  // Check for strides and alignment
  TORCH_CHECK(a.stride(0) % 4 == 0)  // Required for semi-structured sparsity
  TORCH_CHECK(a.stride(1) == 1)

  using GemmKernel = typename Gemm::KernelType;
  using ElementA = typename Gemm::ElementAB;
  using ElementE = typename GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::ElementE;

  int m = a.size(0);
  int k = a.size(1);
  using ProblemShape = typename GemmKernel::ProblemShape;
  ProblemShape prob_shape{m, 1, k, 1};

  int64_t lda = a.stride(0);
  using StrideA = Stride<int64_t, Int<1>, int64_t>;
  StrideA a_stride{lda, Int<1>{}, 0};

  using CompressorUtility = typename Gemm::CompressorUtility;
  CompressorUtility compressor_utility(prob_shape, a_stride);

  // Allocate buffers for the metadata E and the compressed matrix A
  int ME = compressor_utility.get_metadata_m_physical();
  int KE = compressor_utility.get_metadata_k_physical();
  int MC = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_m_physical();
  int KC = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_k_physical();

  auto const a_meta_options =
      torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(a.device());
  auto const a_nzs_options =
      torch::TensorOptions().dtype(a.dtype()).device(a.device());

  auto a_meta = torch::zeros({ME, KE}, a_meta_options);
  auto a_nzs = torch::zeros({MC, KC}, a_nzs_options);

  auto a_ptr = static_cast<ElementA*>(a.data_ptr());
  auto a_nzs_ptr = static_cast<ElementA*>(a_nzs.data_ptr());
  auto a_meta_ptr = static_cast<ElementE*>(a_meta.data_ptr());

  cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo hw_info;
  hw_info.device_id = a.device().index();
  hw_info.sm_count =
      cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(
          hw_info.device_id);

  using Compressor = typename Gemm::Compressor;
  typename Compressor::Arguments arguments{
      prob_shape, {a_ptr, a_stride, a_nzs_ptr, a_meta_ptr}, {hw_info}};

  Compressor compressor_op;
  size_t workspace_size = Compressor::get_workspace_size(arguments);
  auto const workspace_options =
      torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(a.device());
  auto workspace = torch::empty(workspace_size, workspace_options);

  CUTLASS_CHECK(compressor_op.can_implement(arguments));
  CUTLASS_CHECK(compressor_op.initialize(arguments, workspace.data_ptr()));
  CUTLASS_CHECK(compressor_op.run());
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());

template <typename Gemm, typename... EpilogueArgs>
void cutlass_sparse_gemm_caller(torch::Tensor& out, torch::Tensor const& a,
                                torch::Tensor const& bt_nzs,
                                torch::Tensor const& bt_meta,
                                EpilogueArgs&&... epilogue_params) {
  using ElementAB = typename Gemm::ElementAB;
  using ElementD = typename Gemm::ElementD;

  // Interface stride expected from the argument a (will get transposed)
  // We compute C^T = B^T * A^T, but we assume B is transposed before
  // compression and hence the bt_* naming
  using LayoutB = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::LayoutA;
  using LayoutE = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::LayoutE;

  // M, N, K after transposition
  int32_t m = out.size(1);
  int32_t n = out.size(0);
  int32_t k = a.size(1);

  int64_t lda = a.stride(0);
  int64_t ldc = out.stride(0);

  using StrideA = Stride<int64_t, Int<1>, int64_t>;
  using StrideC = Stride<Int<1>, int64_t, int64_t>;

  StrideA a_stride{lda, Int<1>{}, Int<0>{}};
  StrideC c_stride{Int<1>{}, ldc, Int<0>{}};

  using GemmKernel = typename Gemm::GemmKernel;
  typename GemmKernel::ProblemShape prob_shape{m, n, k, 1};

  using ElementE = typename GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::ElementE;
  using SparseConfig = typename GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::SparseConfig;

  LayoutB b_layout = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(prob_shape);
  LayoutE e_layout = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(prob_shape);

  auto a_ptr = static_cast<ElementAB*>(a.data_ptr());
  auto b_ptr = static_cast<ElementAB*>(bt_nzs.data_ptr());
  auto e_ptr = static_cast<ElementE*>(bt_meta.data_ptr());
  typename GemmKernel::MainloopArguments mainloop_args{
      b_ptr, b_layout, a_ptr, a_stride, e_ptr, e_layout};

  auto c_ptr = static_cast<ElementD*>(out.data_ptr());
  typename GemmKernel::EpilogueArguments epilogue_args{
      Gemm::Epilogue::prepare_args(
          std::forward<EpilogueArgs>(epilogue_params)...),
      c_ptr, c_stride, c_ptr, c_stride};

  typename GemmKernel::Arguments args{cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
                                      prob_shape, mainloop_args, epilogue_args};

  // Launch the CUTLASS GEMM kernel.
  using GemmOp = cutlass::gemm::device::GemmUniversalAdapter<GemmKernel>;
  GemmOp gemm_op;
  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm_op.can_implement(args));

  size_t workspace_size = gemm_op.get_workspace_size(args);
  auto const workspace_options =
      torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(a.device());
  auto workspace = torch::empty(workspace_size, workspace_options);

  auto stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(a.get_device());

  cutlass::Status status = gemm_op.run(args, workspace.data_ptr(), stream);
  CUTLASS_CHECK(status);
}

## vLLM PR 调查完成

**结论**：PR #8708 实际不可用、vLLM 的 sparse 代码已废，不可复用。但**确认了我们的 transpose trick 写法正确**：

```cpp
// vLLM sparse_scaled_mm_c3x.cuh - sm_90 only, BF16/INT8/FP8, no block-scale
// "We compute C^T = B^T * A^T, but we assume B is transposed before compression"
int32_t m = out.size(1);  // m = N_user
int32_t n = out.size(0);  // n = M_user
ProblemShape{m, n, k, 1};                     // (N_user, M_user, K) — 跟我的一致
StrideC c_stride{1, ldc, 0};                  // ColMajor output — 跟我的一致
MainloopArguments{b_ptr, b_layout, a_ptr, a_stride, e_ptr, e_layout};
//                ^weight(CUTLASS A=sparse)   ^activation(CUTLASS B=dense)
```

vLLM 历史 sparse 代码 **只支持 sm_90 Hopper、只支持 INT8/FP8/BF16（无 block-scale）**，已删除。我们这个 sm_120 + NVFP4 路径**必须自己写**，没现成的可抄。

{
  "command": "cat > /user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/diag_transpose_trick.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"Test if dense FP4 kernel handles the 'transpose trick' correctly.\n\nIf we call dense kernel as `dense(a=w, b=x, sfa=w_sf, sfb=x_sf)`, the output should be D' = w @ x.T = (x @ w.T).T = D.T.\nIf this works, my sparse setup (which uses A=weight, B=activation, SFA=w_sf, SFB=x_sf) is structurally sound.\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nimport sgl_kernel\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nDEVICE = \"cuda\"\n\nM, N, K = 128, 4096, 4096\n\n# random (not 2:4 pruned for now, since we're testing dense kernel only)\nw_bf = torch.randn(N, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.05\nx_bf = torch.randn(M, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5\n\nw_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()\nw_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\nw_packed, w_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_gs)\nx_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()\nx_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\nx_packed, x_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_gs)\nalpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).to(torch.float32)\n\n# Variant 1: dense(a=x, b=w, sfa=x_sf, sfb=w_sf) → D = x @ w.T  [M, N]\nout_v1 = sgl_kernel.cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(\n    x_packed, w_packed, x_sf, w_sf, alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n\n# Variant 2: dense(a=w, b=x, sfa=w_sf, sfb=x_sf) → D' = w @ x.T  [N, M]\nout_v2 = sgl_kernel.cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(\n    w_packed, x_packed, w_sf, x_sf, alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n\nprint(f\"out_v1 shape: {out_v1.shape}  (expect [M={M}, N={N}])\")\nprint(f\"out_v2 shape: {out_v2.shape}  (expect [N={N}, M={M}])\")\nprint(f\"out_v1[0,:6] = {[round(v, 4) for v in out_v1[0,:6].tolist()]}\")\nprint(f\"out_v2[:6,0] = {[round(v, 4) for v in out_v2[:6,0].tolist()]}\")\nprint(f\"  (these should match if v1 = v2.T)\")\n\n# Compare v1 vs v2.T\nout_v2T = out_v2.t()\ndiff = (out_v1.float() - out_v2T.float()).abs()\nprint(f\"\\nDiff v1 - v2.T:  max={diff.max():.5f}  mean={diff.mean():.5f}\")\nprint(f\"  ratio max/|v1|.mean = {diff.max().item() / out_v1.float().abs().mean().item():.4f}\")\nEOF\npython /user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/diag_transpose_trick.py 2>&1 | tail -20\n",
  "description": "Test dense kernel transpose trick"
}

If not, compressor is the bug.\n\"\"\"\nimport torch\nfrom build import build\nimport sgl_kernel\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nDEVICE = \"cuda\"\next = build(verbose=False)\n\nN, K = 128, 128\n\n# Build a sparse weight with KNOWN values:\n# Positions 0,1 of each group of 4 = 0\n# Positions 2,3 of each group of 4 = small random non-zero\nw_bf = torch.randn(N, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5\nw_bf = w_bf.view(N, K // 4, 4)\nw_bf[:, :, 0] = 0.0\nw_bf[:, :, 1] = 0.0\nw_bf = w_bf.view(N, K)\n\n# NVFP4 quant\nw_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()\nw_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\nw_packed, w_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_gs)\n# w_packed shape: [N, K/2] uint8. Each byte = (high_nibble: pos i+1, low_nibble: pos i).\nprint(f\"w_packed shape: {w_packed.shape}\")  # [128, 64]\nprint(f\"w_packed[0,:8] = {w_packed[0,:8].tolist()}\")\n\n# Compress\nam_a, ak_a, am_e, ak_e = ext.sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)\nprint(f\"compressed shape: w[{am_a}, {ak_a // 2}] meta[{am_e}, {ak_e}]\")\nw_compressed = torch.zeros((am_a, ak_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\nw_meta = torch.zeros((am_e, ak_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\next.sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed, w_compressed, w_meta)\nprint(f\"w_compressed[0,:8]: {w_compressed[0,:8].tolist()}\")\nprint(f\"w_meta[0,:8]:       {w_meta[0,:8].tolist()}\")\n\n# Manual decompression for CUTLASS NVFP4 sparse:\n# Compressor processes chunks of 8 FP4 logical elements (= 4 packed bytes).\n# Within each chunk, it picks the 2 bytes that are non-zero (4 of 8 FP4 elements kept).\n# Metadata: 2 bits per kept-byte position. Two bytes' positions in 4 bits = 0xN.\n# \n# For our test pattern (positions 0,1 zero; 2,3 nonzero in every group-of-4 FP4):\n# - Byte 0 (pos 0,1) = zero\n# - Byte 1 (pos 2,3) = nonzero\n# - Byte 2 (pos 4,5) = zero\n# - Byte 3 (pos 6,7) = nonzero\n# Expected: chunk's non_zero bytes at log_idx [1, 3] → metadata bits = (0b01 | 0b11 << 2) = 0b1101 = 0xD\n# w_compressed[r, chunk_phys_start..+2] should hold the original byte 1 and byte 3.\n\n# Let's check row 0:\nrow = 0\nprint(f\"\\nRow {row} analysis (every chunk should keep byte 1 and byte 3 of each 4-byte chunk in original):\")\nfor chunk_idx in range(min(4, K // 8)):  # first few chunks\n    orig_byte0 = w_packed[row, chunk_idx * 4 + 0].item()\n    orig_byte1 = w_packed[row, chunk_idx * 4 + 1].item()\n    orig_byte2 = w_packed[row, chunk_idx * 4 + 2].item()\n    orig_byte3 = w_packed[row, chunk_idx * 4 + 3].item()\n    comp_byte0 = w_compressed[row, chunk_idx * 2 + 0].item()\n    comp_byte1 = w_compressed[row, chunk_idx * 2 + 1].item()\n    # Meta byte for this chunk: chunk_idx covers 8 logical FP4 elts = 4 bytes; \n    # meta has 4 bits per chunk (since 2:4 = 2 bits per kept-byte × 2 kept-bytes = 4 bits)\n    # Two chunks per meta byte.\n    meta_byte = w_meta[row, chunk_idx // 2].item()\n    meta_nib = (meta_byte >> (4 * (chunk_idx % 2))) & 0xF\n    print(f\"  chunk {chunk_idx}: orig bytes [{orig_byte0:3d},{orig_byte1:3d},{orig_byte2:3d},{orig_byte3:3d}]  \"\n          f\"compressed [{comp_byte0:3d},{comp_byte1:3d}]  meta_nib=0x{meta_nib:X}\")\n    expect_comp = [orig_byte1, orig_byte3]\n    actual_comp = [comp_byte0, comp_byte1]\n    match = expect_comp == actual_comp\n    expect_meta = 0xD  # 0b1101 = (0b11 << 2) | 0b01\n    meta_match = meta_nib == expect_meta\n    print(f\"    expect compressed=[{orig_byte1},{orig_byte3}] meta=0xD: {'MATCH' if match and meta_match else 'MISMATCH'}\")\nEOF\npython /user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/diag_compress_only.py 2>&1 | tail -25\n",

**找到 BUG 了！🎯**

CUTLASS sm120 sparse NVFP4 kernel 强制使用 **SfVectorSize=32**（line 169-170），而 sgl_kernel quant 产出 **SfVectorSize=16** 的 SF。这是 2x granularity 不匹配！

立刻验证假说：

> AGENT

**找到 BUG 了！🎯（这次是真的）**

CUTLASS sm120 sparse NVFP4 是 **byte-pair 4:8 sparsity**（每 4 字节里挑 2 字节），不是任意 2:4！我们的 magnitude-prune 是"任意 2 of 4 FP4 位置"，从而违反 byte-pair 约束。

实证：weight 单组 4 位置只放 2 个非零：
- `(0,1)` 同字节 → sparse=dense ✓
- `(2,3)` 同字节 → sparse=dense ✓
- `(0,2)`/`(0,3)`/`(1,2)`/`(1,3)` 跨字节 → sparse=dense/2 ❌

立刻验证修复：用 byte-pair-aligned 剪枝重测。

  "command": "cat > /user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/diag_pair_aligned.py <<'EOF'\n\"\"\"Byte-pair-aligned magnitude prune: pick pair (0,1) or (2,3) of each 4-group based on which has higher sum |val|.\"\"\"\nimport torch\nfrom build import build\nimport sgl_kernel\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nDEVICE = \"cuda\"\next = build(verbose=False)\n\n\ndef pair_aligned_prune(w):\n    \"\"\"Per group of 4 elts, keep pair (0,1) or (2,3) with larger sum |.|.\"\"\"\n    out, in_ = w.shape\n    g = w.view(out, in_ // 4, 4)\n    pair01 = g[..., :2].abs().sum(-1)  # sum |.| of positions 0,1\n    pair23 = g[..., 2:].abs().sum(-1)  # sum |.| of positions 2,3\n    keep_high_pair = (pair23 >= pair01).unsqueeze(-1)  # bool [out, in/4, 1]\n    mask = torch.zeros_like(g, dtype=torch.bool)\n    mask[..., :2] = ~keep_high_pair\n    mask[..., 2:] = keep_high_pair\n    return (g * mask).view(out, in_)\n\n\ndef run(M, N, K, label):\n    w_bf = torch.randn(N, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.05\n    w_bf = pair_aligned_prune(w_bf)\n    x_bf = torch.randn(M, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5\n\n    w_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()\n    w_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    w_packed, w_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_gs)\n    x_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()\n    x_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    x_packed, x_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_gs)\n    alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).to(torch.float32)\n\n    out_dense = sgl_kernel.cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(\n        x_packed, w_packed, x_sf, w_sf, alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    am_a, ak_a, am_e, ak_e = ext.sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)\n    w_compressed = torch.zeros((am_a, ak_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    w_meta = torch.zeros((am_e, ak_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    ext.sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed, w_compressed, w_meta)\n    out_sparse = torch.empty((M, N), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    ext.scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(out_sparse, x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)\n\n    out_bf_ref = (x_bf.float() @ w_bf.float().t()).to(torch.bfloat16)\n    diff_sd = (out_sparse.float() - out_dense.float()).abs()\n    diff_sb = (out_sparse.float() - out_bf_ref.float()).abs()\n    print(f\"=== {label}  M={M} N={N} K={K} ===\")\n    print(f\"  out_dense[0,:6]   = {[round(v, 4) for v in out_dense[0,:6].tolist()]}\")\n    print(f\"  out_sparse[0,:6]  = {[round(v, 4) for v in out_sparse[0,:6].tolist()]}\")\n    print(f\"  diff sparse-dense max={diff_sd.max():.4f}  mean={diff_sd.mean():.4f}\")\n    print(f\"  diff sparse-bf16ref max={diff_sb.max():.4f}  mean={diff_sb.mean():.4f}\")\n    print(f\"  ratio sparse_mean/dense_mean = {(out_sparse.float().abs().mean()/out_dense.float().abs().mean()).item():.4f}\")\n\n\nrun(128, 128, 128, \"tiny\")\nrun(128, 4096, 4096, \"medium\")\nrun(4096, 4096, 16384, \"large\")\nEOF\npython /user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/diag_pair_aligned.py 2>&1 | tail -25\n",

273	// For SM120 MMA F8F6F4 input fp4, the operand A/B are load from ld.matrix. 
274	// ld.matrix b4x16_p64 places FP4 data at the first four bits in each
275	// eight-bit container, whereas MMA F8F6F4 expects the four-bit data to be in 
276	// the middle of the eight-bit container. Thus, e2m1 operands being fed
277	// to MMA F8F6F4 must be shifted left by two bits.
278	// 0b0000ABCD --> 0b00ABCD00
279	// NOTE: Same transformation is NOT needed for FP6 and FP8.
280	template<class AType, class BType, class... MMAArgs, class Tensor>
281	CUTLASS_DEVICE void
282	fp4_shift_A(SM120_SPARSE_16x8x64_TN<AType, BType, MMAArgs ...> const&, Tensor&& tensor) {
283	  using RegisterTypeA = typename remove_extent<typename
284	                        SM120_SPARSE_16x8x64_TN<AType, BType, MMAArgs ...>::ARegisters>::type;
285	  if constexpr (cute::is_same_v<AType, cutlass::float_e2m1_t>) {
286	    cute::transform(recast<RegisterTypeA>(tensor), [](RegisterTypeA& v){ return v << 2; });
287	  }
288	}
289	template<class AType, class BType, class... MMAArgs, class Tensor>
290	CUTLASS_DEVICE void
291	fp4_shift_B(SM120_SPARSE_16x8x64_TN<AType, BType, MMAArgs ...> const&, Tensor&& tensor) {
292	  using RegisterTypeB = typename remove_extent<typename
293	                        SM120_SPARSE_16x8x64_TN<AType, BType, MMAArgs ...>::BRegisters>::type;
294	  if constexpr (cute::is_same_v<BType, cutlass::float_e2m1_t>) {
295	    cute::transform(recast<RegisterTypeB>(tensor), [](RegisterTypeB& v){ return v << 2; });
296	  }
297	}

43	// This class is purposely not compatible with anything -- know what you're doing if you attempt to use it
44	template <int Sparsity, class T>
45	struct sparse_elem
46	{
47	  static constexpr int sparsity = Sparsity;
48	  using raw_type = T;
49	  T elem_;
50	
51	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr
52	  explicit sparse_elem(T const& elem = {}) : elem_(elem) {}
53	
54	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr friend bool operator==(sparse_elem const& a, sparse_elem const& b) { return a.elem_ == b.elem_; }
55	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr friend bool operator!=(sparse_elem const& a, sparse_elem const& b) { return a.elem_ != b.elem_; }
56	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr friend bool operator< (sparse_elem const& a, sparse_elem const& b) { return a.elem_ <  b.elem_; }
57	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr friend bool operator<=(sparse_elem const& a, sparse_elem const& b) { return a.elem_ <= b.elem_; }
58	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr friend bool operator> (sparse_elem const& a, sparse_elem const& b) { return a.elem_ >  b.elem_; }
59	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr friend bool operator>=(sparse_elem const& a, sparse_elem const& b) { return a.elem_ >= b.elem_; }

101	struct sparse_ptr : iter_adaptor<Iterator, sparse_ptr<Sparsity, Iterator>>
102	{
103	  using reference    = typename iterator_traits<Iterator>::reference;
104	  using element_type = typename iterator_traits<Iterator>::element_type;
105	  using value_type   = typename iterator_traits<Iterator>::value_type;
106	
107	  // Sanity, for now
108	  static_assert(is_sparse<value_type>::value, "Enforce sparse value-type");
109	  static_assert(Sparsity == iter_value_t<Iterator>::sparsity, "Enforce sparsity S");
110	  static_assert(not is_sparse_ptr<Iterator>::value, "Enforce sparse singleton");
111	
112	  template <class Index>
113	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr
114	  sparse_ptr operator+(Index const& i) const {
115	    // Only allow offset by multiples of the sparsity factor,
116	    // else the misalignments become a bug. E.g. (sparse_ptr<8,I>{} + 7) + 7
117	    // Motivation for subsparse_iterator or generalization of subbyte_iterator?
118	    assert(i % Sparsity == 0);
119	    return {this->get() + i / Sparsity};
120	  }
121	
122	  template <class Index>
123	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE constexpr
124	  reference operator[](Index const& i) const {
125	    // Allow offset by any value and dereference.
126	    // Not implemented in terms of sparse_ptr::op+()
127	    return *(this->get() + i / Sparsity);
128	  }
129	};

277	// to MMA F8F6F4 must be shifted left by two bits.

## 当前进展总结

### 已确认的事实

1. **transpose trick 正确**：`diag_transpose_trick.py` 证实 dense kernel 对称性 — 调用 `dense(a=w, b=x)` 输出 = `(x @ w.T).T`，diff=0.000。
2. **compressor 正确**：`diag_compress_only.py` 手动解压验证 — 对已知 2:4 pattern（pos 0,1 零；pos 2,3 非零），元数据生成无误。
3. **CUTLASS sm120 稀疏 FP4 不是任意 2:4**：`diag_ratio.py` 测试 — 单组单非零四个位置都过；两个非零里只有同字节 (0,1) 或 (2,3) 过，跨字节 (0,2)/(0,3)/(1,2)/(1,3) 都掉到 0.5×。

### 新发现的卡点

4. **字节对齐裁剪也不够**：`diag_pair_aligned.py` — 即使把裁剪改成"每组保留高能量字节对"，ratio 仍 0.87-0.90，不是 1.0。说明 byte-pair 之外还有一层约束没满足。

5. **MMA traits 线索**（刚 grep 到）：
   - `SM120_SPARSE_16x8x64`（dense F4 / SfVS=16 路径不走这）：`ValTypeA = sparse_elem<2, a_type>` — 2:1 element 压缩，标准 2:4
   - `SM120_SPARSE_16x8x128_TN_VS`（sparse NVFP4 SfVS=32 实际走的）：**`ValTypeA = sparse_elem<4, uint8_t>`** — 4:1 字节压缩 = **2 of 8 字节 = 4 of 16 FP4 元素 = 25% 密度**

如果上面读懂对，CUTLASS sm120 sparse NVFP4 实际是 **4:16 sparsity（25%）而不是 2:4（50%）**，这能解释为什么字节对齐 2:4 出来还差 0.87-0.90 倍。

### 接下来

需要验证：把裁剪改成"每 16 个 FP4 元素（8 字节）只留 2 字节"，看 ratio 是否到 1.0。如果是，那 magnitude-pruning 路径需要从 2:4 改成 4:16，这会改变整个量化产物（密度对半砍，潜在压缩比从 2× → 4×，但准确率代价大）。

工作目前阻塞在 phase 3 numerical test。是否要继续按 4:16 假设写诊断？

45	// Returns the maximum number of smem tiles that can be used with a given smem capacity, or overrides with manual count. 
46	template <
47	  int CapacityBytes,
48	  class ElementAMma,
49	  class ElementB,
50	  class ElementEMma,
51	  class TileShapeMNK,
52	  class TileShapeSFA,
53	  class TileShapeSFB,
54	  int stages
55	>
56	constexpr int
57	sm120_compute_stage_count_or_override_blockscaled_sparse(StageCount<stages> stage_count) {
58	  return stages;
59	}
60	
61	// Returns the maximum number of smem tiles that can be used with a given smem capacity.
62	// With limited SMEM capacity, F8/F6/F4 MMA with larger tiles, such as 128x128, cannot
63	// get 2 stages. Therefore, use 1.5 stages for B.
64	template <
65	  int CapacityBytes,
66	  class ElementAMma,
67	  class ElementB,
68	  class ElementEMma,
69	  class TileShapeMNK,
70	  class TileShapeSFA,
71	  class TileShapeSFB,
72	  int carveout_bytes
73	>
74	constexpr auto
75	sm120_compute_stage_count_or_override_blockscaled_sparse(StageCountAutoCarveout<carveout_bytes> stage_count) {
76	  // For MXF8F6F4 & MXF4NVF4 sub-bytes, ElementAMma will be passed in as sparse_elem<uint8_t, Sparsity>, and
77	  //    ElementB will be passed in as uint8_t
78	  // Each stage include (CollectiveMma::SharedStorage)
79	  // 1. smem for A/E and smem for B (CollectiveMma::SharedStorage::TensorStorage)
80	  // 2. smem for SFA and smem for SFB (CollectiveMma::SharedStorage::TensorStorage, independent of input size b.c. sizeof(sf) is fixed)
81	  // 3. one MainloopPipeline = (CollectiveMma::SharedStorage::PipelineStorage = PipelineTmaSparseUmmaAsync, three arrive-wait barrier)
82	  constexpr auto mainloop_pipeline_bytes = sizeof(cutlass::arch::ClusterBarrier) * 3;
83	  // a_bits, e_bits already consider sparsity through `sizeof_bits(ElementAMma)
84	  // NOTE: sizeof_bits<sparse_elem<>> return integral_ratio instead of size_t.
85	  constexpr auto a_bits = cute::sizeof_bits_v<ElementAMma>;
86	  constexpr auto b_bits = cute::sizeof_bits_v<ElementB>;
87	  constexpr auto e_bits = cute::sizeof_bits_v<ElementEMma>;
88	  constexpr auto stage_sfa_bytes = size(filter_zeros(TileShapeSFA{}));
89	  constexpr auto stage_sfb_bytes = size(filter_zeros(TileShapeSFB{}));
90	
91	  constexpr int stage_bytes =
92	    cutlass::bits_to_bytes(a_bits * size<0>(TileShapeMNK{}) * size<2>(TileShapeMNK{})) +
93	    cutlass::bits_to_bytes(b_bits * size<1>(TileShapeMNK{}) * size<2>(TileShapeMNK{})) +
94	    cutlass::bits_to_bytes(e_bits * size<0>(TileShapeMNK{}) * size<2>(TileShapeMNK{})) +
95	    static_cast<int>(mainloop_pipeline_bytes + stage_sfa_bytes + stage_sfb_bytes);
96	
97	  // When stage >=2, it can be used directly.
98	  constexpr int stages = (CapacityBytes - carveout_bytes) / stage_bytes;
99	  if constexpr (stages >= 2) {
100	    return cute::make_tuple(stages, stages);
101	  }
102	
103	  // When stage < 2, try to use half of TileK, aka size<2>(TileShapeMNK{}),
104	  //   and increase its stages. Eg. when input TileK is 256, instead of
105	  //   buffering K=256 with 2 stages, it uses K=128, with 3 stages. From the
106	  //   kernel's TileK view (K=256), B is 1.5 stages.
107	  // Note, if B apply 1.5 stages, metadata is kept in L2, as limited SMEM capacity.
108	  //  A/B is with asymmetric DMA and buffering, as they are with different
109	  //  TileK and buffer advance steps.
110	  constexpr int stage_bytes_b15 =
111	    cutlass::bits_to_bytes(a_bits * size<0>(TileShapeMNK{}) * size<2>(TileShapeMNK{})) +
112	    cutlass::bits_to_bytes(b_bits * size<1>(TileShapeMNK{}) * size<2>(TileShapeMNK{})) * 3 / 4 +
113	    static_cast<int>(mainloop_pipeline_bytes + stage_sfa_bytes + stage_sfb_bytes);
114	
115	  constexpr int stages_b15 = (CapacityBytes - carveout_bytes) / stage_bytes_b15;
116	  if constexpr (stages_b15 >= 2) {
117	    return cute::make_tuple(stages_b15, 3);
118	  }
119	
120	  return cute::make_tuple(stages_b15, stages_b15);
121	}

267	  // 4 is chosen to make consecutive 32bits of data to have scale factors for only a single row (col). 32bits corresponds to the TMEM word size 
268	  using Blk_MN    = typename Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::Blk_MN;

274	  // So that TileShape for scaling factor needs to be defined as a multiple of Blk_MN.
275	  using TileShapeSf_MNK = decltype(make_shape(ceil_div(size<0>(TileShape_MNK{}), Blk_MN{}) * Blk_MN{},
276	                                           ceil_div(size<1>(TileShape_MNK{}), Blk_MN{}) * Blk_MN{}, 
277	                                           shape<2>(TileShape_MNK{})));

280	  using mnBasicBlockShape  =  Shape<_32,_4>;
281	  using mnBasicBlockStride = Stride<_16,_4>;
282	  using kBasicBlockShape  = Shape<Int<SFVectorSize>, Int<MMA_NSF>>;
283	  using kBasicBlockStride = Stride<_0, _1>;
284	  
285	  using sSFA_shapeM       = decltype(prepend(size<0>(TileShape_MNK{}) / Blk_MN{},   mnBasicBlockShape{}));
286	  using sSF_strideMN      = decltype(prepend(                        Blk_Elems{},  mnBasicBlockStride{}));
287	  using sSFA_strideM      = sSF_strideMN;
288	  using sSF_shapeK        = decltype(prepend(make_shape( Blk_SF{}/Int<MMA_NSF>{},   size<2>(TileShape_MNK{}) / Int<SFVectorSize>{} / Blk_SF{}),  kBasicBlockShape{}));
289	  
290	  using sSFA_strideK      = decltype(prepend(make_stride(         Int<MMA_NSF>{},   size<0>(TileShape_MNK{}) / Blk_MN{} * Blk_Elems{}), kBasicBlockStride{}));
291	  using sSFA_shape        = decltype(make_shape(  sSFA_shapeM{},   sSF_shapeK{}));
292	  using sSFA_stride       = decltype(make_stride(sSFA_strideM{}, sSFA_strideK{}));
293	  using SmemLayoutAtomSFA = decltype(make_layout(  sSFA_shape{},  sSFA_stride{}));
294	
295	  using sSFB_shapeN       = decltype(prepend(size<1>(TileShapeSf_MNK{}) / Blk_MN{},   mnBasicBlockShape{}));
296	  using sSFB_strideN      = sSF_strideMN;
297	  using sSFB_strideK      = decltype(prepend(make_stride(Int<MMA_NSF>{},   size<1>(TileShapeSf_MNK{}) / Blk_MN{} * Blk_Elems{}), kBasicBlockStride{}));
298	  using sSFB_shape        = decltype(make_shape(  sSFB_shapeN{},   sSF_shapeK{}));
299	  using sSFB_stride       = decltype(make_stride(sSFB_strideN{}, sSFB_strideK{}));
300	  using SmemLayoutAtomSFB = decltype(make_layout(  sSFB_shape{},  sSFB_stride{}));
301	
302	  using SmemLayoutAtomsA = decltype(cute::make_tuple(SmemLayoutAtomA{}, SmemLayoutAtomSFA{}));
303	  using SmemLayoutAtomsB = decltype(cute::make_tuple(SmemLayoutAtomB{}, SmemLayoutAtomSFB{}));
304	
305	  // Get stages from shared memory usage. 
306	  static constexpr auto PipelineStages = detail::sm120_compute_stage_count_or_override_blockscaled_sparse<
307	    detail::sm120_smem_capacity_bytes, sparse_elem<ElementAMma::sparsity, SmemAllocTypeA>,
308	    SmemAllocTypeB, ElementEMma, TileShape_MNK, SmemLayoutAtomSFA, SmemLayoutAtomSFB>(StageCountType{});
309	  static constexpr uint32_t PipelineStagesA = get<0>(PipelineStages);

311	  // In normal case, when A/B with same stages, E can be kept in SMEM, with A/B stages.
312	  // When A/B is with different stages, it is design for keeping E in GMEM/L2 to saving
313	  //    SMEM usage. StageE is defined to 0 for this case.
314	  static constexpr uint32_t PipelineStagesE = PipelineStagesA == PipelineStagesB ? PipelineStagesA : 0;
315	
316	  static constexpr uint32_t SchedulerPipelineStageCount = 2;

318	  // Choose dispatch policy based on different required stages.
319	  using DispatchPolicy = MainloopSm120TmaWarpSpecializedSparseBlockScaled<PipelineStagesA,
320	                                                                          PipelineStagesB,
321	                                                                          PipelineStagesE,
322	                                                                          SchedulerPipelineStageCount,
323	                                                                          ClusterShape_MNK>;

325	  using StridePairB = decltype(cute::make_tuple(cutlass::gemm::TagToStrideB_t<GmemLayoutBTag>{}, Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::deduce_layoutSFB()));

340	      SmemLayoutAtomsB,
341	      SmemCopyAtomsB,
342	      cute::identity

> AGENT

下面是完整答案。

## 为什么不能直接做 2:4 元素级稀疏

**根本原因：CUTLASS sm120 sparse NVFP4 路径被锁死在「字节级」稀疏，不是元素级**

链条如下（每一环都查到证据）：

1. **PTX 层：sm120 硬件实际有两套 sparse FP4 MMA**：
   - `mma.kind::f8f6f4.sp.m16n8k64`：1 个 FP4 单独占 1 字节（左移2位的 8-bit 容器），**元素级 2:4**（这才是真正的 2:4）
   - `mma.kind::mxf4nvf4.sp.scale_vec::4X.m16n8k128`：2 个 FP4 紧凑塞 1 字节（low/high nibble），**字节级 2:4**（= 元素级 4:8 byte-aligned）

2. **CUTLASS atom selector**：`cute::rr_blockscaled_sparse_op_selector_sm120()`（`mma_sm120_sparse.hpp:3434-3442`）
   ```cpp
   if (UseF8F6F4) return SM120_SPARSE_16x8x64_TN_VS{};    // 元素 2:4
   else           return SM120_SPARSE_16x8x128_TN_VS{};   // 字节 2:4
   ```

3. **`UseF8F6F4` 由 schedule 决定**（`sm120_blockscaled_sparse_mma_builder.inl:187`）：
   ```cpp
   static constexpr bool UseMxf8f6f4 = Instr == BlockScaledInstr::MXF4F6F8;
   ```
   `KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedNvf4Sm120`（我们走的 schedule）→ NVF4 分支 → 必然选 16x8x128。

4. **chunk 大小写死**（`sm1xx_sparse_config.inl:106-109`）：
   ```cpp
   LogicalElemsAPerChunk = IsF4 ? 8 : ...
   PhysicalElemsAPerChunk = 8 / 2 = 4
   ```
   配合 compressor `ElemsARawPerElementAMmaRaw=2`（packed FP4 1 byte 2 元素），实际 `OneChunkSizeA = 8/2 = 4` —— **compressor 按字节迭代，每 4 字节挑 2 字节**。元数据 4 bits/chunk 只够编码字节级选位。

5. **`find_vector_size` 锁 SfVS**（`sm1xx_common.inl:169-170`）：`KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedNvf4Sm120` → 强制 SfVecSize=32。
   sm120 不存在 SfVS=16 的 sparse NVFP4 schedule。

## SM120_SPARSE_16x8x64 路径能走吗

理论可以，**但代价很大**：

- 必须用 `KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedMxf8f6f4Sm120` schedule 才能触发 `UseMxf8f6f4=true`
- 这个 schedule `find_vector_size` 锁死 **SfVecSize=64**（`sm1xx_common.inl:179`）
- SfVS=64 ⇒ 64 个 FP4 元素共享 1 个 ue4m3 scale —— 退化成 MXFP4-粗粒度，**比 NVFP4 SfVS=16 精度差很多**，相当于放弃 NVFP4
- 现有所有 phase 1/2 量化产物 + layer sparsity 探测 + 校准管线全部基于 NVFP4 SfVS=16，都得重做

**绕过 builder 自己手写 collective**理论可行但工作量约等于重写 GEMM：要抄 builder ~350 行 + 改 atom 强制 16x8x64 + 重写 SF layout + 改 compressor 用元素粒度。

## byte-pair prune 仍 ratio 0.87-0.90 的真因（在字节级路径里）

字节对齐裁剪是**必要但不充分**：BF16 阶段裁的字节对，NVFP4 quant 后字节内 2 个 nibble 可能其中一个被 quant 到 0，整个字节实际只剩 1 个非零 nibble；compressor `sm90_sparse_gemm_compressor.hpp:429-444` 触发"1 非零"corner case 把它拉到固定位置，metadata 信息丢失。

**正确做法**：mask 要在 **NVFP4 quant 之后**对 packed byte 做，按 byte 是否全 0 选 top-2 字节，而不是在 BF16 阶段对 FP4 元素裁剪。

## 我的建议

短路径（验证可行性）：留在字节级 sparse NVFP4，把 magnitude prune 改成 quant-after byte-pair（每 4 字节 = 8 FP4 元素，按 byte 整体能量选 top-2 字节），ratio 应该能到 1.0。这是 4:8 byte-aligned 元素稀疏，密度 50% 不变，但实际能用磁性是"成对 FP4"——量化前的 mask plan 要重做。

长路径（真要元素级 2:4）：要么接受 SfVS=64 MXFP4 精度退步，要么自己写 collective。两个都不划算。

要不要先按短路径写个 quant-after byte-pair 的 mask，确认能拿到 ratio=1.0？

关键：在 packed 字节空间裁剪\n    w_packed_pruned = byte_pair_prune_packed(w_packed)\n    byte_density = (w_packed_pruned != 0).float().mean().item()\n    print(f\"  byte density after prune = {byte_density:.3f} (expect 0.50)\")\n\n    x_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()\n    x_gs = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_max, 1e-6), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)\n    x_packed, x_sf = sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_gs)\n    alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).to(torch.float32)\n\n    # dense kernel 跑同一份 pruned packed bytes（ground truth）\n    out_dense = sgl_kernel.cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(\n        x_packed, w_packed_pruned, x_sf, w_sf, alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,\n    )\n\n    # sparse kernel\n    am_a, ak_a, am_e, ak_e = ext.sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)\n    w_compressed = torch.zeros((am_a, ak_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    w_meta = torch.zeros((am_e, ak_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    ext.sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed_pruned, w_compressed, w_meta)\n\n    out_sparse = torch.empty((M, N), device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    ext.scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(out_sparse, x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)\n\n    diff = (out_sparse.float() - out_dense.float()).abs()\n    max_abs = diff.max().item()\n    out_norm = out_dense.float().abs().mean().item()\n    sparse_norm = out_sparse.float().abs().mean().item()\n    ratio = sparse_norm / max(out_norm, 1e-9)\n    rel = (diff / out_dense.float().abs().clamp(min=1e-3)).mean().item()\n    print(f\"  out_dense  mean(|x|)={out_norm:.4f}\")\n    print(f\"  out_sparse mean(|x|)={sparse_norm:.4f}\")\n    print(f\"  ratio sparse/dense = {ratio:.4f}  (expect ~1.00)\")\n    print(f\"  max_abs_err={max_abs:.5f}  rel_err={rel:.5f}\")\n    print(f\"  out_dense [0,:6]  = {[round(v.item(),4) for v in out_dense[0,:6]]}\")\n    print(f\"  out_sparse[0,:6]  = {[round(v.item(),4) for v in out_sparse[0,:6]]}\")\n\n\nfor shape in [(128, 256, 256), (128, 4096, 4096), (256, 4096, 4096), (4096, 4096, 16384)]:\n    run(*shape)\n"
}
