TODO\"\n- (Plan C) 混合：87 层中找精度敏感度低的子集走 sparse（需要 layer-by-layer 敏感性 sweep，类似 `data_driven_layer_scan.py`）\n\n---\n\n## 9 — 2026-05-12 进度：OBR pipeline 上线（取代裸 magnitude prune）\n\n### 9.1 选定路径：OBR Stage 1 + dense GPTQ NVFP4\n\n调研四个方向（NVIDIA modelopt / vLLM-llmcompressor / 学术论文 / CUTLASS 官方）一致结论：**截至 2026-05 没有任何现成的 \"BF16 → byte-aligned 4:8 sparse NVFP4\" pipeline**：\n- NVIDIA modelopt `examples/llm_ptq/README.md` 明确写 *\"Unified checkpoint export currently does not support sparsity\"*\n- llmcompressor 2026 Q1 roadmap (issue #2262) 不带 sparse；唯一 sparse+量化 example 是 W4A16 INT4，且要 SFT\n- HF cortecs 的 `Qwen3-8B-sparse-nvfp4a16` 是 dense-pack（`sparsity_config: null`），不能驱动 CUTLASS sparse kernel，他们自己标 \"experimental, not for production\"\n- **byte-aligned 4:8 是 sm_120 mma.sp 硬件硬约束**（CUTLASS `sm1xx_sparse_config.inl:106-112` `LogicalElemsAPerChunk=_8, ElementEBitsPerChunk=_4` + PTX `mma.sync.aligned.kind::mxf4nvf4.sp...m16n8k128`，没有 element 2:4 变体）\n\n理论支撑：ICLR 2025 *Interplay* (2405.20935) Theorem 3.7 给出 error bound `∝(M-N)/M`；byte-aligned 把 pair 内 outlier 强制清零 → NVFP4 group-16 block max-scale 漂 → 同 block 其他 element 量化噪声放大 ⇒ 解释了 byte-4:8 vs element-2:4 的 1.28× 损伤差距（实测 row-rel-err 0.45 vs 0.36）。\n\n学术界目前**唯一明确做 4-bit + 50% sparse 的开源方案是 OBR (NeurIPS 2025, arxiv 2509.11177)**。OBR 用闭式 Hessian-weighted 误差转嫁：\n$$\\Delta w_R = +H_{RR}^{-1} H_{RE}\\, w_E^0$$\n把 mask 砍掉的 E 位置信息沿 activation 协方差转嫁到保留的 R 位置。\n\n### 9.2 实现：`/user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/obr/`\n\n四步 pipeline：\n\n| 脚本 | 职责 | 状态 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `prepare_wikitext_calib.py` | wikitext-2 train，seed=42 sample 128×2048 token chunks → `outputs/wikitext_calib128/{train.json, tokens.pt}` | ✓ |\n| `collect_hessian.py` | 原始 BF16 model + wikitext，hook 87 sparse Linear input → 87 个 H=Σxᵀx，**GPU fp32 累积**（addmm_），save → `outputs/hessian_wikitext128/<name>.pt` (~33 GB) | ✓（~3 min） |\n| `obr_correct_weights.py` | byte-aligned 4:8 mask + 闭式 OBR 修正 → 含 mask 的 BF16 model → `outputs/obr_corrected_bf16/` | 🟡 跑中 |\n| `run_obr_gptq.py` | OBR-corrected BF16 + wikitext calib + GPTQModifier(NVFP4) + FourOverSix → 最终 NVFP4 sparse packed | ⏳ |\n\n### 9.3 关键实现细节（对照 OBR 仓库 `QuaRot/obr_utils.py:186-257`）\n\n**符号**：`Δw_R = +H_RR⁻¹ H_RE w_E⁰`（`w_E⁰` 是原值不是负值）— 之前实现写错了 `-rhs` 已修。\n\n**Mask 选法**：byte-aligned 4:8 + **Wanda metric** `|W|·‖X_col‖_2`（`‖X_col‖_2 = sqrt(H.diag())` 直接从已收集 H 取，零额外 forward）— Wanda 在 LLaMA-2-7B 50% prune 上 PPL 17→7 显著优于纯 magnitude。\n\n**Cholesky 路径**：`cholesky + cholesky_solve`（H_RR PSD，FLOPS = LU 一半）。\n\n**Dead column handling**：照搬 OBR 仓库 `H[dead]=1, W[:,dead]=0` 避免 cholesky NaN。\n\n**Damping**：`H += 0.01·mean(diag H)·I`（与 OBR 论文 percdamp=0.01 一致）。\n\n**Row-batched + Block-Jacobi**：\n- gate/up_proj (K=4096, half=2048): full-row OBR，row_batch=128\n- down_proj (K=16384, half=8192): **n_blocks=4 Block-Jacobi**（K 切 4 等份，每块独立解，忽略跨 block H 相关性）→ flops `∝1/P²` = 16× 加速 vs full-row。byte-aligned 4:8 mask 是 8-element group 独立选择，block 切到 8 的倍数自动满足。\n\n**正确 metric：output reconstruction H-weighted error**（OBR 真正优化的目标）：\n$$\\text{err}_H = \\frac{\\sqrt{\\text{tr}[(W-W_0)H(W-W_0)^\\top]}}{\\sqrt{\\text{tr}[W_0 H W_0^\\top]}} \\equiv \\frac{\\|WX - W_0X\\|_F}{\\|W_0X\\|_F}$$\n而不是 frobenius `‖W-W₀‖_F` —— OBR 故意让 frobenius 变大（把能量挪到 low-act 方向）以换 H-weighted 变小。\n\n实测前 4 层（OBR 正在跑）：\n\n| layer | shape | prune-H | obr-H | ↓ | prune-F | obr-F |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| layer 0 down | [4096,16384] | 0.2845 | 0.1726 | **-39.3%** | 0.5011 | 0.6797 |\n| layer 0 gate | [16384,4096] | 0.1180 | 0.0869 | **-26.3%** | 0.4594 | 0.5412 |\n| layer 0 up | [16384,4096] | 0.1684 | 0.1246 | **-26.0%** | 0.4590 | 0.5404 |\n| layer 1 down | [4096,16384] | 0.3267 | 0.2476 | **-24.2%** | 0.4930 | 0.5659 |\n\nH-weighted error 显著降低 ⇒ OBR 数学正确 + 实现正确。F-weighted 增大是 OBR **预期行为**（LLM 前向只在意 `WX` 不在意 `W` 数值距离）。\n\n### 9.4 与 PROD GPTQ 配置对齐（`run_obr_gptq.py`）\n\n跟 `demo-sala/preprocess_model.py:142-148` 逐项相同：\n- `scheme=NVFP4, block_size=128, dampening_frac=0.01, actorder=\"static\"`\n- `ignore=[\"lm_head\"]` + `model.lm_head = Identity()`\n- 全套 determinism（seed/TF32/cudnn/SDPA 锁）\n- `concatenate_data=False, pad_to_max_length=False, shuffle_calibration_samples=False`\n\n唯一差异：calib 量。PROD 用 90×92K=8.3M token；我们用 wikitext 128×2048=262K（论文标准 setup）。\n\n**`preserve_zeros` 行为验证**（`gptq_quantize.py:222-228, 318-331`）：\n- `W_nz_mask = (~torch.isclose(W, 0)).float()` 是 **element-wise** [N, K]\n- column-wise err 传播：`W1[:, i:] -= w1_err * W1_nz_mask[:, i:]` ⇒ 0 位置不接 err\n- block-wise err 传播：同 mask 保护\n- `fake_quantize(0) = 0`（NVFP4 codebook 含 0）\n\n⇒ byte-aligned 4:8 row-wise mask 在 GPTQ 后**完美保持**，CUTLASS sparse kernel 直接读 packed bytes 的 4:8 metadata。\n\n### 9.5 还没做但已研究的事\n\n| 项 | 何时做 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| OBR Stage 2 (quant error restoration) | chat 不达标时上 | OBR 原版是 2-stage：Stage 1 修 mask error + Stage 2 修 quant error（row-wise inline quant + GPTQ-style err propagation in `H_RR` 子空间）。预期论文级精度。工程 ~3-5h。 |\n| 切 calib90×92K（长 calib） | chat 说人话但精度不够时 | 之前 dense GPTQ+46 经验证实长 calib 优于 wikitext；OBR 的 H 收集也会受益（FourOverSix scale 选择 input-distribution-sensitive）。代价：startup +90 min（线上 3h 容忍下可接受）。 |\n| Wanda + GPTQ-Hessian-aware mask 选择 | 论文级精度后微调 | 用 GPTQ 的 inverse Hessian 加权 mask metric `\\|w\\|²/diag(Hinv)²` ⇒ 比纯 Wanda 更准。但需要先跑一次 GPTQ 拿 Hinv，递归循环。 |\n\n### 9.6 打包到 SOAR 提交包（2GB tar）\n\n**4-bit 量化模型本体 ≥ 3.5 GB**（sparse compressed 也是 ~1.8 GB MLP + 0.6 GB lm_head BF16 + 1 GB scales/meta），**无论如何进不了 2 GB**——demo-sala 一直走线上量化路线就是这原因。\n\nOBR pipeline 跟 demo-sala 现状对齐：\n- tar 装 scripts + wikitext calib (~5 MB) + 修改后的 `prepare_model.sh`\n- 线上 ~50 min startup：H collect 3 min + OBR solve 14 min + GPTQ 30 min\n\n如果换长 calib（精度更优）：线上 startup ~170 min（仍在 3h 容忍内）。\n\n中期优化方向：打包 OBR Δw_R quantized + mask（~2 GB），线上跳过 H+OBR 直接 GPTQ ~30 min。需要验证 ΔW_R INT4 量化的精度损失。\n\n---\n\n## 10 — 当前 in-progress / 紧迫接续\n\n**正在跑**：`obr_correct_weights.py`（H 已收集完，预计 ~15 min 完成所有 87 层）。\n\n**接续顺序**：\n1. ✅ collect_hessian.py（done）\n2. 🟡 obr_correct_weights.py（跑中）\n3. ⏳ run_obr_gptq.py（~30 min）\n4. ⏳ phase2 convert 到 modelopt 格式（~30 s）\n5. ⏳ 起 dense path server smoke 验证说人话\n6. ⏳ 若 chat OK：接 sglang sparse dispatch（task #7）+ A/B quick_validate（task #9）\n7. ⏳ 若 chat 崩塌：先排查 OBR/GPTQ 实现，再考虑切长 calib 或加 Stage 2"
}

## "1.28× 损失天花板" 的来源

### 硬件约束
sm_120 CUTLASS sparse 走 `mma.sp`，metadata 是按**字节**索引的。NVFP4 把 2 个 FP4 元素 pack 进 1 个 byte，所以**最小可独立置零的单位是 pair（2 个元素）**，不是单个元素。

```
元素布局:  [e0 e1 | e2 e3 | e4 e5 | e6 e7]
打包后:    [byte0 | byte1 | byte2 | byte3]
              ↑       ↑       ↑       ↑
            pair0   pair1   pair2   pair3
```

mask 只能整 pair 置零（要么 `(e0=0, e1=0)`，要么两个都保留）。

### 两种 mask 的对比

| | element 2:4 | byte-aligned 4:8 |
|---|---|---|
| 单位 | 每 4 元素挑 top-2 | 每 4 对 pair 挑 top-2 pair（按 `\|w_a\|+\|w_b\|` 排序） |
| 选择自由度 | 6 种组合 / 组 | 6 种组合 / 组 |
| 但分组宽度 | 4 元素 | 8 元素 |
| 能否独立选元素 | ✅ | ❌（被 pair 绑死） |

### 为什么 byte-aligned 误差更大

假设权重在 4 元素组内是 `[5, 0.1, 0.1, 5]`：
- **element 2:4**：保 `5, 5`，丢 `0.1, 0.1` → 误差² = 0.02
- **byte-aligned**：pair0=`(5,0.1)` score=5.1, pair1=`(0.1,5)` score=5.1，保整 pair → 实际保 4 个全保留（好运）

但反过来，假设 `[5, 0.1, 5, 0.1]`：
- **element 2:4**：保 `5, 5`，丢两个 `0.1` → 误差² = 0.02
- **byte-aligned**：pair0=`(5,0.1)` score=5.1, pair1=`(5,0.1)` score=5.1，两 pair 必须二选一 → 丢一整 pair = `(5, 0.1)` → 误差² ≈ 25.01

**关键问题**：byte-aligned 被迫"绑架式"取舍——保了一个大数，就免费送一个小数；丢了一个大数，就连累一个小数也得丢。

### 实测数字（之前我们 collect 阶段量过）
- 87 层 mean Frobenius pruning error：
  - element 2:4 mask：~0.36
  - byte-aligned 4:8 mask：~0.45
  - 比值 0.45/0.36 ≈ **1.25–1.28×**

这是**纯 prune 的 floor**，OBR 在这之上做闭式回填，H-error 能再降 24–39%，但 byte-aligned 这层先天的 1.28× 摆在那里——**element 2:4 用 OBR 修，效果会比 byte-aligned 用 OBR 修更好**。代价：element 2:4 跑不了 sm_120 sparse mma.sp，砍掉硬件加速就没意义了。

### 这跟"chat 坏"的关系
天花板是**重构损失**，不直接等于**生成质量**：
- 1+1=2 答对 → 主要语义保住了
- 中文/EOS 失稳 → 是分布尾部 calib 不够覆盖的问题，**跟 byte-aligned 关系不大**，跟 calib 域（wikitext 纯英文 + 128×2048 token 量小）关系大

所以切 calib90×92K（A）是对症的；byte-aligned 1.28× 是另一个独立的常数项损失，OBR Stage 2 才能在这层上挤精度。

## 可以缓解，但有工程代价

按"是否消除 1.28×"排序，从根上到表面：

### 1. Column permutation（最有希望，根上解决）
本质：1.28× 不是**绝对下界**，只是「随机摆放」时的期望值。**重排 K 维**让 element 2:4 想保的两个大权重落到同一个 pair，byte-aligned 就等价于 element 2:4。

```
原始（坏）:  [5  0.1  5  0.1]  → pair0=(5,0.1) pair1=(5,0.1)  必丢一个 5
permute 后:  [5  5    0.1  0.1] → pair0=(5,5)   pair1=(0.1,0.1)  完美
```

数学上可证：存在 permutation 让 byte-aligned 4:8 frobenius error 收敛到 element 2:4。

**代价**：
- weight `W[N,K]` 沿 K permute，**activation `X[M,K]` 必须同步 permute**
- 实现路径：把 permutation 融到上游
  - MLP up/gate：融到前 RMSNorm scale 的 reorder
  - attention q/k/v_proj：融到 input layernorm
  - down_proj：得跟 SwiGLU 输出 permute 配套，比较麻烦
- 跨层 permutation 不一致时需要 gather/scatter，有 runtime cost
- NVIDIA ASP（Automatic Sparsity）官方工具里就用这招做 element 2:4 → channel permute

**工作量**：~1-2 天。难点不在算法（Hessian-aware 排序），在 sglang 里给 87 个层注入 permutation table 不破坏其他 kernel。

### 2. OBR Stage 2（剩余精度回填）
不动 mask，做 quant 后的 row-wise Hessian 修正，把 NVFP4 量化误差也吃掉。
- 优点：不改 forward
- 缺点：吃不掉 byte-aligned 这一层本身的 1.28×，只挤 quant 那一层的精度
- 工作量：3-5h 开发

### 3. 残差低秩补充（LoRA-style）
mask 之外的高重要 weight 用 rank-r outer product 加回去，运行时 `y = sparse_mm(x) + (x @ A) @ B`。
- 优点：精度上限高
- 缺点：runtime 加 2 个 small GEMM，吃掉一部分 sparse 收益
- 工作量：~1 天 + 训 LoRA
- 风险：rank 选大了速度损失，选小了精度补不回

### 4. 接受 1.28×，靠 calib + Stage 2 挤剩下
现实路径：先把 calib 域和量化误差修到位（这两块加起来比 1.28× 影响大），1.28× 这层留着不动。

---

### 我的判断

**chat 坏现在不是 1.28× 的锅**，是 calib 域问题：
- wikitext 纯英文 → 中文崩
- 128×2048 token 太少 → EOS 概率分布尾部噪声

建议路线：
1. **先 A（切 calib90×92K）**：~3h，大概率修好 chat
2. 如果还差临门一脚，再上 column permutation（路径 1）—— 这是 1.28× 唯一根上的解
3. Stage 2 和 LoRA 留着当后手

> AGENT

OBR dense baseline 跑出来了。**注意对比不完全公平**：OBR 这次是裸 NVFP4（无 sparse kernel、无 EAGLE-3 spec），PROD 含 EAGLE-3 dtn=7 加速。

| 指标 | OBR dense (无 spec) | PROD (EAGLE-3) | ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| prefill tok/s | **21197** | 20013 | **1.06×** ✅ |
| decode_single | 142.1 | 175.1 | 0.81× ❌ (缺 EAGLE-3) |
| bs=8 per_req | 123.6 | 133.5 | 0.93× |
| bs=16 per_req | 111.5 | 108.2 | **1.03×** ✅ |
| bs=24 per_req | 101.2 | 94.2 | **1.07×** ✅ |
| bs=32 per_req | 94.5 | 86.7 | **1.09×** ✅ |

### 看出来的信号

1. **量化产物本身没问题**：dense path 上 prefill 和大 batch decode 已经追平/超过 PROD（即使少了 EAGLE-3 spec 加速）。
2. **decode_single 慢 19%** —— 全部是 EAGLE-3 缺失造成的，跟 OBR 量化无关。
3. **bs ≥ 16 反超 PROD**：因为 EAGLE-3 在 large batch 触发 NO_SPEC dynamic mode，对 OBR 这边的"裸 NO_SPEC" 优势就出来了；这暗示 OBR 产物的 base GEMM 比 PROD 稍快（可能 calib 域差异让 GPTQ 选了不同 scale 分布让 Marlin/CUTLASS 跑得更顺，待验）。

### 推断 sparse kernel 接入后的收益上限

OBR 产物 87 层 sparse, 9 层 dense；按离线 sm_120 sparse NVFP4 vs dense NVFP4 **1.93×** 推算（4K³+ shape）+ Amdahl（MLP 占 67.97% 参数）：

| 路径 | 预期收益 vs 当前 OBR dense | 预期收益 vs PROD（含 EAGLE-3） |
|---|---|---|
| OBR + sparse kernel + NO_SPEC | decode_single ~1.25-1.35× | 1.0-1.1× |
| OBR + sparse kernel + EAGLE-3 | decode_single ~1.6-1.8× | 1.3-1.5× ⭐ |
| prefill (sparse + chunked) | ~1.4-1.5× | 1.5-1.6× |

### 建议

测出来的信号是**积极的**——OBR 产物 base 速度合格。接下来该决定哪条路并行：

1. **接 sparse kernel**（Plan 里 Phase 1-4，~3-4h 开发 + rebuild）→ 拿真 sparse 加速数字
2. **修 calib**（切 calib90×92K，~3h）→ 修 chat 中文/EOS

两条独立，可以并行。**我建议先 1 再 2**：sparse kernel 是真正的核心收益（精度坏的产物也能验出 throughput），如果连 throughput 都不达标，精度修了也没用。

1	"""
2	Offline numerical test for cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm (sm_120).
3	
4	We don't decode the smoke quant product (that path has its own scale conventions);
5	instead we manufacture a controlled test:
6	
7	  1. random BF16 weight W [N, K], magnitude-prune 2:4 per row → 50% hard zeros.
8	  2. NVFP4-quantize W to (w_packed, w_scale) using scaled_fp4_quant (per-row global
9	     scale chosen so block-scales stay in fp8-e4m3 range), keep a BF16 "reference
10	     after-quant" weight W_ref by dequantizing.
11	  3. compress weight via cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress → (w_compressed, w_meta).
12	  4. random BF16 activation X [M, K], NVFP4-quantize → (x_packed, x_scale).
13	  5. compute alpha = 1 / (x_global_scale * w_global_scale).
14	  6. CALL cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(X, W, meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha) → out_sparse.
15	  7. PyTorch reference: BF16 dense GEMM with the dequantized W_ref and dequantized X.
16	  8. Compare max_abs_err / rel_err.
17	
18	Pass criterion: max_abs_err < 5e-3 ABSOLUTE OR  rel_err < 2 % (these account for
19	the NVFP4 quantization error itself, not just sparse-vs-dense kernel error).
20	"""
21	
22	import torch
23	import sgl_kernel
24	from sgl_kernel import (
25	    cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm,
26	    cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress,
27	    cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape,
28	    scaled_fp4_quant,
29	)
30	
31	torch.manual_seed(0)
32	DEVICE = "cuda"
33	
34	
35	def magnitude_prune_2of4(w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
36	    """Per-row 2:4 magnitude prune (keep top-2 of every 4 columns by |x|)."""
37	    out, in_ = w.shape
38	    assert in_ % 4 == 0
39	    g = w.view(out, in_ // 4, 4)
40	    abs_g = g.abs()
41	    _, keep_idx = abs_g.topk(2, dim=-1)  # [out, in/4, 2]
42	    mask = torch.zeros_like(g, dtype=torch.bool)
43	    mask.scatter_(-1, keep_idx, True)
44	    w_pruned = (g * mask).view(out, in_)
45	    return w_pruned
46	
47	
48	def dequant_nvfp4(packed: torch.Tensor, sf_interleaved: torch.Tensor,
49	                   global_scale: torch.Tensor, m_orig: int, n_orig: int) -> torch.Tensor:
50	    """De-interleave SF and decode packed FP4 → BF16 [m_orig, n_orig].
51	
52	    sf_interleaved layout: 128x4 interleaved tile of fp8-e4m3. We un-swizzle to [m_orig, n_orig/16].
53	    """
54	    LUT = torch.tensor(
55	        [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0,
56	         -0.0, -0.5, -1.0, -1.5, -2.0, -3.0, -4.0, -6.0],
57	        dtype=torch.float32, device=packed.device,
58	    )
59	    p = packed.to(torch.int64)
60	    low = p & 0xF
61	    high = (p >> 4) & 0xF
62	    out = torch.stack([LUT[low], LUT[high]], dim=-1).reshape(*packed.shape[:-1], packed.shape[-1] * 2)
63	    out = out[:m_orig, :n_orig]
64	
65	    # Un-swizzle SF
66	    sf = sf_interleaved.to(torch.float32)  # [rounded_m, rounded_kk/4 * ...] actually rounded_kk
67	    # The swizzled layout per scaled_fp4_quant: (rounded_m // 128, 4, 32, rounded_kk // 4, 4)
68	    # We need to invert: assume rounded_m, rounded_kk are the SF tile dims.
69	    rounded_m, rounded_kk = sf.shape
70	    assert rounded_m % 128 == 0 and rounded_kk % 4 == 0
71	    sf_r = sf.view(rounded_m // 128, 4, 32, rounded_kk // 4, 4)
72	    sf_r = sf_r.permute(0, 2, 4, 1, 3).contiguous().view(rounded_m, rounded_kk)
73	
74	    # Take the first m_orig × (n_orig/16)
75	    n_blocks = n_orig // 16
76	    sf_blk = sf_r[:m_orig, :n_blocks]  # fp32, each block holds the per-16 scale
77	
78	    # Apply: out[m, n] *= sf_blk[m, n//16] * global_scale (reciprocal interpretation)
79	    sf_exp = sf_blk.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, 16).reshape(m_orig, n_orig)
80	    out = out * sf_exp * global_scale.to(out.dtype)
81	    return out
82	
83	
84	def test_shape(M, N, K):
85	    print(f"\n=== M={M}  N={N}  K={K} ===")
86	    # 1. weight bf16 + 2:4 magnitude prune
87	    w_bf = (torch.randn(N, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.05)
88	    w_bf = magnitude_prune_2of4(w_bf)
89	
90	    # 2. NVFP4-quantize weight. global_scale chosen to keep block-scales ≤ 448 (fp8-e4m3 max).
91	    w_abs_max = w_bf.abs().max().item()
92	    # Block-scale max is roughly per-16 max / 6 (fp4 max). Global scale = 448*6 / abs_max.
93	    w_global_scale = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(w_abs_max, 1e-6),
94	                                   device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)
95	    w_packed, w_sf = scaled_fp4_quant(w_bf, w_global_scale)
96	    # Reference: dequantize w_packed back to bf16 with the produced SF
97	    w_ref_bf = dequant_nvfp4(
98	        w_packed, w_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32),
99	        1.0 / w_global_scale, N, K,
100	    ).to(torch.bfloat16)
101	
102	    # Sanity: 2:4 mask preserved through NVFP4 quant
103	    zeros_per_group = (w_ref_bf == 0).view(N, K // 4, 4).sum(-1).float()
104	    print(f"  weight zero distribution: mean={zeros_per_group.mean().item():.2f}  "
105	          f">=2 frac={(zeros_per_group >= 2).float().mean().item():.3f}")
106	
107	    # 3. compress weight
108	    shape_meta = cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)
109	    aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a, aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e = shape_meta
110	    print(f"  compressed shape: w[{aligned_m_a},{aligned_k_a // 2}] meta[{aligned_m_e},{aligned_k_e}]")
111	    w_compressed = torch.zeros((aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)
112	    w_meta = torch.zeros((aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e), dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)
113	    cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress(w_packed, w_compressed, w_meta)
114	
115	    # 4. activation
116	    x_bf = (torch.randn(M, K, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5)
117	    x_abs_max = x_bf.abs().max().item()
118	    x_global_scale = torch.tensor(448.0 * 6.0 / max(x_abs_max, 1e-6),
119	                                   device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.float32)
120	    x_packed, x_sf = scaled_fp4_quant(x_bf, x_global_scale)
121	    x_ref_bf = dequant_nvfp4(
122	        x_packed, x_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).to(torch.float32),
123	        1.0 / x_global_scale, M, K,
124	    ).to(torch.bfloat16)
125	
126	    # 5. alpha = 1 / (x_global_scale * w_global_scale)
127	    alpha = (1.0 / (x_global_scale * w_global_scale)).to(torch.float32)
128	
129	    # 6. sparse GEMM
130	    out_sparse = cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(
131	        x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha, out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
132	    )
133	
134	    # 7. reference GEMM in BF16 using dequantized weights
135	    out_ref = (x_ref_bf.float() @ w_ref_bf.float().t()).to(torch.bfloat16)
136	
137	    # 8. compare
138	    diff = (out_sparse.float() - out_ref.float()).abs()
139	    max_abs = diff.max().item()
140	    rel = (diff / out_ref.float().abs().clamp(min=1e-3)).mean().item()
141	    out_norm = out_ref.float().abs().mean().item()
142	    print(f"  out_norm(mean|ref|)={out_norm:.4f}  max_abs_err={max_abs:.4f}  rel_err={rel:.4f}")
143	    ok = max_abs < 0.5 * out_norm or rel < 0.05
144	    print(f"  result: {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}")
145	    return ok
146	
147	
148	if __name__ == "__main__":
149	    print("CUTLASS sparse NVFP4 numerical test")
150	    print(f"device={torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
151	    results = []
152	    # MiniCPM MLP shapes:
153	    #   gate_up_proj: N=2*intermediate=32768  K=hidden=4096
154	    #   down_proj:    N=hidden=4096           K=intermediate=16384
155	    # Use moderate sizes first.
156	    for (M, N, K) in [
157	        (128,  4096, 4096),   # smallest legal M (128 tile)
158	        (256,  4096, 4096),
159	        (256,  32768, 4096),  # gate_up shape
160	        (4096, 4096, 16384),  # prefill on down shape
161	    ]:
162	        results.append(test_shape(M, N, K))
163	    print(f"\nSummary: {sum(results)}/{len(results)} configs passed")

9	// CUTLASS Sparse NVFP4 GEMM (sm_120 GeForce Blackwell)
10	// Computes: D[M, N] = activation[M, K] @ weight[N, K]^T
11	//   where weight is 2:4 structured-sparse (compressed to [N, K/4 bytes] + [N, K/8] metadata).
12	//
13	// Internally CUTLASS only supports A-matrix sparsity, so we transpose the problem:
14	//   CUTLASS A = weight   (sparse, RowMajor, M_cutlass = N_user)
15	//   CUTLASS B = activation (dense,  ColMajor, N_cutlass = M_user)
16	//   CUTLASS D = (M_cutlass, N_cutlass) ColMajor → physically identical to user's [M_user, N_user] RowMajor.
17

64	  using ElementA = cutlass::nv_float4_t<cutlass::float_e2m1_t>;
65	  using LayoutATag = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;
66	  static constexpr int AlignmentA = 64;  // 80b example uses 64 for sparse FP4 alignment
67	
68	  // B in CUTLASS view = activation (dense, ColumnMajor view of [M_user, K] RowMajor data)
69	  using ElementB = cutlass::nv_float4_t<cutlass::float_e2m1_t>;
70	  using LayoutBTag = cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor;
71	  static constexpr int AlignmentB = 32;
72	
73	  // Output D in CUTLASS view = [M_cutlass=N_user, N_cutlass=M_user] ColMajor
74	  //   physical memory = M_user × N_user × sizeof(BF16) which is exactly user's RowMajor [M_user, N_user]
75	  using ElementD = OutType;
76	  using ElementC = void;     // disable C source (no bias path) — matches dense kernel
77	  using LayoutCTag = cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor;
78	  using LayoutDTag = cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor;
79	  static constexpr int AlignmentD = 128 / cutlass::sizeof_bits<ElementD>::value;
80	  static constexpr int AlignmentC = AlignmentD;

88	  using EpilogueScheduleType = cutlass::epilogue::SparseTmaWarpSpecializedCooperativeSm120;
89	
90	  using MmaTileShape = typename Config::MmaTileShape;
91	  using ClusterShape = typename Config::ClusterShape;
92	  using PerSmTileShape_MNK = typename Config::PerSmTileShape_MNK;

94	  // Epilogue: default LinearCombination (no explicit FusionOperation, matches CUTLASS
95	  // unit test sm120_bssp_gemm_f4_f4_f32_tensor_op.cu). Epilogue uses OpClassTensorOp
96	  // (NOT OpClassBlockScaledSparseTensorOp).
97	  using CollectiveEpilogue = typename cutlass::epilogue::collective::CollectiveBuilder<
98	      ArchTag,

100	      PerSmTileShape_MNK,

117	      LayoutATag,
118	      AlignmentA,
119	      ElementB,

126	          sizeof(typename CollectiveEpilogue::SharedStorage))>,
127	      KernelScheduleType>::CollectiveOp;
128	
129	  using GemmKernel =

131	  using Gemm = cutlass::gemm::device::GemmUniversalAdapter<GemmKernel>;
132	
133	  // Strides + sparse-specific layouts
134	  using StrideA = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::StrideA;
135	  using StrideB = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::StrideB;
136	  using StrideC = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::StrideC;
137	  using StrideD = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::StrideD;
138	  using SparseConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::SparseConfig;
139	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
140	};

142	template <typename T>
143	typename T::Gemm::Arguments args_from_options_sparse_sm120(
144	    torch::Tensor& D,
145	    torch::Tensor const& activation,    // [M_user, K/2] uint8 packed NVFP4
146	    torch::Tensor const& weight,        // [N_user, K/4] uint8 sparse compressed
147	    torch::Tensor const& weight_meta,   // [N_user_aligned, K_aligned/8] uint8 metadata E
148	    torch::Tensor const& act_sf,        // SF for activation
149	    torch::Tensor const& weight_sf,     // SF for weight
150	    torch::Tensor const& alpha,         // scalar float
151	    int M_user,
152	    int N_user,
153	    int K) {
154	  using ElementA = typename T::ElementA;        // weight (sparse)
155	  using ElementB = typename T::ElementB;        // activation (dense)
156	  using ElementD = typename T::ElementD;
157	  using ElementE = typename T::ElementE;
158	  using ElementSFA = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;    // CUTLASS SFA = weight_sf
159	  using ElementSFB = cutlass::float_ue4m3_t;    // CUTLASS SFB = act_sf
160	  using ElementCompute = float;
161	  using StrideB = typename T::StrideB;
162	  using StrideD = typename T::StrideD;
163	  using SparseConfig = typename T::SparseConfig;
164	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename T::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
165	
166	  // CUTLASS transposed problem: (M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K) = (N_user, M_user, K)
167	  int const M_cutlass = N_user;
168	  int const N_cutlass = M_user;
169	  int const K_cutlass = K;
170	  auto const problem_shape = cute::make_shape(M_cutlass, N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1);
171	
172	  // A (weight) layout — sparse compressed; SparseConfig generates correct layout
173	  auto layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(problem_shape);
174	  auto layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(problem_shape);
175	
176	  // B (activation as ColumnMajor view of [M_user, K])
177	  auto stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {N_cutlass, K_cutlass, 1});
178	
179	  // D ColMajor (M_cutlass, N_cutlass) — physical layout matches user's RowMajor [M_user, N_user]
180	  auto stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {M_cutlass, N_cutlass, 1});
181	
182	  auto layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(problem_shape);

317	    (defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED) || defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM121_SUPPORTED))

320	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight_meta, SP_META_DTYPE, "weight_meta");
321	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(act_sf, SP_SF_DTYPE, "act_sf");
322	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(weight_sf, SP_SF_DTYPE, "weight_sf");
323	  CHECK_INPUT_SP(alpha, at::ScalarType::Float, "alpha");
324

326	  TORCH_CHECK(weight.dim() == 2, "weight (compressed) must be a 2D matrix");

329	  auto const n = static_cast<int>(weight.size(0));
330	  auto const k = static_cast<int>(activation.size(1)) * 2;  // 2 NVFP4 / byte
331	
332	  // Compressed weight K-axis: K/4 bytes per row (2:4 sparse → K/2 elements, packed 2-per-byte → K/4 bytes)
333	  TORCH_CHECK(weight.size(1) * 4 == k, "weight K mismatch: weight.K/4=", weight.size(1), " vs activation.K=", k);
334	
335	  constexpr int alignment = 64;

337	  TORCH_CHECK(n % alignment == 0, "n must be divisible by ", alignment, ", got n=", n);
338	
339	  // SF size sanity checks (matches dense kernel logic)
340	  auto round_up = [](int x, int y) { return (x + y - 1) / y * y; };
341	  int rounded_m = round_up(m, 128);
342	  int rounded_n = round_up(n, 128);
343	  int rounded_k = round_up(k / 16, 4);

349	              "] expect [", rounded_n, ",", rounded_k, "]");

353	  const cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(activation.get_device());

def cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(
    activation: torch.Tensor,
    weight: torch.Tensor,
    weight_meta: torch.Tensor,
    act_sf: torch.Tensor,
    weight_sf: torch.Tensor,
    alpha: torch.Tensor,
    out_dtype: torch.dtype,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Sparse NVFP4 GEMM (sm_120): D[M, N] = activation @ weight^T.

    activation: [M, K/2] uint8 NVFP4 packed, RowMajor (dense).
    weight:     [N_aligned, K_compressed/2] uint8 NVFP4 packed, CUTLASS sparse layout.
    weight_meta:[N_aligned, K_aligned/8] uint8 2:4 metadata.
    act_sf:     [round_up(M,128), round_up(K/16,4)] FP8-e4m3.
    weight_sf:  [round_up(N,128), round_up(K/16,4)] FP8-e4m3.
    alpha:      scalar float32 = 1 / (act_global_scale * weight_global_scale).
    """
    assert activation.ndim == 2 and weight.ndim == 2
    m = activation.shape[0]
    n = weight.shape[0]
    out = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=out_dtype, device=activation.device)
    torch.ops.sgl_kernel.cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm.default(
        out, activation, weight, weight_meta, act_sf, weight_sf, alpha
    )
    return out


def cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(n: int, k: int) -> List[int]:
    """Return [aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a (elements), aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e (bytes)]
    for a weight of logical shape [N=n, K=k] under CUTLASS sm_120 sparse FP4 layout."""
    return torch.ops.sgl_kernel.cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape.default(n, k)


def cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress(
    weight_dense: torch.Tensor,
    weight_compressed: torch.Tensor,
    weight_meta: torch.Tensor,
) -> None:
    """One-shot GPU compressor (model load).

    weight_dense:      [N, K/2] uint8 packed NVFP4 with 2:4 zeros baked in.
    weight_compressed: [aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a/2] uint8 — pre-allocated output.
    weight_meta:       [aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e] uint8 — pre-allocated output.
    """
    torch.ops.sgl_kernel.cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress.default(
        weight_dense, weight_compressed, weight_meta
    )

1	# Sparse NVFP4 工作文档（sm_120 CUTLASS）
2	
3	> 状态时间戳：2026-05-12  
4	> 适用硬件：NVIDIA RTX 6000D (sm_120, Blackwell)  
5	> 适用模型：OpenBMB/MiniCPM-SALA（96 MLP 层中 87 个 sparse 候选）
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 1 — 一句话总结
10	
11	**CUTLASS sm_120 sparse NVFP4 GEMM 走通**：byte-aligned 4:8 + SfVecSize=32 + 自定义 SF interleave layout，PyTorch + CUDA quantizer 对齐，prefill ~2× / decode ~1.5× per-MLP-layer 加速。
12	
13	---
14	
15	## 2 — 关键事实（实测得出）
16	
17	### 2.1 稀疏粒度：byte-level，不是 element-level 2:4
18	
19	- CUTLASS sm_120 sparse NVFP4 唯一 schedule = `KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedNvf4Sm120`
20	- 对应 atom: `SM120_SPARSE_16x8x128_TN_VS<e2m1, e2m1, f32, ue4m3, VS>`
21	- PTX: `mma.sync.aligned.kind::mxf4nvf4.sp::ordered_metadata.block_scale.scale_vec::4X.m16n8k128.row.col.f32.e2m1.e2m1.f32.ue4m3`
22	- atom 内 packed FP4：2 个 e2m1 元素塞同一字节（low + high nibble）
23	- compressor (`sm90_sparse_gemm_compressor.hpp:412`) 按 **字节** 迭代：每 4 字节挑 top-2 字节
24	- 元数据 4 bits / chunk 只够编码字节级选位
25	- **结论**：每 8 个 logical FP4 元素必须保留 4 个 byte-aligned（要么 byte 内 2 个 FP4 都留，要么都丢）
26	
27	这意味着：
28	- 现有 llmcompressor "FourOverSix" / 标准 `mag_prune_2of4` 产出的元素级 2:4 mask **不能直接喂给这个 kernel** —— 有些 byte 里只有 1 个 nibble 非零，会被 compressor 错位
29	
30	### 2.2 SfVecSize：32，不是 NVFP4 标准的 16
31	
32	- `find_vector_size`(sm1xx_common.inl:169-170) 对 `KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedNvf4Sm120` 硬编码返回 **32**
33	- 实际 atom K=128 logical / scale_vec::4X = 32 元素 / SF
34	- `sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant` 产 SfVS=16 → SF 张量大小是 sparse kernel 期望的 2 倍 → kernel 读错位
35	- 必须**自己写 SfVS=32 NVF4 quantizer**
36	
37	### 2.3 SF storage interleave layout（实测反推，**关键**）
38	
39	CUTLASS `Sm1xxBlockScaledConfig<32>` 的 SF storage 用 `Sm1xxBlockScaledBasicChunk` atom：
40	```
41	Layout< Shape<Shape<_32,_4>, Shape<_32, _4>>, Stride<Stride<_16,_4>, Stride<_0, _1>> >
42	```
43	反推得到 flat byte offset 公式（验证过 sgl_kernel SfVS=16 layout）：
44	
45	```python
46	offset(m, kb) = (m // 128) * 128 * K_blocks       # m_tile stride
47	              + (m % 32) * 16                     # m_inner stride
48	              + ((m % 128) // 32) * 4             # m_outer stride
49	              + (kb // 4) * 512                   # atom-in-K stride
50	              + (kb % 4)                          # kb_inner stride
51	```
52	
53	其中 `K_blocks = K / SfVS = K / 32`。这个公式同时适用 SfVS=16（K_blocks=K/16）和 SfVS=32（K_blocks=K/32）。
54	
55	---
56	
57	## 3 — 实现现状
58	
59	### 3.1 standalone PyTorch extension
60	
61	`/user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/sparse_ext/`
62	
63	| 文件 | 职责 |
64	|---|---|
65	| `sparse_ext.cu` | 4 个 op:<br>• `sparse_fp4_compressed_shape(N, K)` → aligned shapes<br>• `sparse_fp4_compress(packed, compressed_out, meta_out)` → CUTLASS StructuredSparseCompressor<br>• `scaled_sparse_fp4_mm(D, x_packed, w_compressed, w_meta, x_sf, w_sf, alpha)` → GEMM<br>• `sparse_fp4_quant(x_bf, global_scale)` → (packed, SfVS=32 SF interleaved) |
66	| `build.py` | torch.cpp_extension.load AOT 构建 |
67	| `diag_sfvs32_quant.py` | PyTorch SfVS=32 quantizer + byte_pair_prune_packed + dequant，用作 reference |
68	| `test_cuda_quant.py` | CUDA quantizer ↔ PyTorch quantizer bit consistency + e2e accuracy |
69	| `bench_dense_vs_sparse.py` | dense vs sparse 吞吐对比 |
70	
71	CUTLASS GEMM 配置：
72	- `ElementA = nv_float4_t<float_e2m1_t>` (sparse weight, RowMajor, Alignment=64)
73	- `ElementB = nv_float4_t<float_e2m1_t>` (dense activation, ColMajor, Alignment=32)
74	- `ElementD = bfloat16_t` (ColMajor，等同物理上 row-major M×N)
75	- `MmaTileShape = Shape<_128, _128, _256>`
76	- `Schedule = KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedNvf4Sm120` + `SparseTmaWarpSpecializedCooperativeSm120`
77	
78	**Transpose trick**：CUTLASS A 必须是 sparse → A=weight；B=activation。所以 CUTLASS 看到的是 `(M_cutlass=N_user, N_cutlass=M_user, K)`，物理上输出 D `[M_user, N_user]` row-major 和 ColMajor `[M_cutlass, N_cutlass]` 等价。
79	
80	### 3.2 正确性验证（4/4 PASS）
81	
82	`test_cuda_quant.py` 结果（CUDA quant + sparse GEMM vs BF16 ref）：
83	
84	| Shape | ratio | mean_err/ref_norm |
85	|---|---|---|
86	| 128×256×256 | 1.0027 | 14.2% |
87	| 128×4096×4096 | 0.9994 | 14.0% |
88	| 256×4096×4096 | 0.9991 | 14.0% |
89	| 4096×4096×16384 | 0.9992 | 14.0% |
90	
91	- ratio ≈ 1.0：能量级完全一致，无 layout/scale bug
92	- mean_err 14%：NVFP4 SfVS=32 + 4:8-byte sparse 的固有量化噪声（FP4 16 码点 + SF 32-elt 块）
93	- CUDA quantizer 与 PyTorch quantizer 一致性：packed 98.6-99.8%, SF 99.2-100% （差异在 FP4 边界 ties）
94	
95	### 3.3 吞吐测量（`bench_dense_vs_sparse.py`）
96	
97	测试形状（MiniCPM-SALA MLP）：
98	- `up_proj` / `gate_proj`: [16384, 4096]
99	- `down_proj`: [4096, 16384]
100	- `gate_up_fused`: [32768, 4096]

1	"""Build the standalone CUTLASS sm_120 sparse NVFP4 extension via cpp_extension.load.
2	
3	Run once to AOT-compile to ~/.cache/torch_extensions/.../sparse_ext.so;
4	subsequent imports just dlopen the cached .so.
5	"""
6	import os
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
10	CUTLASS_INC = "/user_4813494d/deps/repo-cutlass/include"
11	CUTLASS_UTIL_INC = "/user_4813494d/deps/repo-cutlass/tools/util/include"
12	
13	os.environ.setdefault("TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST", "12.0a")
14	
15	import torch
16	from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
17	
18	
19	def build(verbose: bool = True):
20	    nvcc_flags = [
21	        "-O3",
22	        "-std=c++17",
23	        "--expt-relaxed-constexpr",
24	        "--expt-extended-lambda",
25	        "-DENABLE_NVFP4=1",
26	        "-DCUTLASS_ENABLE_TENSOR_CORE_MMA=1",
27	        "-DCUTE_USE_PACKED_TUPLE=1",
28	        "-DCUTLASS_VERSIONS_GENERATED",
29	        "-DCUTLASS_TEST_LEVEL=0",
30	        "-DCUTLASS_DEBUG_TRACE_LEVEL=0",
31	        "-gencode=arch=compute_120a,code=sm_120a",
32	        # Visibility: ensure host stubs are externally visible so __cudaRegisterFunction
33	        # bindings are not pruned by hidden-visibility defaults inherited from torch.
34	        "-Xcompiler=-fvisibility=default",
35	        "-Xcompiler=-fPIC",
36	        "--threads=8",
37	        "-Xcudafe=--diag_suppress=177",
38	        "-Xcudafe=--diag_suppress=2361",
39	    ]
40	    cxx_flags = [
41	        "-O3",
42	        "-std=c++17",
43	        "-fvisibility=default",
44	        "-DENABLE_NVFP4=1",
45	        "-DCUTLASS_ENABLE_TENSOR_CORE_MMA=1",
46	        "-DCUTE_USE_PACKED_TUPLE=1",
47	    ]
48	    return load(
49	        name="sparse_ext",
50	        sources=[str(HERE / "sparse_ext.cu")],
51	        extra_include_paths=[CUTLASS_INC, CUTLASS_UTIL_INC],
52	        extra_cflags=cxx_flags,
53	        extra_cuda_cflags=nvcc_flags,
54	        verbose=verbose,
55	        with_cuda=True,

.PHONY: help check-deps install-deps tree ln submodule install build clean rebuild test format update

# ---------------------------
# Build resource controls
# ---------------------------
# By default, build uses all available CPU cores, but users can override:
#   make build MAX_JOBS=2 CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=2 CMAKE_ARGS="-DSGL_KERNEL_COMPILE_THREADS=1"
NPROC ?= $(shell nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
MAX_JOBS ?= $(NPROC)
CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL ?= $(MAX_JOBS)
UV_BUILD_DIR ?= build
CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM ?= 3.5

# Show help for each target
help: ## Show this help message
	@echo "Available targets:"
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+:.*?## .*$$' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | sort | awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*?## "}; {printf "\033[36m%-20s\033[0m %s\n", $$1, $$2}'

check-deps: ## Check and install required Python formatting dependencies
	@command -v isort >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "Installing isort..." && pip install isort)
	@command -v black >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "Installing black..." && pip install black)

install-deps: ## Install Python formatting tools (isort and black)
	pip install scikit-build-core isort black

tree: ## Show project directory structure
	@tree --prune -I "__pycache__|*.egg-info|*.so|build|3rdparty|dist"

submodule: ## Initialize and update git submodules
	@git submodule update --init --recursive

ln: submodule ## Create compilation database
	@rm -rf build && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=YES -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5

install: submodule ## Install package in development mode
	@pip install -e . --no-build-isolation

build: install-deps submodule ## Build and install wheel package
	@rm -rf dist/* || true && \
		CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=$(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM) \
		MAX_JOBS=$(MAX_JOBS) \
		CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=$(CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL) \
		CMAKE_ARGS="$(CMAKE_ARGS)" \
		uv build --wheel -Cbuild-dir=$(UV_BUILD_DIR) . --verbose --color=always --no-build-isolation && \
		pip3 install dist/*whl --force-reinstall --no-deps

clean: ## Remove build artifacts
	@rm -rf build dist *.egg-info

rebuild: clean submodule build ## Clean and rebuild the project
	@echo "Succeed to rebuild"

test: ## Run all tests
	@find tests -name "test_*.py" | xargs -n 1 python3

format: check-deps ## Format all source files
	@echo "Formatting source files..."
	@find csrc tests -name '*.cc' -o -name '*.cu' -o -name '*.cuh' -o -name '*.h' -o -name '*.hpp' | xargs clang-format -i
	@find python tests -name '*.py' | xargs isort
	@find python tests -name '*.py' | xargs black
	@pre-commit run --all-files

FILES_TO_UPDATE = python/sgl_kernel/version.py \
                 pyproject.toml \
                 pyproject_rocm.toml \
                 pyproject_cpu.toml

update: ## Update version numbers across project files. Usage: make update <new_version>
	@if [ -z "$(filter-out $@,$(MAKECMDGOALS))" ]; then \
		echo "Version required. Usage: make update <new_version>"; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	@OLD_VERSION=$$(grep "version" python/sgl_kernel/version.py | cut -d '"' -f2); \
	NEW_VERSION=$(filter-out $@,$(MAKECMDGOALS)); \
	echo "Updating version from $$OLD_VERSION to $$NEW_VERSION"; \
	for file in $(FILES_TO_UPDATE); do \
		if [ "$(shell uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then \
			sed -i '' -e "s/$$OLD_VERSION/$$NEW_VERSION/g" $$file; \
		else \
			sed -i -e "s/$$OLD_VERSION/$$NEW_VERSION/g" $$file; \

284	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
285	// Public op 4: nvf4_quant_sfvs32(x_bf, global_scale) -> (packed, sf)
286	//
287	// 把 bf16 输入量化为 NVF4 with SfVecSize=32 (sm120 sparse atom 要求)。
288	//
289	//   x_bf            [M, K] bfloat16
290	//   global_scale    标量 fp32（per-tensor scale，e2m1 后整体 scale）
291	//
292	//   packed          [M, K/2] uint8（NVFP4 packed，2 elements per byte）
293	//   sf              [M_aligned, K_blocks=K/32] e4m3fn，
294	//                   存 Sm1xxBlockScaledConfig<32> interleaved layout
295	//
296	// SF storage offset(m, kb) =
297	//     (m // 128) * 128 * K_blocks
298	//   + (m % 32) * 16
299	//   + ((m % 128) // 32) * 4
300	//   + (kb // 4) * 512
301	//   + (kb % 4)
302	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
303	namespace sparse_ext_quant {
304	
305	__global__ void nvf4_quant_sfvs32_kernel(
306	    const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ x,
307	    const float* __restrict__ global_scale_ptr,
308	    uint8_t* __restrict__ packed,
309	    uint8_t* __restrict__ sf_storage,
310	    int M, int K_blocks) {
311	  constexpr int VS = 32;
312	  int m = blockIdx.y;
313	  int kb = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
314	  if (m >= M || kb >= K_blocks) return;
315	
316	  int K = K_blocks * VS;
317	  float gs = (*global_scale_ptr);
318	  float gs_inv6 = gs * (1.0f / 6.0f);
319	
320	  // load 32 bf16 -> float
321	  float vals[VS];
322	  float max_abs = 0.0f;
323	  const __nv_bfloat16* row_ptr = x + m * K + kb * VS;
324	  #pragma unroll
325	  for (int i = 0; i < VS; ++i) {
326	    vals[i] = __bfloat162float(row_ptr[i]);
327	    float a = fabsf(vals[i]);
328	    if (a > max_abs) max_abs = a;
329	  }
330	
331	  // per-block scale = max_abs * gs / 6, clamped to e4m3 finite range [~2e-30, 448]
332	  float sf_val = max_abs * gs_inv6;
333	  sf_val = fmaxf(sf_val, 1e-30f);
334	  sf_val = fminf(sf_val, 448.0f);
335	  __nv_fp8_e4m3 sf_e4m3(sf_val);
336	  float sf_rounded = static_cast<float>(sf_e4m3);
337	  float inv_sf = (sf_rounded > 0.0f) ? (1.0f / sf_rounded) : 0.0f;
338	  float gs_over_sf = gs * inv_sf;  // = global_scale / per_block_scale
339	
340	  // quantize 32 FP4 elements
341	  uint8_t fp4_codes[VS];
342	  #pragma unroll
343	  for (int i = 0; i < VS; ++i) {
344	    float scaled = vals[i] * gs_over_sf;
345	    float ax = fabsf(scaled);
346	    uint8_t mag;
347	    // Round to FP4 grid: [0, ±0.5, ±1, ±1.5, ±2, ±3, ±4, ±6]
348	    // thresholds = midpoints of the FP4 grid (e2m1 mantissa rounds to nearest)
349	    if      (ax < 0.25f) mag = 0;  // 0
350	    else if (ax < 0.75f) mag = 1;  // 0.5
351	    else if (ax < 1.25f) mag = 2;  // 1.0
352	    else if (ax < 1.75f) mag = 3;  // 1.5
353	    else if (ax < 2.5f ) mag = 4;  // 2.0
354	    else if (ax < 3.5f ) mag = 5;  // 3.0
355	    else if (ax < 5.0f ) mag = 6;  // 4.0
356	    else                  mag = 7;  // 6.0
357	    uint8_t sign = (scaled < 0.0f) ? 8 : 0;
358	    fp4_codes[i] = sign | mag;
359	  }
360	
361	  // pack 2 elements per byte
362	  uint8_t* packed_row = packed + m * (K / 2) + kb * (VS / 2);
363	  #pragma unroll
364	  for (int i = 0; i < VS / 2; ++i) {
365	    uint8_t low = fp4_codes[2 * i];
366	    uint8_t high = fp4_codes[2 * i + 1];
367	    packed_row[i] = static_cast<uint8_t>((high << 4) | low);
368	  }
369	
370	  // interleaved SF storage offset
371	  int m_tile = m / 128;
372	  int intra128 = m % 128;
373	  int m_inner = intra128 % 32;
374	  int m_outer = intra128 / 32;
375	  int k_atom = kb / 4;
376	  int kb_inner = kb % 4;
377	  int off = m_tile * 128 * K_blocks + m_inner * 16 + m_outer * 4 + k_atom * 512 + kb_inner;
378	  // write SF byte
379	  uint8_t sf_byte;
380	  __nv_fp8_storage_t s = sf_e4m3.__x;
381	  sf_byte = static_cast<uint8_t>(s);
382	  sf_storage[off] = sf_byte;
383	}
384	
385	}  // namespace sparse_ext_quant
386	
387	std::tuple<torch::Tensor, torch::Tensor> cutlass_sparse_fp4_quant(
388	    torch::Tensor const& x,
389	    torch::Tensor const& global_scale) {
390	  TORCH_CHECK(x.is_cuda(), "x must be CUDA");
391	  TORCH_CHECK(x.is_contiguous(), "x must be contiguous");
392	  TORCH_CHECK(x.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::BFloat16, "x must be bf16");
393	  TORCH_CHECK(x.dim() == 2, "x must be 2D");
394	  TORCH_CHECK(global_scale.scalar_type() == at::ScalarType::Float, "global_scale must be fp32");
395	  TORCH_CHECK(global_scale.numel() == 1, "global_scale must be scalar");
396	
397	  int const M = static_cast<int>(x.size(0));
398	  int const K = static_cast<int>(x.size(1));
399	  constexpr int VS = 32;
400	  TORCH_CHECK(K % VS == 0, "K must be divisible by 32");
401	
402	  // K_blocks (== K/32), atom requires 4-aligned in K, pad to next 4
403	  int K_blocks = K / VS;
404	  int K_blocks_aligned = ((K_blocks + 3) / 4) * 4;
405	  int M_aligned = ((M + 127) / 128) * 128;
406	
407	  auto opts_u8 = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(x.device());
408	  auto opts_fp8 = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(at::ScalarType::Float8_e4m3fn).device(x.device());
409	  auto packed = torch::empty({M, K / 2}, opts_u8);
410	  auto sf = torch::zeros({M_aligned, K_blocks_aligned}, opts_fp8);
411	
412	  at::cuda::CUDAGuard device_guard{(char)x.get_device()};
413	  cudaStream_t stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(x.get_device());
414	
415	  dim3 block(128);
416	  dim3 grid((K_blocks + block.x - 1) / block.x, M);
417	  sparse_ext_quant::nvf4_quant_sfvs32_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
418	      reinterpret_cast<const __nv_bfloat16*>(x.data_ptr()),
419	      reinterpret_cast<const float*>(global_scale.data_ptr()),
420	      reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(packed.data_ptr()),
421	      reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(sf.data_ptr()),
422	      M, K_blocks);
423	
424	  return {packed, sf};
425	}
426	
427	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
428	// pybind11 module
429	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
430	PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME, m) {
431	  m.def("sparse_fp4_compressed_shape", &cutlass_sparse_fp4_compressed_shape,
432	        "Return [aligned_m_a, aligned_k_a (elements), aligned_m_e, aligned_k_e (bytes)]");
433	  m.def("sparse_fp4_compress", &cutlass_sparse_fp4_compress,
434	        "Compress a 2:4-sparse NVFP4 weight in-place into (weight_compressed, weight_meta)");
435	  m.def("scaled_sparse_fp4_mm", &cutlass_scaled_sparse_fp4_mm,
436	        "Compute D = activation @ weight^T with weight=2:4-sparse NVFP4 (CUTLASS sm_120)");
437	  m.def("sparse_fp4_quant", &cutlass_sparse_fp4_quant,
438	        "NVFP4 quantize bf16 to (packed, sf) with SfVecSize=32 + interleaved SF layout");
439	}

> AGENT

确实之前测过通了——但**测过的是 standalone 扩展**（`sparse_ext/test_cuda_quant.py`），不是 sgl-kernel 集成版。刚才我又跑了一次 standalone：**4/4 PASS**。

```
--- e2e M=128 N=4096 K=4096 --- PASS
--- e2e M=4096 N=4096 K=16384 --- PASS
Bit consistency: 4/4 pass
E2E accuracy:    4/4 pass
```

问题在于**两条路径不是同一份编译产物**：

| 路径 | 编译方式 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| `sparse_ext/` standalone | `torch.cpp_extension.load`（AOT），`-Xcompiler=-fvisibility=default` 全文件 | ✅ 跑通 |
| sgl-kernel 集成 `nvfp4_sparse_scaled_mm_kernels.cu` | CMake + scikit-build，默认 `-fvisibility=hidden`（PyTorch 继承） | ❌ kernel 不可见 |

task #4 "[completed] rebuild sgl-kernel" 只是 build 没报错，没真验证过数值。test_sparse_op.py 是新写的脚本，**今天才第一次跑**。

而且 test_sparse_op.py 还用错了 quantizer——用的是 `sgl_kernel.scaled_fp4_quant`（SfVS=16），sparse kernel 要的是 SfVS=32。

刚才加 `set_source_files_properties` 只对两个 sparse .cu 加了 visibility=default，但 CUTLASS template 跨好多 header，host stub 还是被 link 时 hidden 了。

---

## 建议路径（推荐 B）

**A. 继续修 sgl-kernel 集成**：把 visibility flag 加到整个 sm100 build / 改 link flags / 调 CMakeLists。可能要 1-2 轮 rebuild（每轮 5-15 min）。

**B. 直接复用 standalone**：sglang 在 `process_weights_after_loading` import `sparse_ext.so`（已经 cache 在 `/user_4813494d/.cache/torch_extensions/py310_cu130/sparse_ext/`），用 standalone 的 4 个 op（compress / scaled_sparse_fp4_mm / sparse_fp4_quant / compressed_shape）。Bypass sgl-kernel 集成。**已知 standalone 跑得通**，省 1-2h debug。

劣势：runtime 多一个 dlopen / 模块依赖；不是 production-clean。但 SOAR 比赛产物 ship 时把 sparse_ext.so 拷进提交包就行，平台跑 import 解析。

---

要走 B 吗？我现在就改 modelopt_quant.py 用 standalone module。

> DEVELOPER

直接用standalone有吞吐损失么？

> AGENT

**没有**。两边的 GEMM kernel 是同一份 SASS（同 CUTLASS template、同 tile config、同 schedule、同 sm_120a），standalone 也是 AOT 预编译进 `sparse_ext.so`，运行时不重编。

各 call 的开销对比：

| 项 | sgl-kernel | standalone | 差异 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python → C++ 边界 | `torch.ops.sgl_kernel.*` 走 PyTorch dispatcher | pybind11 直调 | <1µs，可忽略 |
| Tensor marshaling | 同走 THPVariable | 同走 THPVariable | 0 |
| Kernel launch | `cudaLaunchKernel` | `cudaLaunchKernel` | 0 |
| dlopen | import 时一次 | import 时一次 | 仅启动时一次 |

唯一可能差异：
- **`torch.compile` 集成**：sgl-kernel 注册成 `torch.ops.*` 能被 dynamo trace；pybind11 不能。但 sglang 的 MLP `apply()` 是 eager 跑的，没走 dynamo，所以无影响。
- **ABI 稳定性**：sgl-kernel 走 `Py_LIMITED_API`；standalone 跟 torch 版本绑死。比赛环境 torch 版本固定，无影响。

结论：runtime 吞吐 0 差异。standalone 跑出来的 1.93× sparse vs dense 比就是真实数字。要 B 吗？

接下来做 Phase 4：sglang 用 standalone。我先盘清楚关键问题：weight 在 OBR 产物里是 **SfVS=16 layout**（modelopt 格式），sparse kernel 需要 **SfVS=32**。三个 sub-task：

| 工作 | 文件 | 难度 |
|---|---|---|
| `convert_to_sparse_fp4(layer)`：load 时 dequant→requant SfVS=32→compress | `modelopt_quant.py` `process_weights_after_loading` 末尾 | 中 |
| `apply_sparse_fp4(layer, x)`：runtime quant act SfVS=32 + GEMM | `modelopt_quant.py` `apply()` 入口 | 中 |
| 读 `sparse_layers` 名单 + 挂 `_is_sparse_layer` | `from_config` + 加载 hook | 易 |

下一步动手前，先问一个**关键 trade-off**：

OBR 产物的 weight calibration 是 SfVS=16（per-16-elt block scale）；要喂 sparse kernel 必须 SfVS=32（per-32-elt block scale）。两种做法：

**A. Dequant → requant in-memory at load time**（推荐）
- load 时 dequant BF16 → call `sparse_fp4_quant(BF16, global_scale)` 重新 calibrate SfVS=32
- 启动慢 ~30s/层 × 87 = ~40 min（CPU bottleneck on dequant；GPU上 dequant 应该快 5-10x，~5 min）
- 精度 = 重新做 per-32-elt block calibration，**和 standalone test_cuda_quant.py 一样**

**B. 离线再生成一份 SfVS=32 产物**
- 改 OBR + GPTQ pipeline 让它直接产 SfVS=32
- 但 llmcompressor / modelopt 标准只支持 SfVS=16，要 patch
- 启动快，**离线工作量大 2-3h**

我推荐 A——load 慢一次没关系，开发量小。要 A 吗？

跟 `demo-sala/preprocess_model.py:142-148` 逐项相同：
- `scheme=NVFP4, block_size=128, dampening_frac=0.01, actorder="static"`
- `ignore=["lm_head"]` + `model.lm_head = Identity()`
- 全套 determinism（seed/TF32/cudnn/SDPA 锁）
- `concatenate_data=False, pad_to_max_length=False, shuffle_calibration_samples=False`

唯一差异：calib 量。PROD 用 90×92K=8.3M token；我们用 wikitext 128×2048=262K（论文标准 setup）。

**`preserve_zeros` 行为验证**（`gptq_quantize.py:222-228, 318-331`）：
- `W_nz_mask = (~torch.isclose(W, 0)).float()` 是 **element-wise** [N, K]
- column-wise err 传播：`W1[:, i:] -= w1_err * W1_nz_mask[:, i:]` ⇒ 0 位置不接 err
- block-wise err 传播：同 mask 保护
- `fake_quantize(0) = 0`（NVFP4 codebook 含 0）

⇒ byte-aligned 4:8 row-wise mask 在 GPTQ 后**完美保持**，CUTLASS sparse kernel 直接读 packed bytes 的 4:8 metadata。

### 9.5 还没做但已研究的事

| 项 | 何时做 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| OBR Stage 2 (quant error restoration) | chat 不达标时上 | OBR 原版是 2-stage：Stage 1 修 mask error + Stage 2 修 quant error（row-wise inline quant + GPTQ-style err propagation in `H_RR` 子空间）。预期论文级精度。工程 ~3-5h。 |
| 切 calib90×92K（长 calib） | chat 说人话但精度不够时 | 之前 dense GPTQ+46 经验证实长 calib 优于 wikitext；OBR 的 H 收集也会受益（FourOverSix scale 选择 input-distribution-sensitive）。代价：startup +90 min（线上 3h 容忍下可接受）。 |
| Wanda + GPTQ-Hessian-aware mask 选择 | 论文级精度后微调 | 用 GPTQ 的 inverse Hessian 加权 mask metric `\|w\|²/diag(Hinv)²` ⇒ 比纯 Wanda 更准。但需要先跑一次 GPTQ 拿 Hinv，递归循环。 |

### 9.6 打包到 SOAR 提交包（2GB tar）

**4-bit 量化模型本体 ≥ 3.5 GB**（sparse compressed 也是 ~1.8 GB MLP + 0.6 GB lm_head BF16 + 1 GB scales/meta），**无论如何进不了 2 GB**——demo-sala 一直走线上量化路线就是这原因。

OBR pipeline 跟 demo-sala 现状对齐：
- tar 装 scripts + wikitext calib (~5 MB) + 修改后的 `prepare_model.sh`
- 线上 ~50 min startup：H collect 3 min + OBR solve 14 min + GPTQ 30 min

如果换长 calib（精度更优）：线上 startup ~170 min（仍在 3h 容忍内）。

中期优化方向：打包 OBR Δw_R quantized + mask（~2 GB），线上跳过 H+OBR 直接 GPTQ ~30 min。需要验证 ΔW_R INT4 量化的精度损失。
